title: Additive Manufacturing Technician
description: Job Description Additive Manufacturing Technician i Enabling&Operations – Daghold på LEGO® Jobbet som Additive Manufacturing Technician består i at sikre effektiv drift med produktion af udstyrsdele i den rigtige kvalitet samt bidrage til høj udnyttelse af produktionsapparatet og skabe løbende forbedringer. Det forventes, at du kan arbejde med udvikling og optimering af processer i et miljø hvor der ofte implementeres ændringer. Additive Manufacturing arbejder med teknologier, hvor både plast og metal-elementer bygges med materialer lag på lag. I vores udviklings- og produktionsområde på Kornmarken kører vi to programmer, som er fremstilling af henholdsvis LEGO-elementer og udstyrselementer til produktionen i form af bla. jigs og fixtures til bla. vores bearbejdningsafdelinger. Denne stilling henvender sig til drift af vores udstyrsproduktion på forskellige teknologier der omfavner både DLP, SLM og SLS. Dine opgaver bliver Sikre høj effektivitet på udstyr og maskiner. Varetage fejlfinding, optimering og justering af maskiner og processer. Deltage aktivt i forebyggende aktivitet, som rengøring, kvalitetskontrol og vedligehold. Udføre testkørsler og undersøgelser af materialer og udstyr i samarbejde med relaterede områder og samarbejdspartnere. Yde problemløsning samt deltage i analysearbejde. Opnå stor procesforståelse og knowhow for at opnå den bedst mulige kvalitet. Give feedback på partkvalitet og udstyrsperformance til samarbejdspartnere. Udgående kvalitetskontrol. Området er kendetegnet af kreativitet og innovative medarbejdere, hvor vi hele tiden forsøger at hæve barren på vores løsninger. Vi ved at den bedste måde at gøre det på, er at er at samarbejde , så vi udnytter idéer og innovative tanker fra alle funktioner. I jobbet forventes der, at du bidrager til udvikling af processer og bidrager til at løfte disse til et højere niveau. Jobbet forudsætter, at kundens behov holdes i centrum og udnyttelse af egne erfaringer og kompetencer på tværs af organisatoriske tilhørsforhold. Det gode match Du er uddannet Plastmager, Værktøjsmager, Industriteknikker eller har en lignende faglig uddannelse. Du er open-minded i forhold til nye teknologier og klar til sidemandsoplæring i opsætning og indkøring af AM-maskiner. Desuden har du et grundlæggende kendskab til og forståelse for kvalitet, da du skal besidde beslutningskompetence ifm. kvalitet Vurdere den visuelle kvalitet, og ved konstatering af afvigelser eller kvalitetsbrist skal disse håndteres i henhold til gældende eskaleringsprocedurer. Vi ser meget frem til at modtage og læse din ansøgning. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. What’s in it for you? title: Senior mekanikkonstruktör till Svekon
description: Vill du kombinera hands-on konstruktion med tekniskt ledarskap? Då kan du vara rätt person för rollen som senior mekanikkonstruktör hos Svekon i Solna. Läs mer och sök rollen redan idag! Vilka är Svekon? På Svekon får du vara med där det händer - från ett behov och en prototyp till en färdig lösning. Med sina 50 år i branschen fortsätter Svekon sin framgångsresa som ingenjörsbyrån som jobbar för en bättre morgondag. Idag erbjuder de tjänster inom bland annat mjukvaruutveckling, elektronik- och mekanikkonstruktion, industridesign och regulatorisk- och teknisk dokumentation. Svekon huserar i moderna och livfulla lokaler i Solna, där både kontor och verkstad finns under samma tak. På så sätt hamnar du aldrig långt från tekniken – oavsett vilken roll du har på Svekon. Vad ingår i rollen? Som senior mekanikkonstruktör blir du en viktig del av Svekons utvecklingsprojekt. I rollen kombinerar du avancerad mekanikkonstruktion med tekniskt ledarskap och ansvarar för både den tekniska lösningen och kvaliteten i projektens mekanikarbete. Du arbetar i projekt inom flera produktområden som konsumentprodukter, automation samt försvarsbranchen. Uppdragen kan variera från mindre utvecklingsinsatser till större tvärfunktionella projekt. I vissa projekt driver du konstruktionen självständigt, medan du i andra fungerar som konstruktionsledare och tekniskt stöd till projektledare och kollegor. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter: Utveckla och konstruera produkter och tekniska system från koncept till industrialisering Ansvara för mekaniska lösningar och kvalitetssäkring inom utvecklingsprojekt Driva och samordna konstruktionsarbete i rollen som konstruktionsledare Stötta projektledare med teknisk kompetens och vägledning Handleda och utveckla andra konstruktörer Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta med fortsatt hands-on konstruktion samtidigt som du tar ett större ansvar för helhet, teknisk riktning och kunskapsöverföring inom teamet. Vi söker dig som har: Civil- eller högskoleingenjörsutbildning inom mekanik, produktutveckling eller motsvarande Minst 8 års erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion och produktutveckling Erfarenhet av hela produktutvecklingsprocessen, från kravställning och konceptutveckling till verifiering och industrialisering Erfarenhet av att leda eller samordna tekniskt arbete inom produktutveckling God kunskap om design för olika tillverknings- och monteringsmetoder Avancerade kunskaper i 3D-CAD (gärna SolidWorks) samt erfarenhet av PDM-system God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift Vi tror att du är van att ta initiativ, skapa struktur i ditt arbete och stötta andra i tekniska frågeställningar, samtidigt som du är prestigelös och tycker om att dela med dig av kunskap. Det är meriterande om du har: Praktisk erfarenhet från tillverkande verksamhet Erfarenhet av plåtbearbetning, maskinbearbetning, formsprutning, gjutning eller monteringsprocesser Erfarenhet av flera olika material och tillverkningsmetoder Avancerade kunskaper i ytmodellering i SolidWorks Erfarenhet av konstruktion i kompositmaterial Erfarenhet från konsultverksamhet Erfarenhet av att handleda och utveckla juniora kollegor Kunskap om materialval och hållbarhetsanpassad produktutveckling Om du har läst så här långt är chansen stor att du är rätt person för rollen. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

title: Design Engineer Pump Product Engineering till Metso i Sala
description: Metso helps build a more sustainable future by developing solutions that transform the world's essential raw materials-the foundation of modern infrastructure, electrification, renewable energy, and digital development. With nearly 18,000 employees worldwide, the company combines innovation, safety, inclusion, and collaboration to drive positive change. At Metso, you'll have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and contribute to a more sustainable world. Introduktion Vi söker en erfaren Design Engineer till vår R&D-avdelning för slurrypumpar i Sala. I rollen arbetar du med mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling för produkter som används i krävande industriella miljöer. Tillsammans med kollegor inom konstruktion, produktutveckling och andra specialistområden driver du utvecklingsprojekt från idé till färdig lösning. Med din tekniska kompetens bidrar du genom hela utvecklingsprocessen och säkerställer att konstruktioner möter högt ställda krav på kvalitet, funktion, säkerhet och prestanda. Rollen innefattar även tekniska beräkningar och analyser, bland annat inom hållfasthet och säkra lyft. Arbetet sker i nära samverkan med funktioner som inköp, kvalitet, HSE, test och produktion. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team i Sala samtidigt som du samarbetar med kollegor och specialister runt om i världen. Som Design Engineer spelar du en viktig roll i vår fortsatta utveckling och bidrar till att skapa innovativa och hållbara lösningar som möter framtidens behov. Du rapporterar till Engineering R&D Manager, också placerad i Sala. Tjänsten är hybrid, men du förväntas vara fysiskt på plats minst två dagar i veckan. Allt för att skapa ett sammanhang där människor samarbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Teamet du tillhör Ditt närmaste team utgörs av nio personer med gedigen expertis inom design och FEA. Vi stöttar varandra och jobbar tillsammans mot gemensamma mål. Vissa av oss har jobbat länge inom Metso medan andra är relativt nya. Vi värdesätter mångfald och ser varandras olikheter som en styrka. Vad du ska göra Som Design Engineer R&D kommer du i huvudsak Skapa tekniska ritningar och modeller som motsvarar standardkrav för funktion och kvalitet. Självständigt, eller tillsammans med andra, ansvara för produktutveckling inklusive designprototyputveckling. Utföra hållfasthetsberäkningar med särskild betoning på säkerhet och säkra lyft. Bidra med ingenjörsexpertis och designkompetens både inom specifika produktutvecklingsprojekt och kontinuerligt utvecklingsarbete. Analysera uppkomna problem och bidra med tekniska lösningar. Jobba tight tillsammans med andra för att säkerställa framdrift och måluppfyllelse. Säkerställa att designen uppfyller kvalitets- och säkerhetsstandarder och vid behov utföra riskbedömningar, initiera testning, revideringar eller andra typer av verifieringsmetoder. Skapa och underhålla teknisk dokumentation som ritningar, specifikationer och rapporter och tillse att dessa granskas innan deadlines. För att lyckas För att vara framgångsrik i rollen behöver du vara drivande och självgående men också uppskatta att samarbeta och interagera med andra. Du är en ingenjör med öga för detaljer och analytisk förmåga men också förståelse för vikten av att hitta balansen mellan framdrift och hållbara lösningar över tid. Följande punkter stämmer också in på dig Examen inom maskinteknik eller annat relevant område. Tidigare erfarenhet från liknande arbete inom tillverkande industri. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: About Dalkia UK At Dalkia, we're driven by a shared purpose: tackling climate change and building a better, more sustainable future. We bring together talented people who share knowledge, challenge each other and grow together. Backed by EDF, Britain's biggest generator of low carbon electricity, we're a people-first culture. With 5,000+ employees and £600m+ turnover, we combine the strength of a major group with a great culture, innovative mindset and inclusive values making Dalkia a great place to work and grow your career. Mechanical Design Engineer Design innovative energy and decarbonisation solutions. Deliver projects that make a real impact. We're looking for a talented engineer to join our growing design team, delivering innovative decarbonisation and energy infrastructure projects across complex, live operational environments such as hospitals, universities, and industrial sites. This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge energy technologies while helping organisations achieve ambitious net-zero goals. From large-scale energy centres and heat pumps to district heating, chilled water systems and plant rooms, you'll play a key role in developing high-quality engineering solutions that improve performance, resilience and sustainability. This is an exciting opportunity to work on a diverse portfolio of projects involving energy centres, heat pumps, CHP, steam and hot water systems, chilled water systems, BMS, standby generation and other critical infrastructure. You'll be involved throughout the project lifecycle, from concept development and detailed design through to construction support and commissioning. What you'll be doing: Developing mechanical designs from concept through to detailed design Producing and reviewing specifications, schematics and technical documentation Coordinating designs with internal engineering teams and external consultants Supporting the delivery of low-carbon and energy efficiency projects Ensuring designs are practical, buildable and compliant with relevant standards Participating in site surveys, inspections and client meetings Supporting construction, commissioning and handover activities Identifying and helping to mitigate technical and operational risks Working collaboratively with project, electrical and controls engineers to deliver integrated solutions What we're looking for: Degree qualified in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering 3–5+ years' experience within building services, energy, infrastructure or M&E environments Experience with HVAC, steam, heating, chilled water and domestic water systems Knowledge of major plant including heat pumps, boilers, CHP and chillers Ability to produce engineering schematics and concept layouts using AutoCAD Understanding of commissioning, testing and engineering documentation Strong communication and problem-solving skills Experience working within live operational environments would be advantageous Why join us? This is an opportunity to work on challenging projects that directly contribute to sustainability, energy efficiency and Net Zero goals. You'll gain exposure to a wide range of technologies and work alongside experienced engineers in a collaborative and supportive environment where professional development is encouraged. If you're passionate about engineering, sustainability and delivering practical solutions to complex challenges, we'd love to hear from you. Our Values People First – It starts with health, safety and wellbeing Better Together – A collaborative team Trusted Partners – Dedicated to our clients' success Taking Responsibility – Making a positive difference Equity, Diversity & Inclusion We're committed to an inclusive and fair recruitment process. If you need any adjustments please let us know, in confidence, our team is here to support you.

title: PhD Position in the Fatigue Performance and Weldability of Next-Generation Structural Steels
description: Do you want to contribute to the scientific and engineering foundations of the next generation of sustainable structural steels? Job Description The steel industry is undergoing a major transformation to reduce its environmental impact. New production routes based on hydrogen direct reduced iron (DRI), electric arc furnaces (EAF), and the increased use of scrap are expected to play a key role in the decarbonization of the steel sector. However, important questions remain regarding the performance of these next-generation sustainable steels in fatigue-critical infrastructure and structural applications. In this PhD project, you will investigate the fatigue performance and weldability of next-generation structural steels, with the aim of enabling their safe application in infrastructure and construction. Specifically, the research will examine how "greener" steel production routes and varying levels of scrap content affect the fatigue behaviour and the weldability of these sustainable structural steels. You will combine experimental testing with advanced numerical modelling to evaluate both the base material and welded joints. The project will also assess whether existing fatigue design methods developed for conventional steels remain applicable to these next-generation sustainable steels. As a PhD candidate, you will be part of the Grow with Green Steel (Groeien met Groen Staal) programme and work within a multidisciplinary consortium of leading universities, research institutes, and industrial partners. This unique collaboration offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge research while working closely with stakeholders across the steel value chain. The outcomes of the project will support the safe implementation of the next-generation structural steels in fatigue-critical infrastructure and structural applications. Furthermore, the research will help reduce technical uncertainties associated with the transition towards a more sustainable and circular steel industry. title: Trading Systems Performance Engineer – EMO – Experienced Hire
description: Overview As a pioneer in low latency trading, Susquehanna is at the forefront in advances in the technology used to trade markets all around the world. As a Low Latency Trading Systems Research Engineer, you will be instrumental in driving enhancements and optimizations in how Susquehanna trades global markets in an extremely competitive environment. At Susquehanna, we don't believe in silos, we've proven that people do their best work when they have the freedom to explore, experiment and collaborate with other brilliant minds and as such this role engages close partnership with Traders, Trading and Quantitative Researchers, FPGA Developers, System and Network Engineers to continually analyze and optimize our trading systems, using data from lab experimentation, production data and the candidates own experiences and intuitions. The work done here has a direct impact on our trading business, and every single aspect of the environment is pulled apart and scrutinized, from physical cabling, fiber optics, transceivers, network stacks, all the way up to exchange level protocol specifications. What You Will Do Work with the very latest innovative and cutting edge technologies used in financial trading. Recreate complex low latency trading topologies and scenarios in our dedicated lab environment. Provide critical thinking to challenging problems and work as part of a team to help solve them. Work with stakeholders to identify and formulate lab testing scenarios. Use the dedicated lab and tools you develop to explore and test innovative trading scenarios to prove/disprove hypothesis. Identify, recommend, implement and drive optimizations in the production trading environment from the results of the testing. In depth analysis of production trading and lab network data, from many sources and formats. Become an expert on all aspects of the low latency trading environment. Drive testing automation efforts. Work with external vendors and companies on new products, features and technologies to keep Susquehanna at the forefront of Ultra Low Latency Trading. What We're Looking For Highly motivated, meticulous, articulate and deeply curious about all aspects of technologies used in a trading environment. Excellent software development, testing, trouble shooting and analysis skills using C/C++ and C#. Extensive knowledge of computer internals, operating systems and networking. Data analysis experience in Python using Jupyter Notebooks. Python and Powershell scripting experience. Great If You Also Have Experience in a low latency trading environment. Practical knowledge of the following network protocols BGP, IGMP, PIM, Ethernet, IP, UDP, TCP, LLDP etc Experience using FPGA's and technologies used in a Low latency networking environment. (Solarflare, Kernel bypass, etc) Knowledge or experience of DC operations. Susquehanna does not post salary information, so any salary information you find online may not be accurate because it was not provided or verified by Susquehanna. Susquehanna does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or search firms. Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will become the property of Susquehanna and no fee will be paid.

title: Process Engineer - New Manufacturing Technologies

You will take ownership of the end-to-end process lifecycle: from scouting new technologies and benchmarking machines to installation, commissioning, process optimization, and quality control. Your daily flow involves keeping our dedicated prototyping shop operational and efficient, supporting machine operators with technical challenges, and driving continuous process improvements. You will work with both conventional manufacturing methods (milling, turning, grinding) and advanced innovative techniques like Additive Manufacturing (3D printing). Managing machine selection, CAD/CAM integration, and data acquisition, you ensure high quality, short lead times, and optimal process efficiency. You will work via our hybrid model at our production facility in Wilrijk. To succeed, you will need At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position. Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering, or equivalent through experience Profound knowledge of manufacturing processes (conventional machining and/or Additive Manufacturing) and quality management principles Familiarity with CAD/CAM software suites and data acquisition systems Fluent communication skills in Dutch and English (spoken and written); knowledge of German is considered a plus Hands-on, creative, and critical thinker who is always looking for a better way to optimize processes Independent worker and reliable team player with strong organizational skills, accuracy, and a cost-conscious, innovative mindset In return, we offer t Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. You will work in a varied, challenging, and state-of-the-art prototyping environment with access to our local training center, structured mentorship (including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather), and global career growth opportunities. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave, retirement benefits, and flexible hybrid working arrangements. At Atlas Copco Group, we encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, philosophy, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity. Job location This role requires you to work on-site at our office in Anwterp, Belgium. You will be part of a dynamic team and enjoy the benefits of face-to-face collaboration. Uniting curious minds Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

title: Senior Process Engineer
description: Company Description Всичко започна с една проста идея: ами ако хирургията можеше да бъде по-малко инвазивна, а възстановяването по-малко болезнено? Близо 30 години по-късно, този въпрос все още е в основата на всичко, което правим в Intuitive. Като световен лидер в роботизирано-асистираната хирургия и минимално инвазивните грижи, нашите технологии – като хирургическата система da Vinci и Ion – трансформираха начина, по който се предоставят грижи за милиони пациенти по целия свят. Ние сме екип от инженери, клиницисти и новатори, обединени от една цел: да направим хирургията по-интелигентна, по-безопасна и по-хуманна. Всеки ден нашата работа помага на екипите за грижи да работят с по-голяма прецизност, а пациентите да се възстановяват по-бързо, подобрявайки резултатите по целия свят. Проблемите, които решаваме, изискват креативност, строгост и сътрудничество. Работата е предизвикателна, но дълбоко смислена – защото всяко подобрение, което правим, има потенциала да промени живота. Ако сте готови да допринесете за нещо по-голямо от себе си и да помогнете за трансформирането на бъдещето на здравеопазването, ще намерите своята цел тук. Job Description Основни трудови задачи и функции на длъжността Функцията допринася с ключовите си знания и умения за производството, проектирането и управлението на проекти, създаващ прецизни ендоскопски инструменти за минимално инвазивна роботизирана хирургия. Тази позиция се съсредоточава върху разработването, валидирането и внедряването на процеси, за да се изпълнят производствените операции и целите за безопасност, надеждност и производителност на продуктовата линия ендоскопи. Отговорности Разработва, поддържа и подобрява ефективни процеси за сглобяване на „среден до голям обем“, включително: Идентифициране, оценка и въвеждане на нови иновации в процесите в производствената линия. Специфицира, документира, квалифицира и внедрява производствени приспособления и оборудване. Дефинира и изпълнява тестове (като DOE, валидиране), за да провери дали процесите са стабилни и способни да предоставят последователни и надеждни резултати. Подпомага проектирането за определяне на критични характеристики на дизайна по отношение на приложимата технология на сглобяване и оптимална технологичност. Определя и включва инспекция на критични функции и тестови контролни точки в процеса. Разработва и валидира процеси на сглобяване и производство от първия прототип до преминаването към серийно производство. title: PhD position in circular silicon and silicon carbide for additive manufacturing
description: Job Description We offer a fully funded, four-year PhD position at the University of Twente focused on developing circular production routes for silicon and silicon carbide, key materials for high-temperature and high-performance applications. The project brings together materials science, powder technology, additive manufacturing, and data science. Silicon carbide is widely used in demanding thermal, structural, and electronic applications, yet its production is energy-intensive and relies on global supply chains. At the same time, the photovoltaic and semiconductor industries generate large volumes of silicon-rich waste: up to 75% of silicon can be lost across the value chain, while recycling rates remain around 5%. Existing recycling routes largely downcycle this material into lower-value compounds and do not produce powders with the quality required for advanced manufacturing. This PhD project aims to address that gap. You will develop and optimise routes for converting silicon-rich waste streams into high-purity powders. Using mechanochemical processing, you will investigate and control phase formation, particle size distribution, morphology, and flowability. You will then establish additive manufacturing process windows for these circular powders using both binder-free and binder-based additive manufacturing approaches, investigating melt behaviour, densification, defect formation, and microstructure in materials. A distinctive element of the project is its data-driven approach. Together with colleagues at Saxion University of Applied Sciences, you will contribute to the development of machine-learning models that connect powder characteristics and process parameters with the properties of the final components. These models will support faster feedstock qualification and enable predictive quality control. You will work in an interdisciplinary and international environment alongside academic researchers and industrial partners spanning the full value chain—from waste recovery and silicon processing to powder qualification, additive manufacturing, and advanced ceramics. The project offers strong opportunities to publish high-impact research while developing technologies with immediate industrial relevance and clear potential for sustainability impact. Your profile We are looking for a highly motivated, enthusiastic, and self-driven researcher who meets the following qualifications: A Master's degree in Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another relevant engineering/science discipline. Strong interest in powder technology, ceramics, and additive manufacturing. Experience with materials characterisation techniques an mechanical and thermal testing is highly desirable. Familiarity with additive manufacturing processes is an advantage. Knowledge of ceramic processing, powder metallurgy, or mechanochemistry is beneficial. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an interdisciplinary research environment. Strong analytical, experimental, and problem-solving skills. Motivation to contribute to both fundamental research and industrially relevant technology development. Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English, both spoken and written. Our offer A fully funded 4-year PhD position in an ambitious and internationally recognized research environment. Excellent working conditions, an exciting scientific environment, and a green and lively campus with lots of sports facilities and an international scientific community. The terms of employment are in accordance with the Dutch Collective Labour Agreement for Universities (CAO) and include: Gross salary between € 3.204,- and € 4.051,- per month depending on experience and qualifications; Excellent benefits include a holiday allowance of 8% of the gross annual salary, a year-end bonus of 8.3%, and a solid pension scheme. You can make use of excellent facilities for professional and personal development and a training program in which you and your supervisor will make up a plan for additional suitable education and supervision. You will receive good secondary conditions, in accordance with the collective labor agreement CAO-NU for Dutch universities. We encourage a high degree of responsibility and independence while collaborating with close colleagues, researchers, and other university staff. Information and application Are you interested in being part of our team? Please send your application by October 22, 2026 , via the "Apply Now" button and include the following documents: A cover letter (maximum one A4 page) outlining your motivation, relevant expertise, and interest in the project. A detailed CV, including academic achievements, research experience, publications (if applicable), and the contact details of at least three references. Academic transcripts from your Bachelor's and Master's studies. An abstract of your Master's thesis, briefly describing the research objectives, methodology, main findings, and key conclusions. For more information about this position, you are welcome to contact Dr. Davoud Jafari at davoud.jafari@utwente.nl. screening is part of the procedure About The Department The project at the University of Twente brings together scientists from the Faculties of Engineering Technology (ET). ET: The Faculty of Engineering Technology engages in the education and research of Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Industrial Design Engineering. We enable society and industry to innovate and create value using efficient, solid, and sustainable technology. We are part of a ‘people-first' university of technology, taking our place as an internationally leading center for smart production, processes, and devices in five domains: Health Technology, Maintenance, Smart Regions, Smart Industry, and Sustainable Resources. description: Application Closing Date: 30th October 2026 - Please note we reserve the right to close roles sooner, so Early Application is encouraged. Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together. Role description: Our two-year Graduate GROW Programme supports your transition from student to professional, sitting along client work and real projects from day one. Each graduate’s journey is unique, shaped by their chosen specialism and the variety of projects they contribute to. You will build your technical expertise by contributing to meaningful client engagements and project work, whilst business acumen and professional skills will be developed through centrally delivered graduate cohort training. Although there are no formal rotations, graduates are encouraged and supported by their managers to proactively seek opportunities, to broaden their experience and support their development. As an engineer joining GROW, you will be given the opportunity to specialise within your chosen discipline of engineering and we ensure you obtain the appropriate experiences that you need to become a technical expert. Being an Engineer at Arcadis is about applying a human filter to all your technical expertise and training, and making an impact through innovation and creativity. During this two-year programme you will develop core engineering and consulting techniques that can be applied while working with our clients in the UK&I and potentially even some of our international clients around the globe. Role accountabilities: Joining a multidisciplinary team, you will support our clients with their needs covering aspects such as HVAC, mechanical, architectural, process, electrical, commissioning, validation, and construction management services, across semiconductor and advanced manufacturing sectors. As a Mechanical Engineer you will support on key activities within HVAC/ Mechanical Services design. This will include supporting activities and projects across areas such as wet and dry mechanical system design, Energy Saving Review and Implementation, HVAC from basic ventilation systems to Grade A clean rooms, Chilled/Cooling water, Heating Hot Water/Heat Pumps, Compressed Air and CHP. Willing to travel and stay away from home when required (where possible we embrace virtual working) Why Arcadis? We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together. You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you. Together, we can create a lasting legacy. Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy. Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We believe that by working together diverse people with different experiences develop the most innovative ideas. Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the heart of how we improve quality of life and we work closely with our people across six ED&I Workstreams: Age, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+ and Race. title: Junior Mechanical Engineer Energiesystemen
description: Organisatie- en afdelingsomschrijving Sta jij te popelen om mee te bouwen aan een duurzamer Nederland? Voor een toonaangevende landelijke speler zoeken wij een Junior Mechanical Engineer Energiesystemen die een actieve rol wil spelen in de energietransitie. Je komt terecht bij een mooi Noord-Brabant bedrijf met een sterke focus op innovatie, duurzaamheid en samenwerking. Hier werk je aan de technische ruggengraat van de toekomst: duurzame energiesystemen die helpen bij het oplossen van netcongestie en het versnellen van de energietransitie. De afdeling Energieontwerp is volop in ontwikkeling. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een hecht team met een duidelijke missie: Nederland voorzien van toekomstbestendige energie-infrastructuur. Met een solide onboarding en buddy-traject zorgen we dat jij een vliegende start maakt. Functie-informatie Als Junior Mechanical Engineer Energiesystemen werk je aan het ontwerp en de technische uitwerking van mechanische componenten binnen complexe energieprojecten. Denk aan de aanleg van warmtenetten, ondergrondse energieopslag en grootschalige kabel- en leidingsystemen. Jij zorgt ervoor dat energie efficiënt, veilig en duurzaam van A naar B komt. Je werkt nauw samen met engineers, tekenaars en uitvoerders aan een grote diversiteit van projecten. Je krijgt volop ruimte om ervaring op te doen en jezelf te ontwikkelen in meerdere richtingen, zoals werkvoorbereiding, uitvoering of zelfs EMVI- en ontwerpcoördinatie. title: Mechanical Engineer - Image Quality
description: ABOUT THE ROLE Have you ever wanted to understand what happens between light entering a lens and a high-quality image being produced? Are you interested in how optical design, mechanical precision, manufacturing processes, and environmental conditions shape the performance of advanced imaging systems? FRAMOS is looking for an Image Quality Engineer to join our growing team in Čakovec. Working at the intersection of optics, precision mechanics, and manufacturing, you will help validate, optimize, and improve camera modules used in cutting-edge applications worldwide. This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates and early-career mechanical engineers who want to build expertise in optics, imaging systems, precision mechanics, advanced manufacturing, and embedded technologies. WHAT WILL YOU WORK ON? You don't need prior experience in optics or imaging – you will learn with us. You will start with clear tasks such as: Running tests that help us understand the mechanical and optical behavior of camera modules during product onboarding and validation. Evaluating how optical alignment, mechanical assembly, and tolerances affect image quality performance. Learning to operate and configure specialized laboratory and measurement equipment such as optical benches, calibration devices, and environmental test systems. Investigating the effects of manufacturing variation, mechanical tolerances, vibration, temperature changes, and other environmental conditions on product performance. Supporting process automation and continuous improvement initiatives that help us manufacture camera modules with the highest quality standards. Performing root cause analysis and solving engineering problems using measurement data, statistical methods, Python, SQL, and other engineering tools. Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to improve product robustness, manufacturability, and production yields. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR? We're looking for someone who is: Curious about how complex products are designed, built, tested, and improved. Interested in optics, imaging systems, precision engineering, manufacturing processes, product validation, and quality improvement. Comfortable working with measurements, technical analysis, and engineering problem-solving. Open to learning new technologies, tools, and methods. Motivated, reliable, and proactive. Enjoy collaborating with engineers from different technical disciplines. Able to work on-site in Čakovec. Comfortable communicating in English on a daily basis. A degree in Mechanical Engineering is especially relevant for this role. Graduates from Electrical Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, Materials Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or similar technical fields are also encouraged to apply. About us FRAMOS is the leading camera module design and manufacturing expert. Founded in Munich, Germany over 40 years ago, FRAMOS has empowered companies worldwide to make drones fly safely, enable robots to see and think, make diagnostics faster and more affordable, boost athletic performance with AI, and countless other innovations. Today, FRAMOS has 160+ employees worldwide, bringing together global expertise to support customers across industries and continents. FRAMOS stands for best-in-class image quality, an open-source approach, and fast, easy integration – helping customers launch products quicker and stay ahead of the competition. With strong expertise in electronics design, optics and optical assembly, camera calibration, image tuning, and software integration, FRAMOS provides off-the-shelf camera modules and customized embedded vision solutions. At our technology campus strategically located in Europe, we combine R&D and manufacturing services under one roof and provide scalable manufacturing capacities for up to millions of pieces. OUR CORE VALUES: PASSION We give our best every day and push ourselves to go the extra mile. INNOVATION We constantly seek new ideas and embrace unconventional solutions. TEAM SPIRIT We support each other, share knowledge, and build trust through feedback. FAIL FORWARD We try new things, learn from failure, and grow with each experience. CUSTOMER 1ST We put our customers at the heart of everything we do.

title: Ingénieur Calcul Mécanique H/F
description: Coengi est une société de conseil en ingénierie en pleine expansion, spécialisée dans l’accompagnement de projets techniques ambitieux et innovants. Notre mission ? Apporter des solutions sur mesure à nos clients en mettant à leur disposition l’expertise et la créativité de nos ingénieurs. Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement stimulant où vos idées sont valorisées ? Rejoignez Coengi et devenez acteur du changement ! Contexte: Dans le cadre du développement de nouveaux systèmes de mobilité, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur Calcul Mécanique spécialisé(e) en simulation numérique sous Abaqus . Intégré(e) à une équipe de développement multidisciplinaire, vous intervenez sur le dimensionnement, l’optimisation et la validation de composants mécaniques critiques : liaisons au sol, châssis, suspensions, transmissions et structures mécaniques . Vos missions Développer et mettre au point des modèles éléments finis (FEA) permettant de simuler le comportement mécanique des composants et sous-ensembles. Réaliser des campagnes de calcul pour accompagner le dimensionnement et l’optimisation des produits. Effectuer des analyses statiques, non linéaires, dynamiques et vibratoires . Analyser et interpréter les résultats de simulation afin d’identifier les zones critiques et proposer des optimisations de conception. Assurer la corrélation et la validation des modèles numériques à partir des résultats d’essais expérimentaux. Participer à la définition et à l’amélioration des méthodologies de calcul. Développer des scripts et outils permettant d’automatiser et d’optimiser les processus de simulation. Étudier, lorsque nécessaire, le couplage avec d’autres outils ou méthodes de calcul. Rédiger les notes de calcul et rapports techniques associés. Présenter et partager les résultats auprès des équipes internes et des différents interlocuteurs projets. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes conception, essais, systèmes et industrialisation. Profil recherché Diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’un Bac+5 en mécanique, calcul de structures ou simulation numérique . Vous justifiez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience en calcul mécanique et simulation numérique . Vous disposez impérativement d’une expérience significative de 2 à 3 ans minimum sur Abaqus . Une expérience dans le domaine de la mobilité, des véhicules, de la défense ou des systèmes mécaniques complexes constitue un plus. Compétences recherchées Maîtrise d’ Abaqus . Connaissance de l’environnement 3DEXPERIENCE appréciée. Modélisation par éléments finis / FEA. Calculs non linéaires, dynamiques et vibratoires. Mécanique des structures et dimensionnement. Corrélation calculs / essais. Bonne compréhension des assemblages mécaniques. Développement de méthodologies de calcul. Scripting et automatisation des simulations. Qualités recherchées Solide capacité d’analyse et d’interprétation des résultats. Rigueur et autonomie. Curiosité technique et force de proposition. Capacité à challenger et optimiser les solutions de conception. Bon relationnel et goût du travail en équipe multidisciplinaire. Pourquoi rejoindre Coengi ? Des projets à fort impact dans un environnement technique innovant : L'opportunité d'évoluer dans un secteur en pleine transformation digitale. Évolution professionnelle : Chez Coengi, vous bénéficiez d'un accompagnement personnalisé pour le développement de vos compétences et votre progression de carrière. Projets variés et stimulants : Travaillez sur des projets d'envergure et relevez des défis techniques passionnants. Ambiance de travail positive : Une culture d'entreprise qui valorise la convivialité, la collaboration, et le partage d'idées. Avantages : Rémunération compétitive, chèques-repas, assurances, possibilité de télétravail et formations continues. Prêt(e) à relever le défi ?

title: Ingénieur Calcul Expérimenté H/F
description: Description du poste et Missions La société "EGI" , filiale du Groupe Ponticelli Frères, recrute dans le cadre d'un renforcement d'équipe. Vous souhaitez développer votre savoir-faire d' Ingénieur Calcul expérimenté (H/F) et ainsi participer aux transformations du monde dans un groupe familial qui œuvre à fournir aux hommes ce dont ils auront toujours besoin : l’énergie, la santé, l’eau, l’alimentation et la sureté, dans le respect sincère de la planète et de ses collaborateurs. Nous vous proposons de nous rejoindre en CDI . Le poste proposé est localisé à Marseille (13) . Rattaché(e) au Responsable Calcul, le poste que nous vous proposons s’articule autour des principales missions suivantes : apporter votre expérience métier et votre savoir-faire pour des calculs de structure à l’aide d’outils numériques tels que ROBOT, BEAMSTRESS et des calculs par éléments finis à l’aide du logiciel ANSYS, selon les normes en vigueur (EUROCODES, RCC-M, …) ; calculer en appliquant les règles RDM pour des structures mécano-soudées à l’aide d’outils numériques ou de façon analytique ; réaliser/Vérifier les calculs d’assemblages boulonnés ou soudés, et des ancrages des structures étudiées ; rédiger/Vérifier des notes de calcul en français (voire en anglais) mais également échanger avec les clients et fournisseurs ; donner des avis sur des dimensionnements, avec des calculs sommaires et sur la base de votre expérience ; garantir la transmission d’informations entre les différents services, rédiger les offres techniques et commerciales tout en participant aux mises au point techniques. Votre réussite à ce poste passera par une période d'intégration. Vous découvrirez nos équipes, notre fonctionnement et nous vous apporterons le complément de formation nécessaire à notre domaine d'activité. Nous étudierons votre rémunération en fonction de votre profil et expérience : Fixe + Intéressement + Tickets restaurant + Mutuelle familiale prise en charge à 100% + Télétravail. Profil recherché Ingénieur généraliste, vous avez de l'expérience (au moins 5 ans) sur un poste similaire. Vous maitrisez les logiciels tels que ANSYS, ROBOT, BEAMSTRESS. Une expérience ou des connaissances dans le calcul de structure en génie civil serait un plus appréciable. Vous êtes force de proposition. Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux, organisé et avez une bonne capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Rejoindre EGI, c'est intégrer un bureau d'études ingénierie spécialisé en installation générale, comptant près de 150 collaborateurs répartis en 7 agences sur le territoire national : Lyon, Pierrelatte, Marseille, Nantes, Bordeaux, Saint-Mitre-Les-Remparts, IDF Est. Chez EGI, nous garantissons de bonnes conditions de travail en favorisant la formation et l'accompagnement, en permettant la mise en place du télétravail et surtout, en s'engageant à travers les chartes de l'ingénierie pour le climat et la mixité. Si vous souhaitez vous engager à nos côtés pour accompagner les transformations du Monde, nous vous attendons !

In this role, you will combine engineering simulation, scientific computing, and artificial intelligence to develop next-generation simulation technologies. You will work closely with structural simulation engineers to improve modeling efficiency, accelerate complex simulations, and build intelligent tools for engineering analysis. Proficient in programming languages, such as Python and C++, and have good code development capabilities. Proficient in commercial simulation software including Abaqus, COMSOL, or ANSYS. Familiar with mainstream machine learning frameworks. Familiar with mainstream database management frameworks. Practical experience in AI+ FEM simulation projects is preferred. Experience in large-scale data processing and model optimization is preferred. Experience in LLM/Graph Neural Network is preferred. Contract Type and Work Arrangement: This is a full-time, permanent employee position based on-site at our Helsinki office. Why Join Us? Our Helsinki Hardware and System Lab works on advanced hardware research and engineering challenges. In this role, you will apply AI to structural simulation and help develop faster and more effective methods for engineering analysis. The work combines mechanics, materials, numerical simulation, and machine learning. You will work closely with simulation engineers and other technical experts to develop new methods, build prototypes, and test their value in real engineering use cases. The team includes researchers and engineers from different technical and cultural backgrounds. We encourage open technical discussion, knowledge sharing, and collaboration with universities, research institutes, and industry partners. We support continuous learning and give our experts room to explore new ideas, take ownership of technical topics, and develop their professional expertise. Our employee benefits include occupational healthcare, performance based bonus, culture and sports benefits, team activities and celebrations, employee recognition programs, and daily office breakfast and snacks. About Huawei Huawei is a global provider of information and communications technology infrastructure and smart devices. Our business covers telecommunications networks, IT, smart devices, and cloud services. Research and innovation are central to Huawei’s work. We invest in both long-term research and the development of technologies that can be applied to future products and engineering systems. About Huawei Finland R&D Huawei Finland Research Center was established in 2012. Our teams work on advanced hardware, software, and system technologies for future products. The Helsinki Hardware and System Lab brings together specialists in engineering, simulation, materials, and AI. The team works on practical technical challenges while also exploring new research directions. This role provides a chance to work in an international R&D environment, collaborate with experienced technical experts, and contribute to new approaches in AI-based engineering simulation.

title: Design Engineer
description: Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Expertise in modern manufacturing methods (plastics, die casting, machining, and sealing technologies). Strong command of GD&T, material selection, tolerance analysis, and lifecycle management practices. Advanced skills in CAD/PLM systems (UG NX, Teamcenter, SAP) and familiarity with CAE tools (FEA, CFD). Demonstrated ability to apply critical thinking, design thinking, and holistic problem-solving to complex engineering projects. Experience in supplier management, cross-functional collaboration, and technical negotiations. Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills with a global team mindset. Fluent in English (spoken and written).

title: Bakım Planlama Mühendisi
description: 1948 yılında temelleri atılan Karadeniz Holding, enerji ve gemi inşa başta olmak üzere geniş bir sektör yelpazesinde inovasyonu ön planda tutarak büyümeyi ekonomik ve çevresel sürdürülebilirlik açısından destekleyen, vizyoner sektör lideridir. 30 farklı milletten 3.000’den fazla çalışanı ile 20’den fazla ülkede faaliyet gösteren, 8.000 MW’tan fazla kurulu güce sahip Grup, 45 Powership™ ve 11 LNG gemisinden oluşan filosuyla 4 kıtada güvenilir ve temiz elektrik üretirken dünya genelinde 10 bini aşkın kişiye istihdam alanı sağlamaktadır. Powership™ filosunu, uluslararası markası Karpowership altında yöneten Karadeniz Holding; Avrupa, Afrika, Amerika ve Asya kıtalarında faaliyet gösterdiği ülkelerin %10-%100 oranındaki elektrik ihtiyacını karşılamaktadır. Powership™, kara elektrik santralleri ve aynı zamanda yüzen LNG altyapısının dahil olduğu yüksek kapasiteli enerji çözümleriyle, Karpowership ülkelere ve şirketlere enerji geçişi süreçlerinde yardımcı olmaktadır. Yalova’da bulunan Bakım Birimi, Mekanik departmanımızda görevlendirilmek üzere; Bakım Planlama Mühendisi aramaktayız. NE BEKLİYORUZ? Üniversitelerin Mühendislik Fakültelerinden, tercihen Makine Mühendisliği veya Endüstri Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Tersane, ağır sanayi veya benzer endüstriyel tesislerde bakım yönetimi ve bakım planlama süreçlerinde en az 5 yıl deneyimli, SAP MM, QDMS ve MS Office programlarını etkin şekilde kullanabilen, İSG, kalite ve çevre gerekliliklerine ve bakım süreçlerine hâkim, Tercihen İyi seviyede yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce bilen, Analitik düşünme, planlama, takip, koordinasyon ve problem çözme yetkinlikleri güçlü, Mevcut süreçlerin sürekli geliştirilmesine katkı sağlayabilen, Tercihen İstanbul Anadolu Yakası, Yalova veya Kocaeli bölgelerinde ikamet eden veya edebilecek olan. SENİ NELER BEKLİYOR? Tersane genelindeki endüstriyel sistem ve diğer tüm ekipmanların periyodik ve arızi bakım planlarının hazırlanması ve ilgili birimlere raporlanması, Bakım faaliyetleri kapsamında ihtiyaç duyulan malzeme, yedek parça ve teknik hizmetlerin belirlenmesi ve satın alma süreçlerinin takip edilmesi, Makine, ekipman ve demirbaşların periyodik akredite muayeneleri ile elektrik (trafo, jeneratör vb.), asansör ve yangın sistemlerinin planlı bakım, test ve periyodik kontrol süreçlerinin yetkili servisler/kuruluşlar koordinasyonunda planlanması ve yürütülmesi. Akredite test ve muayene kuruluşları ile yetkili servislerin koordinasyonunun sağlanması ve raporların teknik açıdan kontrol edilmesi, 3 aylık periyodik renk kodu uygulamasının planlanması ve takibinin yapılması, Teknik şartname, teknik rapor, bakım planı, prosedür, talimat ve kontrol listelerin hazırlanması ve güncel tutulması, Dış servis ve yüklenicilerin bakım ve onarım faaliyetlerinin teknik olarak takip edilmesi ve yapılan işlerin kontrol edilmesi, Yeni makine ve ekipmanların teknik değerlendirme, satın alma, devreye alma, test ve kabul süreçlerine katkı sağlanması ve bakım gerekliliklerinin belirlenmesi, Ana ekipman ve teknik hizmet alımlarında piyasa araştırması yapılması, teknik tekliflerin değerlendirilmesi ve tedarikçilerin teknik yeterliliklerinin değerlendirilmesi, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 ve ISO 50001 kapsamında ve diğer iç-dış denetimlere hazırlık yapılması, denetimlerde bakım süreçlerinin temsil edilmesi ve uygunsuzluklara yönelik düzeltici faaliyetlerin QDMS üzerinden takip edilmesi ve aksiyon alınması, Bakım faaliyetlerine ilişkin KPI ve performans göstergelerinin takip edilmesi ve yönetime raporlanması. NE SUNUYORUZ? Doğum gününde 1 gün izin hakkı, Kapsamlı Özel Sağlık Sigortası, Mesleki ve kişisel eğitim & gelişim fırsatları, Çalışanlara özel indirim ve kampanyalar Çalışma arkadaşlarımız, adaylarımız ve tüm paydaşlarımızla “Tek Dünya” felsefemiz doğrultusunda başarılarımıza başarı katıyoruz. İlanlarımıza başvuru yapan tüm adaylarımıza ırk, din, dil, cinsiyet gözetmeksizin fırsat eşitliği sağlamayı ilke edinerek; farklılıklarımızla başarılarımızı taçlandırıyoruz.

Malzeme bilgisi (özellikle fiber, reçine sistemleri, sandwich yapılar vb.) konusunda bilgili veya öğrenmeye istekli, Parça fiyatlandırma, işçilik ve mühendislik maliyet hesapları konusunda temel bilgiye sahip

title: Proje Mühendisi
description: About MAKERS MAKERS is a growing engineering company delivering automation projects in Türkiye and internationally. We focus particularly on factory automation for the white goods industry, providing solutions from design and manufacturing through installation and commissioning. We are looking for a Project Engineer to join our team and take an active role in the delivery of our automation projects. GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS · Graduated from Engineering Faculty (Preferably Mechanical, Industrial , Mechatronics or Electrical-Electronics) · Min. 1 year of experience, proficient in project processes and stages , · Sufficient knowledge of English · Knowledge of AutoCAD and similar drawing programs, · Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, · Knowledge and experience in one or more of the fields of automation and robotics systems, · Has the discipline to business follow-up, · Compatible with teamwork, strong social communication, · He should have done his military service for male candidates, · Preferably living in any of these locations; Gebze, Çayırova, Darıca or Tuzla, · Successful in time management, · Proactive, result oriented, high problem solving ability and analytical thinking, · Strong communication skills, · No restriction for travelling, having a class B license and able to drive actively, JOB DESCRIPTION · Ensuring communication between the Project Sales team and the Technical operations department, · Execution of the processes (project, design, manufacturing, shipment, field operations) until the delivery of the project to the customer, · Taking responsibility for cost, budget and calendar management and creating periodic reports, carrying out necessary internal and external coordination and follow-up activities, · Preparing work orders for the relevant departments in the technical operations unit, · Making detailed plans for the projects he/she follows, · Preparing weekly and monthly reports on the projects followed, · Recording the material list to be used in the project to the system, · Examines the warehouse stock records on the system, transfers the products in stock to the relevant project warehouse, tracking the purchase orders through the purchasing department for the products that are not in stock, · Being in close contact with the production department during the production phase, answering the questions from the production department and providing the necessary support on the needed issues, · Preparation of documentation for responsible projects,

title: Üretim Takım Üyesi
description: KoçMedical I Bıçakcılar Hakkında Pandeminin en yoğun dönemlerinde yaşanan yoğun bakım solunum cihazı eksikliğine çözüm olarak, Mart 2021’de Sağlık Bakanlığı ile Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlıklarının talepleri doğrultusunda, Nisan 2021’de 100 adet ve Haziran 2021’de 5000 adet ventilatör üretimi sağlanmıştır. Bu kısa sürede gerçekleşen üretim süreci, KoçMedical hikayesinin başlangıcını oluşturmuştur. Koç Topluluğu’nun sağlık teknolojileri alanında faaliyet gösteren Hollanda merkezli şirketi olarak, sağlık alanındaki ihtiyaçlara yenilikçi çözümler sunmak, sağlığa erişimi geniş kitlelere ulaştırmak ve bölgesel bir sağlık teknoloji gücü haline gelmek amacıyla kurulduk. KoçMedical olarak, tek kullanımlık tıbbi sarf malzemeler ve tıbbi cihazlar olmak üzere iki ana ürün grubunda faaliyet göstermekte, medikal cihaz ve sarf malzemelerinin tasarımı ve üretimine odaklanmaktayız. Temmuz 2023’te KoçMedical bünyesine katılan Bıçakcılar Tıbbi Cihazlar Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş., 60 yılı aşkın deneyimiyle tıbbi cihazlar alanında pazar lideridir. Medikal sarf malzemeler kategorisinde kateter ve tüp setlerinde Türkiye’nin lider üreticisi olan Bıçakcılar, ameliyathane ve yoğun bakım ünitelerine yönelik geniş ürün portföyüyle Türkiye’de 150’den fazla bayiye, 1.500’den fazla hastaneye ve dünya genelinde 100’den fazla ülkeye hizmet sunmaktadır. Bünyesinde bulunan akredite Ar-Ge merkezinde ürün geliştirme çalışmalarını sürdürürken aynı zamanda kaliteli ve yenilikçi ürünlerin Türkiye ve yakın coğrafyalar distribütörlüğünü üstlenmektedir. KoçMedical | Bıçakcılar, bu güçlü birleşimle sürdürülebilir büyüme hedefini benimseyerek Avrupa merkezli bir global firma olmayı, sağlık teknolojilerinde ürün yelpazesini genişletmeyi ve ihracat pazarlarını büyüterek sektöre uluslararası düzeyde katkı sağlamayı hedeflemektedir. KoçMedical I Bıçakcılar’ın Sundukları KoçMedical | Bıçakcılar, Fortune Global 500'de yer alan güçlü bir grubun parçası olarak, yenilikçi bir şirket ruhu ve dinamik bir çalışma ortamı sunuyor. Çevik, eğlenceli ve esnek yapısıyla, profesyoneller için hem kurumsal bir düzen hem de yenilikçi bir kariyer yolculuğu vadediyoruz. Eşitlik ve birlik ilkelerini her fırsatta vurgulayarak çalışanlarımızın değerli hissetmesini sağlıyoruz. “Sağlığa yenilik, hayata iyilik katmak” misyonuyla çıktığımız bu yolda kalite ve inovasyonu ön planda tutarak sektörün geleceğini şekillendiren bir vizyonla ilerliyoruz. Bizimle çalışmak, sadece bir iş değil; insanı odağına alan bir ortamda gelişim, öğrenme ve başarıya ulaşma yolculuğudur. Çalışma anlayışımız, bireysel katkıyı desteklemek ve güçlü bir takım ruhu oluşturmak üzerine kuruludur. Şirket içi etkinlikler, sosyal sorumluluk projeleri, takım çalışmaları ve düzenli toplantılar ile hem birlikte öğreniyor hem de büyüyoruz. Çalışanlarımızın fikirlerine değer veriyor ve her seviyede katılımı teşvik ediyoruz. Koç Grubu’nun “Koç’lu Olmak” kültüründen ilham alarak, çalışanlarımıza eşitlik ve değer odaklı bir deneyim sunuyoruz. Onların gelişimlerini desteklemek ve kariyer yolculuklarında ilerlemelerine olanak tanımak için yanlarında oluyoruz. Eğer siz de bu heyecan verici, yenilikçi ve gelişim odaklı ortamda bizimle çalışmak istiyorsanız, Üretim ekibimize katılacak bir Üretim Takım Üyesi arıyoruz. Rol Sorumlulukları Üretim süreçlerinin planlanması, izlenmesi ve iyileştirilmesi, Günlük üretim hedeflerinin gerçekleştirilmesinin sağlanması, Üretim verimliliğini artırmaya yönelik süreç iyileştirme çalışmalarının yürütülmesi, Kalite standartları ve prosedürlerine uygun üretim yapılmasının sağlanması, Üretimde karşılaşılan problemlerin kök neden analizlerinin yapılması ve gerekli çözümlerin üretilmesi Kalite, Ar-Ge, Üretim Teknolojileri, Bakım ve Planlama ekipleriyle koordineli çalışılması, Üretim faaliyetlerinin İş Sağlığı ve Güvenliği kurallarına uygun gerçekleştirilmesi. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Mühendislik fakültelerinden, tercihen Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun, Üretim sektöründe, tercihen medikal / tıbbi ürün ve ekipman üretiminde en az 3 yıl deneyimli, Üretim süreçleri ve proses iyileştirme teknikleri bilgisine sahip, Kalite yönetim sistemlerine hakim, tercihen ISO 13485 hakkında bilgi sahibi, Süreç ve kök neden analizi (5 Why, Fishbone vb.) becerisine sahip, Makine performans ölçümü, duruş analizi ve OEE takibi hakkında bilgi sahibi, Teknik resim okuma, ölçüm ekipmanları ve temel ölçüm teknikleri üzerine bilgi sahibi, ERP programları, tercihen SAP kullanabilen, İleri derece İngilizce ve MS Office bilgisine sahip Ayrıca şunlara sahipseniz: Güçlü analitik ve proje yönetimi becerileri, Yenilikçi zihniyet odaklı, Güçlü iletişim ve sunum becerileri, Öğren-öğren-yeniden öğren çevikliği, Değişim için esneklik.

(Ürün ağacı altında; DMU, doküman ağacı, simülasyon ağacı, vb.) DMU çakışma analizlerini yapacak, DMU ve tasarım veri seti kalitesinin kontrolünü yapacak DMU’nun sağlıklı şekilde oluşturulması ve idamesi için, tüm proje tarafından uyulacak kuralları belirleyecek ve rehber dokümanlar hazırlayacak, bu katkılarınla havacılık ve uzay geleceğini şekillendireceksin. Türkiye’nin en kapsamlı ve başarılı kurumsal akademilerinden biri olan Akademi’miz ile sürekli eğitim ve gelişim, Çalışırken yüksek lisans veya doktoraya yarım asırlık Türk Havacılık Uzay Sanayii’nin desteğiyle devam edebilme, Global bir ekosistemde uluslararası stratejik pozisyonu olan projelerde deneyim, Türkiye’nin havacılık ve uzay alanında en iyi yetişmiş ve en başarılı mühendisleriyle birlikte çalışma, Keşif tutkunu, merak duygunu ve başarı hazzını sürekli besleyen çalışma ortamı, Havacılık ve uzay geleceğini şekillendirmenin itibarı. Yaşamına Ne Katacağız? Piyasa şartlarında rekabetçi kazanç paketi, Seni ve aileni kapsayan avantajlı sağlık paketi, Sevdiklerinle birlikte istifade edebileceğin kurumsal anlaşmalar, İlgi alanına göre katılabileceğin topluluklarımızla aktif bir sosyal yaşam, Spor takımlarımız ve tesislerimiz ile enerji ve sağlık, Kurum içi etkinliklerimiz ve sürprizlerimizle keyif ve motivasyon, Nasıl? title: Engineering Associate Trainee
description: Nestlé is one of the world’s leading food and beverage company, with 2000 global iconic brands and operating in 188 countries. At Nestlé we work for unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. That is our purpose. We are the Good food, Good life company. We believe in the power of food to enhance lives. Good food nourishes and delights the senses. It helps children grow healthy, pets thrive, parents age gracefully and everyone live life to the fullest. Good food brings us together. Good food also respects our planet and protects resources for future generations. Get to know us better at www.nestle.com Join Nestlé Team and be a Force For Good! We are currently looking for an Engineering Associate Trainee to join our Engineering team. Location: Karacabey Type of contract: Temporary (10 Months) As a Engineering Associate Trainee, you will have the following responsibilities; Support the maintenance and operation of factory infrastructure, electrical and mechanical utilities to ensure safe and reliable service continuity. Support the preventive and corrective maintenance activities for facility systems in line with Nestlé standards and site requirements. Support the preparing and maintaining regular reports related to maintenance activities, utilities performance and compliance requirements according to Nestlé standards. title: Grafik Tasarım Stajyeri
description: BİZ KİMİZ? Kaliteli kahveye ulaşmak herkesin hakkı olmalı dedik ve 2019 yılında hayata geçerek hayalimizi gerçekleştirdik. İlk günden bu yana kahve kültüründe yeni bir model yaratmayı hedefledik. Bunda başarılı da olduk. Yaptığımız doğru yatırımlarla kısa zamanda temelleri sağlam bir büyüme yakaladık. Bugün, Türkiye’nin dört bir yanından şubelerimizle hizmet vermeye ve hızla gelişmeye devam eden tek fiyatlı kahve noktasıyız! Benzersiz fiyat stratejimiz ve yenilikçi hizmet anlayışımızla açıldığımız her noktada çok seviliyoruz. Sektöre öncülük eden uygulamamız “Coffy App”le misafirlerimizin siparişlerini App üzerinden alıyor, lezzetlerimizi hızlıca sunuyoruz. Kaliteli kahvemizi herkese ulaştırabilmek için en yaygın online sipariş kanallarında da varız! Yaratıcı, aktif ve yeniliklere açık ekibimizle kahve kültürünün geleceğini hep birlikte şekillendirmeye devam ediyoruz. Özenle seçilmiş kahve çekirdekleriyle hazırlanan lezzetli içeceklerimizi ve her zaman taptaze, lezzetli tuzlu ve tatlılarımızı özel Coffy hizmet deneyimiyle harmanlayarak misafirlerimize en iyi şekilde sunacak kahve tutkunları arıyoruz. Sen de kahve kültürüne ilgiliysen, işini severek yapan, her gün daha iyisi için keyifle çalışan takımımıza katılmak istiyorsan hemen başvur! ARADIĞIMIZ POZİSYONDA SENİ ÖNE ÇIKARACAK KRİTERLER NELER? Üniversitelerin Grafik Tasarım, Görsel İletişim Tasarımı veya ilgili bölümlerinde lisans öğrenci, Haftanın 3 günü staja devam edebilecek, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects gibi video programlarını iyi derecede kullanabilen, Çekilen fotoğraflarda dekupe ve retouch işlemlerini yapabilecek, Görsel yönü güçlü, iletişim yönü kuvvetli. BU POZİSYONDA NELER YAPILIR? İç ve dış iletişimde kullanılan baskılı ve dijital tüm pazarlama materyallerinin uyarlamalarının yapılmasına destek, Franchisee ihtiyaçları doğrultusunda promosyon ve reklam faaliyetlerinde kullanılacak tüm katalog, broşür, flyer, store banner tasarımlarının hazırlanması, Banner, gif, sosyal medya ileti ve mailing gibi dijital iletişim görsellerinin tasarlanması, Coffy App içerisindeki kampanya ve ürün görsellerinin hazırlanması. COFFY SANA NASIL BİR ÇALIŞMA ORTAMI SUNUYOR? Alacağın sorumluluklarla kendini geliştirme, inisiyatif alma ve çokça öğrenme imkanı, Arkadaşlık bağlarının da güçlü olduğu bir çalışma ortamında takım çalışmasıyla Coffy’de potansiyelini ve güçlü yönlerini keşfetme fırsatı, Rahat, heyecanlı ve eğlenceli bir çalışma ortamı, Çevik takımlarımızla e-ticaretteki yenilikleri uygulama şansı. Coffy ailesine katılmak ister misin? Hadi hemen başvuru yaparak bize CV’ni gönder!

title: Mechanical Engineer - jouwtechniekbaan.nl
description: Als Mechanical Engineer in Zwolle werk je vanuit een modern kantoor in een informele, technisch gedreven omgeving aan innovatieve en duurzame maakindustrieprojecten. Je specificeert en ontwerpt zelfstandig constructies, machines en producten en vertaalt concepten naar volledige engineeringspakketten die geschikt zijn voor realisatie door productie en assemblage. Binnen jouw projecten draag je medeverantwoordelijkheid voor de technische en constructieve uitvoering en lever je de analytische onderbouwing die nodig is om sterkte, functionaliteit en integriteit te garanderen. Je zoekt naar optimale oplossingen op het gebied van maakbaarheid, kosten, sterkte, monteerbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid en voert berekeningen en validaties uit met moderne methoden zoals FEM-analyses. In je dagelijkse werk wissel je zelfstandig werken af met samenwerken in multidisciplinaire teams en onderhoud je projectgericht contact met klanten. We vragen een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur Werktuigbouwkunde of Mechatronica, minimaal twee jaar relevante ervaring en vertrouwdheid met 3D-ontwerpsoftware en analysetools. Je hebt een scherp conceptueel vermogen, technische nieuwsgierigheid en je communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s en opdrachtgevers in het Nederlands en Engels. Deze rol biedt ruimte om je technische signatuur uit te bouwen binnen hightech en duurzame projecten met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden en ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Functie-inhoud Specificeren en zelfstandig ontwerpen van constructies, machines en producten voor realisatie in productieomgevingen. Opstellen van volledige engineeringspakketten inclusief tekeningen, stuklijsten en montagematerialen voor uitvoerende teams. Uitvoeren van sterkte- en integriteitsanalyses met FEM om functionele eisen en veiligheid te borgen. Zoeken naar oplossingen gericht op maakbaarheid, kostenreductie, monteerbaarheid en lange termijn betrouwbaarheid. Overleggen met klanten en interne teams om technische keuzes en projectafstemming te waarborgen. Functie-eisen Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in de techniek, bij voorkeur Werktuigbouwkunde of Mechatronica. Minimaal twee jaar aantoonbare ervaring als mechanical engineer of constructeur binnen vergelijkbare projecten. Ervaring met FEM en 3D CAD-software zoals NX, Ansys, SolidWorks of Inventor is gewenst. Sterk conceptueel vermogen en kunde in technisch-constructieve onderbouwing van ontwerpen en berekeningen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels; kennis van Duits is een pré. Wij bieden Werken aan hightech en duurzame projecten met veel ruimte voor technische innovatie en eigen inbreng. Een informele, vakinhoudelijke werksfeer met enthousiaste en deskundige collega’s om kennis mee te delen. Regie op je loopbaan en toegang tot interne ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en opleidingen binnen de organisatie. Prima faciliteiten voor thuiswerken en een thuiswerkvergoeding voor flexibel werken tussen kantoor en thuis. Aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals 35 vakantiedagen, reiskostenvergoeding, goede pensioenregeling en collectieve zorgverzekering. #Jobster

Value Engineering i praksis Value Engineering er specialiseret inden for bærende konstruktioner. Vores spidskompetence er at analysere og optimere konstruktive løsninger med fokus på bygbarhed og værdi for projektet. Opgaverne varierer i både indhold og varighed. Nogle sager strækker sig over få uger, mens andre løber over længere perioder. Hvem søger vi? title: Structural Engineering Intern Part-time / Full-time | Flexible / Hybrid
description: mellow designs is looking for a Structural Engineering Intern to join our interdisciplinary design and development team. We work across modular architectural systems, temporary structures, scaffolding-based installations and experimental spatial projects, and we are looking for someone with a structural engineering background who can support the technical development, analysis and testing of these projects. What you will work on You will contribute to real projects that are developed, produced and implemented in physical environments. Your tasks may include: Structural analysis and calculations for modular architectural systems Wind load analysis for temporary and outdoor structures Load calculations for scaffolding-based stages, installations and spatial structures Evaluation of structural stability, stiffness and load-bearing capacity Analysis of connections, nodes, tubes and structural components Supporting the optimisation of material use, dimensions and structural performance Contributing to prototype testing, technical documentation and validation Supporting the structural development of systems that move from early concept to physical implementation You may also contribute to the testing and development of experimental spatial structures created through reuse and upcycling strategies, where existing materials and components are given new architectural applications. Who we are looking for You may be studying or recently graduated in: Structural Engineering Civil Engineering Architectural Engineering Building Engineering or a related field Experience with structural analysis software is an advantage. Knowledge of tools such as Karamba3D, FEM software, RFEM, SAP2000 or similar tools is welcome. We are especially interested in someone who enjoys working between engineering, architecture, product development and experimentation, rather than only following predefined structural solutions. What you will gain This is an unpaid internship , but the role is designed to provide meaningful professional experience and direct involvement in real projects. You will: Work in an interdisciplinary environment together with architects, product designers, business and commercial profiles Contribute to products, installations and structures that are intended to be physically produced and implemented Gain hands-on experience with structural development from concept and calculation to prototyping and real-life testing Work with both permanent and temporary structural applications Gain experience with scaffolding-based structures, modular systems and experimental construction methods Learn about circular design, material reuse and upcycling strategies in architecture and product development Be able to document and use your calculations, analyses and project contributions in your portfolio and future professional applications Have flexibility in organising your working hours and responsibilities The internship can be part-time or full-time , with flexibility for remote work , although occasional collaboration with the team in Copenhagen is very welcome. About mellow designs mellow designs works at the intersection of architecture, product development, temporary structures and circular construction . We develop adaptable spatial systems, installations and architectural products while exploring how existing materials and construction components can be reused, reconfigured and given new applications. Our projects range from modular wall systems and product development to scaffolding-based stages, temporary structures and experimental spatial installations . If you are interested in combining structural engineering with architecture, circular design, product development and real-world experimentation , we would be happy to hear from you. Please send us a short introduction, your CV and, if relevant, examples of previous structural or technical work to tg@mellowdesigns.dk
