title: Saab söker erfarna ingenjörer inom mekanik!
description: Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld. Din roll För oss är teknik mer än design och mekanik. Det är hjärtat i vår verksamhet. Det som utmanar oss, inspirerar oss och håller oss engagerade. Som ingenjör inom mekanik kommer du att vara involverad i kravspecifikationer, och utifrån detta konstruera och utveckla mekaniska lösningar till våra produkter, genom att arbeta med kravhantering, specificering, konstruktion, verifiering och dokumentation. Dina blivande arbetsuppgifter kan vara allt ifrån modellering, testning, utvärdering av resultat, framtagning och uppdatering av ritningsunderlag samt bistå med teknisk kompetens mot till andra avdelningar, leverantörer och kunder. Vi driver både stora projekt som ställer krav på samarbetsförmåga och mindre projekt som ställer krav på självständighet – och du tillsammans med ditt team är en viktig pusselbit i vår resa mot att skapa nästa generations försvarssystem. Vi erbjuder en stimulerande arbetsmiljö där du kommer att få möjlighet att utvecklas och växa inom området. Du kommer att vara del av ett team som stöttar dig och din personliga utveckling. Din profil För att trivas på Saab tror du på en kultur av nyfikenhet, tillit och lagarbete. Det spelar ingen roll om du är i början av din karriär eller är expert inom ditt område, det viktigaste är att du delar vår passion för utveckling och ny spännande teknik! Som en del av vårt team kommer du att få möjlighet att arbeta med de senaste verktygen och teknologierna inom branschen. Vi söker dig med kunskap och erfarenhet inom bland annat verktyg och programspråk som; Catia, 3DExperience, och 2D-Ritningar. Även andra verktyg och tekniska plattformar förekommer. Våra team är mångsidiga och vi tror på att olika perspektiv och erfarenheter kan bidra till att skapa ännu bättre lösningar. Så oavsett tidigare erfarenhet och arbetsbakgrund är du mer än välkommen att vara med och forma framtidens teknologi. På vårt kontor i Karlskoga erbjuder vi en bred variation av spännande roller inom meka. Oavsett om du är mekanikkonstruktör, mekanikingenjör, verktygskonstruktör, elmekanikkonstruktör eller projektledare inom området finns det möjligheter för dig att växa och utvecklas tillsammans med oss! Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Det du blir en del av Bakom våra innovationer finns alla de som har gjort det möjligt. Modiga pionjärer och kluriga tänkare. Vardagshjältar och kreativa problemlösare. De som delar djup kunskap och de som utforskar nya områden. Och alla däremellan. Här har du chansen att påverka och bidra på ditt unika sätt. Allt från att utveckla kod och bygga imponerande försvars- och säkerhetslösningar till att ta en kaffe med en kollega. Varje bidrag räknas. Vi ger dig möjlighet att anta utmaningar och skapa smarta innovationer. I vår vänliga och tekniksmarta värld finns plats för dig att växa. Vi finns här för att tillsammans skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här. Vad innebär en spontanansökan? Detta är en öppen ansökan för dig som är nyfiken på vår verksamhet i Karlskoga. Om du vill bli en del av vår framtida resa är du varmt välkommen att skicka in en spontanansökan. Genom att göra det visar du att du är öppen för jobbmöjligheter hos oss – och om vi längre fram får in en roll som stämmer överens med din bakgrund och dina intressen, kan vi komma att kontakta dig. Vi vill dock tydliggöra att en spontanansökan inte är detsamma som att söka en tjänst. För att maximera dina möjligheter uppmanar vi dig att visa oss vad som lockar dig mest, genom att aktivt söka de specifika tjänster som du är intresserad av! Du kan alltid dra tillbaka din spontanansökan genom att logga in på din Workday-profil. Läs mer om dina rättigheter och hur du kontaktar Saabs dataskyddsombud här.

title: Entry level: Mechanical Design Developer

We develop an increasing number of products where every generation delivers improved value to our customers, with high demands on quality and robustness in harsh outdoor environments. At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more. title: FEA Engineer_ Abaqus- Gas Turbines- Combustion
description: Job Description Must be a Swedish National or European origin with valid work permit to work in Sweden and good grasp of Swedish Language Execute complex FEA jobs with minimum supervision within a high performing FEA team. Do hand calculations leveraging a strong foundation in engineering fundamentals. Performing steady state and transient thermal, structural and thermo-mechanical analysis. Understand and define contacts, conducting nonlinear analysis, vibration analysis, buckling analysis, etc. Thorough understanding of high-cycle fatigue (HCF), low-cycle fatigue (LCF), creep, and fracture mechanics. Drive technical solutions and engage in reviews with both internal and external customers. Writing of analysis reports and certification reports. Ensuring timely and high-quality deliveries for complex development projects. Have a solutioning mindset and approach to work. Required Skills and Experience Hands on Experience in performing static/dynamic, transient, linear and non-linear thermal and thermo-mechanical analysis of gas turbine Combustor & Transition Pieces using commercial software Abaqus. Hands on Experience in performing PRE-POST in Abaqus software for static/dynamic, transient, linear and non-linear thermal and thermo-mechanical analysis of gas turbine Combustor & Transition Pieces. Graduate/Post Graduate in Mechanical engineering or equivalent with 4 to 6 years of experience in finite element analysis (FEA) especially in turbomachinery domain. Strong fundamental in Finite element methods and solid mechanics. Experience in product design of turbomachinery i.e., Gas turbine, steam turbine will be preferred. Experience in performing strength assessment as per ASME BPV Sec VIII Code. Experience in Rotor dynamics is an added advantage. Du hast fundierte Erfahrung in Mikrofabrikation und Reinraumarbeit; idealerweise mit Dünnschicht-Prozessierung, Photolithographie, Sputtering, RIE oder nasschemischen Verfahren. Platin, Iridiumoxid, PDMS, Polyimid, Parylene C) und verstehst deren Einfluss auf Signalqualität und Biokompatibilität. Du hast ein unternehmerisches Mindset und denkst in End-to-End Prozessen, mit dem Ziel: Prototypen in eine skalierbare Fertigung zu überführen. Du hast Dein Studium oder Deine Promotion in Neuroengineering, Mikrosystemtechnik, Elektrotechnik, Physik, Biomedical Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen und gehörst zu den Besten Deines Jahrgangs. Du besitzt starken Drive, die Fähigkeit, Dich schnell in neue Aufgabengebiete einzuarbeiten und kannst komplizierte Sachverhalte prägnant kommunizieren. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1). Über uns FUTRUE Neurosciences – An unlimited mind. title: Senior Ceramics Engineer
description: Company Description Nernst Electric is commercialising a groundbreaking electrochemical technology to produce oxygen, with a novel manufacturing process. Our process enables the direct manufacture of complex ceramic electrochemical stacks, dramatically reduce manufacturing costs. We are looking for a Senior Ceramics Engineer to take a leading role in developing, scaling and industrialising our manufacturing processes. You will work across ceramic paste formulation, processing, additive manufacturing, sintering and electrochemical device fabrication , taking materials and processes from laboratory development through to production-scale manufacturing. The role You will be responsible for developing the manufacturing processes underpinning Nernst's next-generation oxygen production technology. This includes: Developing and optimising ceramic paste formulations, including powders, binders, solvents and additives. Developing processes for the fabrication of ceramic reactors by additive manufacturing. Investigating defects, failure modes and variability and developing robust process controls. Working closely with electrochemical engineers to optimise the reactors and production process Scaling laboratory processes towards pilot and commercial manufacturing. Establishing manufacturing specifications, quality-control methods and process windows. Working with external equipment, materials and manufacturing partners where required. Leading technical projects and contributing to Nernst's intellectual property portfolio. About you We are looking for an experienced engineer or scientist with a strong background in ceramics processing and manufacturing . You will ideally have: A degree or PhD in ceramics, materials science, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering or a related discipline Significant hands-on experience with ceramic processing and manufacturing Experience with additive manufacturing of ceramics is highly desirable Experience with multilayer ceramic structures, co-sintering or functional ceramics would be advantageous Experience using materials characterisation techniques and interpreting microstructural and mechanical data A practical, experimental approach to engineering and problem solving The ability to take ownership of technical problems and develop solutions independently Experience with solid oxide fuel cells, solid oxide electrolysers, oxygen transport membranes or other electrochemical ceramics would be particularly valuable, but is not essential. Why join Nernst Electric? This is an opportunity to join a small, highly technical team at an early stage and have a direct impact on the development of a potentially transformative manufacturing technology. You will have significant responsibility and autonomy, working directly with the founding team to develop materials and manufacturing processes that will form the basis of Nernst's commercial products. The role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of ceramics, electrochemistry and advanced manufacturing , with a clear path from fundamental materials development through to commercial-scale production.

title: Ingénieur R&D Thermomécanique H/F
description: Au sein du groupe de recherche Performance Industrielle, vous apporterez votre expertise en modélisation thermomécanique et comportement des matériaux. Vos travaux se concentreront sur la prédiction de durée de vie et l'optimisation de certains composants des installations industrielles. How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW? L’équipe “Materials Integrity” comprend une quinzaine de collaborateurs dont une des missions principales consiste en la réalisation d’expertises métallurgiques et mécaniques afin d’accroître la compréhension des mécanismes de dégradation de matériaux métalliques et/ou céramiques dans des unités aux conditions opératoires sévères (nature du gaz, pression, température, impuretés). L’équipe travaille ainsi à la fois sur des programmes de compréhension long terme et des expertises court terme en lien avec les entités opérationnelles tant sur des matériaux issus de conditions opératoires conventionnelles que des conditions plus innovantes. Analyse et Modélisation Thermomécanique : Analyse de la flexibilité : Étudier les conséquences de la modulation de la demande client (baisse/augmentation de la consommation de gaz) sur la tenue mécanique des équipements, en s'appuyant sur les retours d'expérience récents et les analyses effectuées. Cette flexibilité peut se traduire par une opération dynamique des équipements. Basé sur ces analyses, participer au développement d'outils industriel d'intégrité : Concevoir et développer des modèles et outils industriels pour évaluer l'impact des changements de paramètres opératoires sur la durée de vie des équipements notamment des parties chaudes des installations de type craqueurs NH3 et unités de vaporéformage. Participer au design des unités par la modélisation de l'interaction thermomécanique entre des matériaux de natures différentes (tubes revêtus et milieu granulaire de type catalyseur). In fine, vous devrez déterminer en collaboration avec l’entité Ingénierie du groupe des valeurs de design pour garantir une opération safe, fiable pendant à minima 10 ans. Restituer les résultats aux différents clients internes (Direction Industrielle, E&C) et participer à la capitalisation des connaissances (notes, mémos). Expertise et Support Opérationnel Piloter des expertises pour identifier les causes racines de défaillances thermomécaniques sur sites industriels Restituer les résultats aux différents clients internes (Direction Industrielle, E&C) et participer à la capitalisation des connaissances (notes, mémos). Innovation Proposer des stratégies de prévention pour concevoir les "assets" du futur. Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique d'Air Liquide et participerez à des projets collaboratifs avec des partenaires académiques. Une forte implication dans la création de propriété industrielle est attendue. Vous serez force de proposition pour proposer et défendre de nouveaux sujets de R&D en lien avec les feuilles de route technologique et d'innovation du groupe Air Liquide. Pour cela, vous mettrez à profit de la R&D votre réseau, pour construire des collaborations et échanges avec des partenaires académiques et industriels (participation au montage et / ou au pilotage de projets collaboratifs et / ou internationaux). Une implication dans la gestion de projet pourra vous être demandée. Aussi, dans ce cadre, vous serez le garant de la bonne réalisation des études et projets qui vous seront confiés par la tenue des objectifs qualité/coûts/délais. Vous pilotez les expertises en coopération avec des laboratoires externes, tout en faisant monter en compétences l’équipe. Par votre implication quotidienne, vous participez à l’amélioration continue de l’équipe et à l’appropriation et la retranscription des exigences en matière de qualité et sécurité. Vous serez accompagné-e- pour votre montée en compétences. Votre expérience dans ce poste pourra vous ouvrir des opportunités d'évolution professionnelle vers d'autres métiers du groupe. Are you a MATCH? Vous êtes titulaire d'un Doctorat (PhD) complété par une première expérience industrielle, ou d'un diplôme d'Ingénieur avec 3 à 6 ans d'expérience significative en milieu industriel. Vous possédez une spécialisation en modélisation thermomécanique, et en analyse comportementale des matériaux sous contraintes thermiques (fatigue, fluage, rupture) et du calcul par éléments finis (FEA). Outils : Une excellente maîtrise du logiciel Abaqus est un atout majeur pour être rapidement opérationnel. Une grande agilité sur des logiciels équivalents (ANSYS) couplée à une forte capacité d'apprentissage est également acceptée. La maîtrise de Python pour le développement de modèles est attendue. Savoir-être : Vous faites preuve de pragmatisme industriel. Doté(e) d'un excellent relationnel, vous savez vulgariser des concepts physiques complexes pour convaincre des décideurs techniques. L'anglais professionnel est indispensable. Informations complémentaires : Possibilité d'aménagement individualisé pour des raisons de santé et/ou handicap: discutons en ! Poste basé aux Loges-en-Josas. title: Junior engineer werktuigbouwkunde
description: Toon lef voor een mooiere wereld “"Wil jij jouw technische kennis inzetten voor een onderwerp dat iedereen raakt: water? Schoon water, duurzame energie, CO₂-reductie en klimaatadaptatie komen steeds vaker samen in één vraagstuk. Als junior engineer werktuigbouwkunde krijg je bij ons de ruimte om hierin te leren, mee te denken en samen met ervaren collega’s aan oplossingen te werken die ertoe doen. Je ontwikkelt je technisch én als adviseur, terwijl je bijdraagt aan projecten voor onze klanten en de maatschappij. Ik ben benieuwd welke bijdrage jij wilt leveren. Ik maak graag kennis met j e!" — Jeroen Bakker - teammanager Afvalwater Werken bij Sweco betekent dat je onderdeel wordt van het grootste architecten- en ingenieursnetwerk van Europa. Je hebt de kennis van ruim 24.000 collega's met één druk op de knop binnen handbereik. Binnen de business unit Watertechnologie werk je samen met ongeveer zestig waterprofessionals vanuit De Bilt, Middelburg en Rotterdam. We adviseren en engineeren installaties voor drink-, proces- en afvalwater, oppervlaktewater en infratechniek. Onze opdrachtgevers zijn onder andere drinkwaterbedrijven, waterschappen, gemeenten, provincies, aannemers en industriële partijen. Zo werken we aan drinkwaterinstallaties, rioolwaterzuiveringsinstallaties, gemalen, sluizen, bruggen en industriële waterinstallaties. Daarbij verbinden we water en energie en werken we aan vraagstukken rond energietransitie, assetmanagement en circulaire economie. Juist de combinatie van technische kennis en verschillende disciplines maakt ons interessant: je werkt niet alleen aan elektrotechniek, maar zoekt samen met collega’s naar integrale oplossingen voor de wateropgaven van vandaag en morgen. Daarmee draag je bij aan voorzieningen die voor onze samenleving essentieel zijn. Je kunt bijvoorbeeld bijdragen aan de renovatie van de rioolwaterzuivering in Spijkenisse of de capaciteitsvergroting van de AWZI Almere. Als junior engineer werktuigbouwkunde ondersteun je collega's bij verschillende fasen van een project. Je werkt mee aan ontwerpen en schetsen en leert hoe je programma's van eisen en functionele specificaties opstelt. Ook maak je kennis met technische advisering, begrotingen en planningen. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met ervaren engineers en andere disciplines binnen het projectteam. Naarmate je meer ervaring opdoet, krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van een ontwerp. Je leert jouw technische kennis vertalen naar oplossingen die niet alleen op papier kloppen, maar ook uitvoerbaar zijn. Bij Sweco krijg je de ruimte om jouw ontwikkeling samen met collega’s vorm te geven. Via de Sweco Academy, vak- en kennisgroepen en begeleiding binnen projecten bouw je stap voor stap aan je expertise. Je kunt je verder specialiseren in elektrotechniek, procesautomatisering of watertechnologie en doorgroeien richting bijvoorbeeld medior of senior adviseur elektrotechniek of projectleider. Tegelijkertijd werk je samen met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines en business units, waardoor je een brede blik op projecten ontwikkelt. Digitalisering, data en automatisering spelen daarbij een steeds grotere rol. Je kunt flexibel werken vanuit kantoor, thuis of bij de klant en deelnemen aan vakinhoudelijke sessies en activiteiten die verbinding tussen collega’s stimuleren. Omdat je aan verschillende projecten en met verschillende disciplines werkt, ontdek je gaandeweg welke onderwerpen jou het meest aanspreken. Vanuit daar kun je je verder specialiseren en meer verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Zo ontwikkel je je op een manier die past bij jouw ervaring, interesses en ambities. Reageer dan snel!

title: Ingénieur Développement de Produit Aéronautique - Mécanique & Matériaux
description: TerX est un partenaire stratégique spécialisé dans le conseil en ingénierie et la mise à disposition de compétences techniques pour l'industrie. Né du terrain — des ateliers, laboratoires et bureaux d'études — TerX connecte les meilleures expertises aux enjeux concrets des entreprises industrielles, avec rigueur, méthode et une compréhension fine des réalités opérationnelles. Fondée en 2018, l'entreprise compte aujourd'hui 160 collaborateurs et a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 13,5 millions d'euros en 2025, confirmant sa trajectoire de croissance et la confiance de ses clients industriels. Mission : Mobiliser les meilleures compétences pour répondre aux enjeux concrets des entreprises industrielles. Vision : Contribuer à une industrie française et européenne plus autonome, plus exigeante et créatrice de valeur durable. Le poste : Objectif : Développer et qualifier un produit mécanique critique destiné à un environnement aéronautique exigeant, en intégrant de fortes contraintes matériaux et vibratoires. Missions clés : Concevoir un produit mécanique conforme au cahier des charges aéronautique : architecture, géométrie, choix matériaux, justification. Intégrer les contraintes typiques du secteur : vibrations rotor, fatigue, sollicitations multi-axes, tenue en environnement sévère. Analyser et modéliser le comportement matériau : rigidité, amortissement, fluage, vieillissement, comportement non-linéaire (élastomères notamment). Rédiger les dossiers : notes de justification, rapports de qualification, échanges techniques client. À l'aise avec les problématiques dynamiques aéronautiques : vibrations, fatigue, amortissement (une expérience directe en aéronautique n'est pas indispensable mais est un vrai plus). Connaissances appréciées : élastomères (formation type Élanova / IFoca). Bon communicant, capable d'échanger avec un donneur d'ordre aéronautique ; anglais professionnel requis. Maturité, capacité à gérer des journées terrain et un relationnel client exigeant.

title: PhD position: Multi-scale Modelling and Experimental Assessment of Volumetrically Prestressed Concrete
company: EPFL CED Centre d'Employabilité et de Développement / Employability and Development Center
description: Empa 100% Académique: Doctorant Suisse Description Facebook Twitter LinkedIn Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain. Smart and Sustainable Resilient Performance-based Cementitious Composites for Adaptive Strengthening and Repair System (SURPASS) is an EU Horizon Research and Innovation project (2027-2031) which aims to develop adaptive strengthening and repair strategies for ageing infrastructure in aggressive environments. The project endeavours to develop intervention procedures that can help reduce maintenance costs and increase circularity over the life cycle of a structure. The SURPASS solutions combine eco-efficient UHPFRC containing CO2-negative SCMs, bio-based self-healing, hybrid fiber architecture, Fe-SMA-based self-prestressing, and integrated structural health monitoring into one coherent system for thin, durable structural interventions. It can be deployed through conventional casting for standard applications and through 3D printing for complex or non-planar geometries. In parallel, circular end-of-life strategies will recover fibres, upcycle fines into new low-carbon constituents, and enable structural reuse. The project comprises 11 partners across the globe, including partners from Europe, Canada and Japan PhD position: Multi-scale Modelling and Experimental Assessment of Volumetrically Prestressed Concrete Your tasks The tasks of the PhD at ETHZ and Empa within the framework of SURPASS are as follows: Volumetric prestressing of cast and 3D-printable SURPASS overlays using Fe-SMA fibres. Meso-scale finite element modelling of volumetric prestressing mechanisms with Fe-SMA fibres, including activation, recovery stress, prestress transfer, and reactivation. Structural-scale simulation of SURPASS overlays in strengthened members, including parametric finite element analyses for surrogate-model development and digital-twin support. Large-scale experimental assessment of volumetrically prestressed SURPASS overlays for non-planar structures, including representative applications such as tunnel linings, arch intrados, and curved bridge soffits. Your profile The candidate should have a Master's degree in Structural Engineering (or related engineering) with a strong back-ground in nonlinear finite element modeling, structural mechanics, and concrete structures. Experience or interest in 3D concrete printing is also important. Additional skills, including experience in small and large-scale experimental investigations and knowledge of shape memory alloys, would be an advantage. A strong desire and motivation to find cutting-edge and innovative solutions in the field of structural engineering are essential. Excellent knowledge of English (oral and written) is mandatory. Knowledge of German would be an advantage. Our offer We offer a multifaceted, challenging, and fully funded Ph.D. position for 48 months in a modern research environment with excellent infrastructure supported by regular supervision. The thesis director of the PhD student will be Prof. Dr. Eleni Chatzi, who heads the Chair of Structural Mechanics and Monitoring at ETH Zurich. The candidate will be based at Empa Dübendorf, where the day-to-day research will be supervised by Prof. Dr. Moslem Shahverdi and Dr. Saim Raza. The position is available as soon as possible but should be filled by no later than 1 March 2027. We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered. title: Procurement Engineer (Located in Liberia)
description: About Us Avesoro is a leading gold mining company operating in West Africa, committed to maintaining the highest standards of safety, operational excellence, and sustainable business practices. As part of our commitment to ensuring efficient and cost-effective procurement operations, we are seeking an experienced Procurement Engineer to join our team. Key Responsibilities Plan and manage the procurement of spare parts, maintenance and repair materials, equipment, technical consumables, and service purchases for the light vehicle and heavy equipment fleet. Evaluate requests received from site operations from a technical perspective and determine the correct part numbers, brands, alternatives, dimensions, and quality requirements. Conduct supplier research, develop alternative supplier portfolios, obtain quotations, prepare comparison analyses, and support purchasing decisions based on cost, quality, and delivery performance. Monitor pricing, quality, delivery schedules, warranty conditions, and supply risks for critical spare parts, and identify cost improvement opportunities. Coordinate purchase orders, supplier confirmations, delivery tracking, goods receipt, and invoicing processes with relevant departments. Regularly evaluate supplier performance in terms of cost, quality, delivery, and service levels, and conduct supplier and site visits when required. Follow up on return, warranty, replacement, and quality processes related to non-conforming or defective parts and materials. Maintain purchasing reports, price analyses, supplier records, and contract/quotation archives in an organized and up-to-date manner. Execute procurement activities in compliance with occupational health and safety requirements, quality standards, company procedures, and budget objectives. Perform additional duties assigned by management in a timely and professional manner. Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering is preferred. Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in light vehicles, heavy-duty vehicles, mobile equipment, automotive spare parts, maintenance and service operations, technical procurement, or supply chain management. Hands-on experience in field operations involving vehicles, equipment, workshops, maintenance, repair, or service activities, with the ability to evaluate spare part requirements based on actual operating conditions and failure causes. Familiarity with technical terminology related to engines, drivetrains, undercarriage systems, brakes, suspension systems, hydraulic and pneumatic systems, electrical components, and technical consumables. Ability to evaluate OEM and alternative spare parts, technical specifications, quality standards, brands, warranty conditions, and service life considerations. Experience in supplier sourcing, quotation collection, price comparison, negotiations, supplier evaluation, and procurement reporting. Experience in inventory management, order tracking, goods receipt processes, lead time monitoring, quality compliance verification, and critical spare parts control. Experience coordinating with maintenance teams, service departments, warehouses, accounting teams, and suppliers. Experience conducting supplier and site visits when required to support procurement activities. Ability to analyze procurement risks and support continuous improvement initiatives related to cost and supply reliability. Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of automotive and heavy equipment spare parts, maintenance materials, procurement processes, supplier management, inventory control, cost analysis, technical documentation, and purchasing best practices. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel. Ability to read technical catalogs and interpret part numbers. Language Skills: Excellent command of French and English communication skills Soft Skills : Strong analytical thinking, negotiation, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Detail-oriented, results-driven, and capable of building effective relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers. Additional Requirements: Willingness to travel for supplier and site visits as required. Ability to work in a dynamic operational environment while maintaining compliance with company procedures, quality standards, budget objectives, and occupational health and safety requirements.

title: Mechanical Routing Engineer
description: Vacancy: Mechanical Routing Engineer who is ‘equipped for impact’ Do you want to be part of a globally operating team of innovators? Do you also think bigger than big? And, do you have what it takes to make an impact? Then we might be looking for you. Find out more about our vacancy for a Mechanical Routing Engineer. About Our Organisation We are Huisman. We develop step changing technical solutions and translate these into the design and construction of the largest onshore and offshore installations. For decades, we have been working all over the world for offshore wind, geothermal, oil & gas, leisure and civil industries. With our passionate workforce and worldwide production, service & sales facilities we are equipped for impact in these times of energy transition. “We see our designs come to life in our own production facilities, that makes our work extra special.” Jorg Kerklaan, Mechanical Routing Engineer About The Position Of Mechanical Routing Engineer What to expect of the Mechanical Routing Engineer position within Huisman? As Mechanical Routing Engineer at Huisman you may expect a challenging position in an international organisation. You are part of a dynamic and professional company where innovation, quality, flexibility and creativity are key. You have the opportunity to develop innovative technologies and for instance contribute to exciting renewable projects. The complete design and production are done in-house and we deliver turn-key products to our clients. The delivery can be anywhere in the world. In addition to our inspiring atmosphere, we offer an excellent benefits package tailored to your background and experience. Personal development and education opportunities are part of the deal. And let’s not forget excellent company perks, like regular drinks in our very own bar. What do we expect of you? Responsibilities As a Mechanical Routing Engineer, you are responsible for designing piping systems, cable routes, access and outfitting, as well as the positioning of hydraulic or electrical components including their associated foundations. Your work is multidisciplinary, and no two days are the same. Your responsibilities will include: Designing access and outfitting layouts at system, basic and detailed levels for complex systems; Defining design priorities (interfaces, E-rooms, HPUs) within the layout and routing phase. Decide the level of required detail within a project/design based on project requirements; Impact analysis & system overview over the whole system; Acting pro-actively towards all the stakeholders to come to a cost effective design. Wondering if you are 'equipped for impact'? You Are Analytical with a systematic approach to work; Able to perform effectively under time pressure; Results-driven and customer-focused; Proactive and self-motivated; Up to date with the latest developments in your field of expertise; An excellent communicator; Practical, accurate and punctual. You Have A Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or an MBO Level 4 technicus engineering; Experience as a Mechanical Routing Engineer within the offshore or maritime sector; We are also open to candidates who are willing and motivated to learn this role; Experience in both 2D and 3D CAD design; knowledge of Autodesk AutoCAD and Inventor is an advantage; A strong affinity with, or interest in, complex mechanical systems; The ability to adapt quickly to new requirements and to set the right priorities. Some Practical Things We Need You To Have An EU passport/valid work permit for The Netherlands; A good command of the Dutch and English language verbally and in writing. More About Huisman We design and produce in-house and deliver our turn-key products to clients worldwide. Our clients choose us for our entrepreneurial spirit, skills, reliability, and innovative solutions. Examples? Monopile Gripper. So, if you join Huisman make sure you are equipped for impact. In other words, surprise us, our clients and… yourself! What do we have to offer? An open, informal and no-nonsense culture with short lines of communication. An international working environment with ample opportunities for career progression and personal development. An excellent benefits package tailored to your experience and qualifications. A minimum of 29 holiday days (based on full-time employment) with the option to purchase an additional 10 days. Participation in a collective pension scheme in line with the Wtp. Eligibility for a bonus scheme. Access to collective health insurance, with Huisman contributing as your employer. Take advantage of tax benefits through our bicycle scheme. Huisman organises sporting activities, such as a ski trip, as well as various social events, including large-scale company parties where colleagues come together and get to know each other better. title: Thesis Work – Motion control limited mechanical dimensioning
description: At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world. This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment. This Position Reports To R&D Department/Local Unit Lead Take your next career step at ABB with a global team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each and every one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences. At ABB, you can be sure you are helping to create a better world. Why not take the chance to do this while working in one of the most fascinating technology areas in modern industry – Robotics! ABB Robotics is a leading supplier of industrial robots and robot software, in addition to its equipment, and complete application solutions. We are found in 53 countries and have installed more than 500,000 robots, supported by the broadest service network, and offering in the industry. Now we are offering an exciting master thesis within Mechanical Analysis R&D. Within ABB Robotics R&D, the Mechanical Analysis team configures Manipulators by choosing gears, motors, kinematics and arms and analyzing them with FEM. To do even better we constantly evolve our methods to produce faster, more accurate and better-quality products. All the parts of the manipulator must be dimensioned against the loads occurring during motion and to make the best optimized product we must have control over the input for these calculations. In this project you get the chance to do FEM dimensioning in different ways in our manipulators and get the chance to develop the next step. The goal of this thesis is to help develop and prove new concepts of mechanical dimensioning. With the help of both mechanical analysis team and motion control team we dive deeper into ways to make predictive maintenance easier. The new features might even arrive in next generation of manipulators to provide better and more robust industry robots. Details January-June 2027 30 ECTS/högskolepoäng(hp) One student Most time on site in Västerås Your responsibilities Investigate different partly pre-defined concepts of dimensioning Collaborate with both mechanics and motion team. Set up and perform load calculations on manipulators with rigid body simulations Verify and compare ways of dimensioning Evaluate arms and machine elements with both FEM and analytical formulas Living ABB’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Engineering student in Mechanical engineering, Engineering Physics, Engineering Mechanics, Applied and Computational Mathematics or similar profile. Basic knowledge of mechanics, Finite element method and machine elements Fluent English in speaking and writing, English is the corporate language and used for all documentation. Ability to work independently while collaborating with the team. More About Us Bring your very own sense of pride and purpose as you help us drive forward the Fourth Industrial Revolution – creating a sustainable future for our planet, and your career. Join ABB and harness the power of our diverse global network, as you collaborate with and learn from our world-class teams. Above all, challenge yourself every day. Let’s write the future, together. More information: Supervisor Andréas Göransson, +46724612332, will answer your questions. Recruiting Manger Linda Hjärne, + 46724614641, Union representatives - Sveriges Ingenjörer: Eric Ramsel +46730822030. Positions are filled continuously and start date is January. Apply with your CV, academic transcripts and a cover letter in English Welcome to apply! A Future Opportunity Please note that this position is part of our talent pipeline and not an active job opening at this time. By applying, you express your interest in future career opportunities with ABB. We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about us and see the impact of our work across the globe.

title: Senior / Lead Structural Engineer
description: Bilfinger is een toonaangevende internationale leverancier van industriële diensten die efficiëntie en duurzaamheid voor de procesindustrie stimuleert. Met meer dan 31.000 medewerkers en een omzet van meer dan € 5.4 miljard in 2025 bieden we oplossingen op het gebied van consulting, engineering, productie, onderhoud, turnarounds en digitale toepassingen in belangrijke sectoren zoals energie, chemie, farmacie en olie & gas. Bilfinger België en Nederland levert geïntegreerde industriële diensten, waarbij we klanten ondersteunen gedurende de volledige levenscyclus van hun installaties. Dit doen we van engineering en nieuwbouw tot onderhoud, inspectie en renovatie. Dankzij onze multidisciplinaire aanpak bieden we alles onder één dak, wat kosten, tijd en complexiteit vermindert Bij Bilfinger bieden we een fijne omgeving waar je kunt leren en groeien. Doe mee en maak deel uit van een team dat de toekomst vormgeeft! Structural engineer bij Bilfinger Engineering & Consultancy, wat is dat eigenlijk precies? Er wordt wel eens gezegd dat dit gelijk staat aan constructeur zijn, maar eigenlijk is het veel breder dan dat. Het maken van constructieve berekeningen hoort er zeker bij als onderdeel van je werk. Dat kan zijn een berekening voor een gebouw of een deel van een fabriek, maar het kan ook een klein onderdeel zijn als een machinefundering of een leidingsteun. Bij dit alles kom je wat andere krachten tegen dan bij een gewoon gebouw. Denk hierbij aan belastingen door explosies, dynamische belastingen of stresskrachten uit leidingen. Je bent onderdeel van het team dat constructieve ontwerpen maakt voor nieuwe gebouwen of delen van fabrieken, maar vaak ook aanpassingen in bestaande fabrieken. Samenwerken met collega's blijft belangrijk, en je moet op locatie kijken wat wel of niet past. Dit kan een leuke puzzel zijn, waardoor zelfs kleinere opdrachten uitdagend zijn. Daarnaast ben je ook bezig met: Het aansturen van constructeurs en modelleurs en daarin speel je als Lead Engineer een coachende rol. Je bent er om je team te ondersteunen en te begeleiden, zodat iedereen kan groeien en excelleren. Ben je betrokken bij het project van ideefase tot aan oplevering. Ga je opzoek naar informatie over bestaande constructies. Maak je beschrijvingen van ontwerpen. Waar ga je werken? Als Senior/ Lead Engineer binnen Bilfinger Engineering Eindhoven of Elsloo maak je onderdeel uit van de afdeling ASB (Architectural Structural & Buidlings) dat bestaat uit globaal 25 collega's. Je werkt vanuit jouw vakdiscipline aan projecten die zich afspelen in de volle breedte van de industrie. Vandaag werken we aan een nieuwe chemische installatie en morgen weer aan een kantoorgebouw. Afwisseling genoeg dus. Wat heb jij te bieden? Als krachtige gesprekspartner en relatiebouwer win je moeiteloos vertrouwen. Je speelt in op veranderingen zonder kwaliteit te verliezen. Met jouw kennis van streng gereguleerde omgevingen vorm je cruciale besluitvormingsprocessen. Als teamspeler neem je iedereen mee in jouw visie. Je straalt passie uit en inspireert anderen om hetzelfde te doen. Ook ben je de persoon met: Een afgeronde technische HBO- en/of WO opleiding richting Bouwkunde, Civiele Techniek of aanverwant; Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met multidisciplinaire technische projecten; Meerdere kwaliteiten zoals enthousiasme, passie, samenwerken en sparringpartner. Wat bieden we jou? Naast een mooi salaris en een mooi secundair arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket: Een passend thuiswerkbeleid met de mogelijkheid om je werkweek flexibel in te richten. Een organisatie en team waar je jezelf kan zijn en we naar elkaars kwaliteiten kijken. Jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat bij ons voorop via het Personal Empowerment Plan. Samen met je manager stel je een persoonlijk ontwikkelingsplan op en krijg je coaching en begeleiding om te groeien binnen of buiten je vakgebied. Door opleidingen en trainingen kun je je zowel persoonlijk als vakinhoudelijk ontwikkelen. Binnen het plan kun je ook je beroepservaringsperiode volgen. Gezond leven: Vitaliteitsprogramma, fietsregeling en fitnessregeling. Tijdelijke acties zoals gratis sportkleding en deelname aan de Ommetje app. Actieve personeelsvereniging: Leuke en inspirerende activiteiten naast het werk. Voor vragen kunt u contact opnemen met Annemarie Rossingh via annemarie.rossingh@bilfinger.com . Wij verwelkomen sollicitaties van alle gekwalificeerde personen, ongeacht geslacht, leeftijd, handicap, etnische afkomst, religie of levensbeschouwing, seksuele identiteit of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken. Gebruik voor uw sollicitatie uitsluitend de knop “Nu solliciteren”.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Job Description: Airbus Netherlands B.V. is looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join our Design & Analysis Engineering Team based in Leiden, The Netherlands. Airbus Netherlands makes a vital contribution to the international Space industry in the current operational areas of Solar Arrays, Launcher Structures, and Laser Satellite Communication. In these areas we belong to the world top and seek to achieve the same level with future products and services. Airbus Netherlands designs and builds structures for European launchers serving the commercial and institutional satellite markets. These structures must be lightweight but still capable of carrying the heavy and complex set of applied loads. The combination of our long heritage and continually expanding expertise have equipped us with the capability to meet the ever-developing demands in this field. You will be part of the team that supports the mechanical analysis and verification of our complex structures for the Ariane 6 launcher. Based on Finite Element modeling, the full set of technical requirements of our customer must be satisfied. This is conducted in close collaboration with the Lead and Systems Engineers, our Thermal Engineering team, the Design Office, the Material & Process department, our Assembly & Integration Team as well, of course, fellow mechanical engineers. Meet the team: Our Engineers have the privilege of working on complex products at the forefront of aerospace technology. We welcome those who are interested in joining our team effort to shape the present and future of Airbus Netherlands products. Your challenges: Understand and design lightweight metallic structures, subjected to complex mechanical loading. Finite element modeling and analysis of Airbus Netherlands B.V. Space products, in particular lightweight structures of the Ariane 6 launcher. This shall be performed with FEMAP and NASTRAN. Model and analyze the performance of structural components and assemblies which are optimized in terms of mass, cost and production / assembly requirements while highest safety of the Product is assured using appropriate Design tools. Define, perform and report tests to qualify structures, subcomponents or processes. Liaise with the Design Office, manufacturing engineers and Assembly, Testing and Integration team, and other appropriate Airbus departments to come up with optimum design solutions. The Team: The Intrinsic Reliability ( i Rel) Group is responsible for ensuring Product/Process Lifetime Robustness. This is achieved by investigating the intrinsic reliability of semiconductor devices/circuits and sensors. The i Rel Group is made up of a range of engineering disciplines including electronics, physics and mathematics. The group is split across two locations namely, ADLK (Limerick, Ireland) and ADSV (San Jose, CA). The successful candidate will reside in ADLK. Main responsibilities: Drive GaN intrinsic reliability strategy across 100V–650V technologies, ensuring alignment with product roadmaps. Define and execute reliability qualification methodologies, including HTGB, HTRB, switching, and transient stress testing. Lead physics-of-failure (PoF) investigations, identifying degradation mechanisms and driving root-cause resolution. title: Process Development & Integration Engineer
description: Back to Careers Process Development & Integration Engineer We are seeking a Process Development & Integration Engineer to build the manufacturing route for our advanced superconducting interconnects, from first concept to working prototype assemblies. Reporting to our Chief of Engineering, you will work hands-on with specialist providers in flip-chip bonding, bumping, and packaging to establish a reliable prototype process. You will also help us select, install, and operate the in-house equipment that brings this capability home. As the link between our external partners and our quantum, radiofrequency, and mechanical engineers, you will turn system requirements into a practical, fast-moving development plan. About Isentroniq At Isentroniq, we are building the future of computing, not in theory, but in hardware. We enable quantum computing at scale by developing superconducting circuit solutions that increase qubit count by more than 100x at fixed cost and infrastructure size. We share knowledge openly, challenge ideas constructively, and stay focused on what matters. Our values (gritty ambition with humility, radical candor, surgical audacity, and self-accountable teamwork) are at the core of how we work and grow. If you’re passionate about transformative innovation and ready to build the interconnects that make quantum computing at scale possible, join us. Key Responsibilities Define the process and its roadmap. Develop practical process flows, work instructions, and acceptance criteria for prototype builds. Shape a scalable process roadmap as the technology moves from early prototypes toward production-intent hardware. Build the prototype manufacturing route. Work with external partners to develop a rapid path to prototype assemblies, coordinating process trials for cryo-compatible bump bonding with superconducting metal, flip-chip bonding, substrate handling, and related assembly steps. Build productive technical relationships with suppliers, and make sure process learning is captured and retained in-house. Bring process capability in-house. Define requirements for the bonding, metrology and inspection equipment we bring in-house. Support its selection, purchase, commissioning and day-to-day operation. Review prototype results and drive improvements. Assess prototype builds with partners and internal teams, and support inspection, testing and failure analysis where required. Identify issues, resolve them quickly and refine the process with each build. Integrate across engineering teams. Work closely with our quantum, RF and mechanical engineers so that every assembly meets system requirements. Who you are We’re looking for a hands-on process engineer who knows how advanced packaging really gets done: in the cleanroom, at the supplier’s facility, and on the bonder. You have taken assemblies from requirements to working hardware through external partners, and you know how to keep a programme moving when a process misbehaves. You are comfortable with the ambiguity of deep tech and the pace of an early-stage prototype programme, where progress comes through iteration. Key Qualifications Background in advanced packaging or assembly. PhD or relevant Master's degree, with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in semiconductor packaging, microelectronics assembly, MEMS packaging, photonics assembly, or a related field. Hands-on process knowledge in one or more of: flip-chip bonding, solder bumping, die attach, wafer-level processing, or precision alignment. Experience working with external partners. You have run process work with fabrication, bumping, bonding or packaging vendors. Process equipment experience. You have used or specified equipment such as flip-chip bonders, optical inspection tools, profilometers or X-ray systems. Comfortable working hands-on in a lab, cleanroom or supplier facility. Strong communication skills to work effectively across internal engineering teams and external partners. Communication proficiency in English Bonus Experience with Cryo-compatible superconducting interconnects or low-temperature / cryogenic hardware. Familiarity with superconducting, radiofrequency, microwave or quantum-device packaging. Experience setting up a new process line, laboratory capability or equipment suite. Experience with compliant substrates, flex circuits, thin substrates or fragile MEMS devices. Knowledge of process qualification, metrology or failure analysis. Proficiency in French Personal Attributes You are a builder. You are hands-on and not afraid to make things from scratch: process flows, equipment setups, supplier relationships. You are pragmatic. You balance technical quality with the urgency of an early-stage programme. You deliver working prototypes first, rather than chasing perfection on the first attempt. You embody an engineer’s mindset, with meticulous attention to detail, a systematic approach to solving process issues, and a drive for continuous process improvement. You are autonomous and organized, and enjoy driving a development plan across several partners at once. You embody radical candor. You surface problems early, with partners and internally. You welcome having your ideas challenged, and speak openly about both achievements and mistakes. You thrive in an environment of high expectations, turning uncertainty into structured action. What We Offer A unique opportunity to build the process capability of a cutting-edge quantum hardware start-up, from first prototypes to production-intent hardware. The chance to shape Isentroniq’s interconnect manufacturing route and in-house equipment from the ground up. A collaborative, mission-driven culture with a focus on personal and professional growth. Competitive salary and equity package. Job Type Permanent position Location St-Germain-en-Laye (FR) Start Date Now Apply now

title: Design Engineer Praktikum - CAD-Konstruktion und Additive Fertigung
description: Wir sind ELOPRINT – ein spezialisiertes Ingenieurbüro für Konstruktion und 3D-Druck von Prüfadaptern für Platinen und elektronische Baugruppen. Bei uns ist fast jedes Projekt ein Unikat: Wir entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Lösungen direkt für unsere Kunden. Zur Verstärkung suchen wir Praktikant:innen (m/w/d) , die Lust haben, hands-on an echten Projekten mitzuarbeiten – von der Idee über die Konstruktion bis zum fertigen Bauteil. Du bringst eigene Vorschläge ein, setzt sie um und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung. Du möchtest Praxiserfahrung im Engineering sammeln und sehen, wie aus Anforderungen funktionierende Hardware wird? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Aufgaben CAD-Konstruktion: Testadapter und Vorrichtungen in CAD entwickeln – passend zu Kundenanforderungen. Prototyping & Fertigung: Bauteile per 3D-Druck und CNC herstellen, Drucke und Fräsjobs einrichten/optimieren und Bedienung der Maschinen. Montage & Verdrahtung: Prüfadapter zusammenbauen, Komponenten integrieren und verdrahten. Testen & Iterieren: Passform/Funktion prüfen, Verbesserungen ableiten und Konstruktionen anpassen. Mitarbeit im Tagesgeschäft: Dokumentation, Ordnung/Materialfluss, kleinere technische Aufgaben – die Tage sind abwechslungsreich. Qualifikation Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in (m/w/d) in Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik oder vergleichbar. CAD-Grundkenntnisse sind vorhanden (Autodesk Fusion ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss). Hands-on-Mentalität: Du arbeitest sorgfältig, strukturiert und übernimmst gern Verantwortung. Interesse an Fertigung/Prototyping: 3D-Druck, Mechanik und idealerweise ein Grundverständnis für Elektronik/Verkabelung. Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse für die Abstimmung im Team und mit Kunden. Benefits Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Fokus auf Ergebnisse, Zeiten nach Absprache (z. B. rund um Vorlesungen/Prüfungen). Echte Praxis & Verantwortung: Mitarbeit an realen Kundenprojekten – von CAD bis fertigem Adapter. Schnelle Lernkurve & kurze Wege: Direkter Austausch, schnelle Entscheidungen, unmittelbares Feedback. Urlaub & faire Rahmenbedingungen: Urlaubsanspruch auch im Praktikum (Details je nach Dauer/Modell). Moderne Infrastruktur: Maschinen/Werkzeuge nutzen – nach Absprache auch für private Projekte. title: Engineer Shipbuilding
description: Your Work Context At Jan De Nul Group, we are on the lookout for new talent! We thank our position as a global player to the know-how and innovative ideas of our employees. To stay top of mind, we continuously invest in our fleet. Our Technical Department follows up the construction of new ships from the preliminary design stage. On the other hand, it is responsible for the maintenance and equipment of existing ships. Every maritime project is different and each time the optimal configuration is put together. And if it doesn't exist, we make it ourselves! Your Role As Technical Superintendent Vessel Construction , you will collaborate on the preliminary design, specifications for and follow-up of construction or conversion of a vessel or other large offshore or dredging equipment. Your main duties and responsibilities: Studying and collaborating on the specifications, construction plans and all relevant documents regarding the construction; Help follow up, adjust and approve the design work and technical purchases, both from the shipyard and internally; Help support the design, construction and/or purchase of specific dredging and offshore equipment supplied to the shipyard, or manufactured by JDN; Help follow up the construction and construction supervision and ensure coordination with the shipyard of work and deliveries by JDN; Helping to monitor the testing programme and commissioning of the newly built ship; Helping to equip a ship with the necessary tools and spare parts; For some (sub)projects, these activities are carried out independently and under your own responsibility. You will work from the office in Aalst. Occasionally you will travel abroad to monitor and inspect the work on site. What do you need? You hold a Master's degree in Mechanical/Electromechanical Engineering option Maritime Engineering. You have just graduated or possess a first work experience. You have a thorough basic technical knowledge and a passion for engineering. You have an analytical mind to design, assess and improve systems. You are an organiser and can work efficiently independently. You have strong communication skills and can express yourself fluently in both Dutch and English. Working at Jan De Nul Working at Jan De Nul means contributing to solutions to some of the biggest challenges of our time: from the energy transition to rising sea levels to smart mobility. It means learning and working together every day to preserve the global quality of life for generations to come. What We Offer A permanent training path via our JDN Academy The opportunity to practice sports at work via our FIT programme An open-ended permanent contract Competitive wages with thirteenth month and double holiday pay When you work in Belgium: Meal vouchers and eco-vouchers Possibility to take part in the Flex Reward programme, including bike and car leasing, including fuel card or charge pass in Belgium Employer’s contribution in public transport and bicycle expenses Group and hospital care insurance Optional iPhone with subscription Miscellaneous staff discounts T he world is what you make it Jan De Nul Group shapes water and land around the world, addressing some of the most important challenges of our time. We boost the energy transition with infrastructure for renewable offshore energy. We focus on nature-inclusive dredging solutions to build harbours and protect our coastlines from the rising sea. We develop innovative construction projects for smart mobility and durable buildings. And we invest in planet redevelopment, giving new purpose to polluted sites. At Jan De Nul, the world is what you make it. Jan De Nul Group promotes diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We are an equal opportunities and anti-discrimination employer. title: Propulsion AIT Engineer
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. We want you as a highly talented Propulsion AIT Engineer to help us in our mission by leading Assembly, Integration and Test activities on Huracan, our cryogenic engine. This is a hands-on role at the interface between engineering, manufacturing, quality, and test operations. You will help turn propulsion designs into flight-relevant hardware by supporting the build-up and verification of thrust chamber assemblies and complete engines. Key Responsibilities In your capacity as a Propulsion AIT Engineer , your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include: Lead the assembly and acceptance testing of Huracan subcomponents, in particular the thrust chamber assembly Participate in full engine builds, integrating the thrust chamber assembly with the engine structure, fluid components, valves, instrumentation, pumps, piping, and other propulsion subsystems. Develop detailed assembly procedures, work instructions and manufacturing documentation Define tooling, fixtures and ground support equipment required for engine assembly Ensure assemblies comply with cleanliness, contamination control and configuration management requirements Perform leak checks, pressure testing, functional checks, instrumentation checks, and other verification or acceptance activities under approved procedures and relevant safety controls Support hot-firing test campaign preparation, including hardware readiness reviews, tooling and equipment checks, procedure walk-downs, and test article closeout Record build data, inspection results, non-conformities, deviations, rework, and as-built information in the ERP system Help investigate assembly or integration issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions in collaboration with engineering and quality teams Contribute to the continuous improvement of assembly processes, work instructions, tooling, ergonomics, and production readiness Qualifications Young graduate in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or another related field (master's and above preferred), preferably with rocketry experience or individual projects What We Would Love To See From You Experience assembling or integrating mechanical systems in a laboratory, workshop, production, or test environment, ideally related to propulsion, pressure systems, fluidic assemblies, or complex hardware Familiarity with CAD, PLM, ERP, manufacturing execution, or technical documentation systems Understanding with torque-controlled assembly, cleanliness practices, FOD prevention, leak testing, pressure testing, or dimensional inspection Understanding of configuration management, non-conformance management, root-cause analysis, and quality documentation Exposure to manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, additive manufacturing, surface treatments, inspections) and their impact on tolerances and performance is highly valued Rigor and attention to detail are core values in everything we do: you take the time to understand requirements, follow procedures precisely, check your work, and maintain accurate records. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, taking ownership of getting the hardware ready Fluency in English, both written and verbal Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and communicating clearly about hardware status, risks, and constraints A passion for space exploration and the motivation to see propulsion hardware move from drawings to tested engines Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable. All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible. If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

In dieser vielseitigen Position bist Du maßgeblich an der Entwicklung und Konstruktion hochpräziser Baugruppen und Systeme beteiligt. Du begleitest den gesamten Entstehungsprozess von der ersten 3D-Konstruktion über die Zeichnungsableitung bis hin zur fertigen Kundendokumentation und arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zu internen Fachabteilungen sowie externen Partnern. Aufgaben eigenverantwortliche 3D-Konstruktion von Einzelteilen, Baugruppen und Systemen unter Berücksichtigung von branchenspezifischen Regelwerken und Normen (u. a. im Bahnbereich) präzise Definition und rechnerische Auslegung von Schraubenverbindungen sowie fachliche Begleitung externer FEM-Berechnungen qualitätsbewusste Überprüfung und Bewertung extern sowie intern gefertigter Baugruppen fachgerechte Erstellung und Ableitung technischer 2D-Zeichnungen von Einzelteilen, Baugruppen und Gesamtsystemen aktive Zuarbeit und Erstellung von Fertigungs- und Angebotsunterlagen sowie der vollständigen Kundendokumentation strukturierte Beschaffung und Bewertung technischer Informationen an den Schnittstellen zu internen Abteilungen (z. B. Bildverarbeitung und Messtechnik) sowie zu externen Lieferanten Erstellung von Stücklisten sowie zuverlässiges Dokumentenmanagement und Zeichnungsverwaltung Profil erfolgreich abgeschlossenes technisches Studium oder Ausbildung (z. B. Technischer Produktdesigner, Technischer Zeichner, Techniker Maschinentechnik) sichere CAD-Kenntnisse (bevorzugt Autodesk Inventor und Vault) sowie routinierter Umgang mit MS Office erste Berufserfahrung in der mechanischen Konstruktion (auch ambitionierte Berufseinsteiger willkommen) fundiertes Wissen über Maschinenbau-Normen; Vorkenntnisse im Bahn- oder Metallbereich von Vorteil sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift ausgeprägtes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen, Kommunikationsstärke und eine selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise Was Dich erwartet flexible Arbeitszeit Teamevents 30 Tage Urlaub weitere Zuschüsse & Benefits Weiterbildungsangebote Wir freuen uns über Deine Online-Bewerbung. Pensum verbindet Unternehmen mit den passenden Menschen – flexibel, zuverlässig und individuell. Mit Erfahrung und einem starken Netzwerk entstehen berufliche Chancen, die wirklich passen. Eine partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und faire Bedingungen stehen dabei immer im Mittelpunkt. #Konstruktion #Maschinenbau #Technischer Produktdesigner #Maschinentechnik #Autodesk Inventor

title: | PROGETTISTA MECCANICO | 109679 |
description: Panoramica di Presentazione Importante realtà industriale operante nella progettazione e produzione di macchinari di automazione custom. L'azienda sviluppa soluzioni tecnologicamente avanzate, seguendo l'intero ciclo di sviluppo del prodotto, dalla progettazione all'industrializzazione, con un forte orientamento all'innovazione, alla qualità e al miglioramento continuo. Grazie a un'organizzazione strutturata e a un team multidisciplinare, rappresenta un punto di riferimento nel proprio settore. Job Title e finalità di Ruolo: PROGETTISTA MECCANICO La risorsa sarà inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Tecnico e si occuperà della progettazione e dello sviluppo di prodotti e del miglioramento di quelli esistenti. Sarà responsabile della definizione delle specifiche tecniche e dell'architettura del sistema, della progettazione meccanica tramite software CAD 3D, garantendo il rispetto degli obiettivi di qualità, tempi e costi. Principali Valori Aziendali • Innovazione tecnologica. • Qualità e affidabilità del prodotto. • Orientamento al miglioramento continuo. Principali Responsabilità • Definizione delle specifiche tecniche e dell'architettura di sistema sulla base dei requisiti di progetto. • Progettazione di assiemi e componenti meccanici mediante CAD 3D. • Collaborazione con il team di progettazione composto da progettisti, designer e collaboratori esterni, e con le diverse unit aziendali coinvolte nella commessa. • Collaborazione al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di tempi, costi e qualità di progetto. • Supporto alla gestione, revisione e organizzazione delle distinte base e della documentazione tecnica di prodotto. • Supporto alle attività di problem solving e analisi delle problematiche di prodotto in collaborazione con Assistenza Tecnica e Controllo Qualità. • Partecipazione alle attività di sviluppo di nuovi prodotti e miglioramento dei prodotti esistenti. • Supporto alle attività di prototipazione e validazione tecnica delle soluzioni progettuali. Competenze Tecniche (Hard Skills) • Preferibile Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica o cultura tecnica equivalente. • Ottima conoscenza della progettazione meccanica, del disegno tecnico e dei sistemi di tolleranza. • Conoscenza dell'analisi strutturale, cinematica e dinamica. • Buona conoscenza della tecnologia dei materiali metallici, trattamenti termici e superficiali, processi di saldatura e costruzione di macchine. • Conoscenze di meccanica, metrologia e misure meccaniche. • Conoscenza delle direttive europee e delle normative tecniche internazionali. • Capacità di gestione della distinta base e della struttura di prodotto. • Esperienza nell'utilizzo di strumenti FEM e software di simulazione. • Conoscenza dei processi di sviluppo prodotto. • Buona conoscenza di CAD 2D e 3D, pacchetto office, preferibile SAP. Abilità Personali (Soft Skills): • Problem solving. • Precisione e attenzione ai dettagli. • Orientamento agli obiettivi. • Attitudine al lavoro in team. • Proattività e orientamento al miglioramento continuo. Condizioni di contratto Sede di lavoro: Provincia di Verona, zona sud. Orario di lavoro e work life balance: Full time, dal lunedì al venerdì. Tipologia contrattuale: Inserimento diretto in azienda. Pacchetto retributivo a budget: L'inquadramento economico sarà definito in funzione dell'esperienza e delle competenze maturate dal candidato. RAL indicativa compresa tra € 32.000 e € 40.000 per i profili junior-middle, € 40.000 – € 50.000 per profili senior. Mensa aziendale interna, welfare, premialità. Si invitano i candidati di entrambi i sessi (L.903/77) a prendere visione dell'informativa sulla privacy https://etjca.it/informativa-per-candidati (art. 13 e 14, Reg. UE 679/2016) pubblicata sul sito www.etjca.it. Etjca S.p.A. (Aut. Min. Prot. N. 1309-SG del 23/02/2005). L'offerta di lavoro è rivolta a tutti i candidati, senza distinzione di genere, ai sensi del D.Lgs. 198/2006 e s.m.i., e indipendentemente da età, etnia, credo religioso o orientamento sessuale, ai sensi dei D.Lgs. 215/2003 e 216/2003. Il servizio è gratuito.

title: Progettista - Project Tool Engineer (Junior) - Settore Aerospace & Defence
description: Descrizione azienda +25 anni di esperienza. +1.400 persone. La nostra specialità è dare valore all’informazione di prodotto. In STAR7 affianchiamo aziende internazionali lungo tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall’ingegneria al post-vendita, integrando competenze tecniche, contenuti, tecnologie e servizi linguistici. Lavoriamo al fianco di clienti in settori industriali complessi, trasformando la conoscenza di prodotto in soluzioni concrete, accessibili e utili per ogni fase del business. Entrare in STAR7 significa far parte di un contesto internazionale, multidisciplinare e in continua evoluzione, dove competenze diverse si fondono per creare valore attorno al prodotto. Stiamo cercando un/una: Posizione Progettista - Project Tool Engineer (Junior) - Settore Aerospace & Defence Lavorerai presso la sede cliente di Cascina Costa - (Samarate) - (VA) e sarai inserito nel nostro team tecnico dedicato un importante cliente operante nel settore Aerospace & Defence. Supporterai nella definizione dei requisiti tecnici per lo sviluppo di attrezzature dedicate alla manutenzione e alla produzione. Supporterai nel coordinamento tecnico delle attività di progettazione affidate a fornitori esterni, garantendo che le soluzioni sviluppate siano conformi alle esigenze operative e agli standard aziendali. Le tue attività principali saranno: Definizione dei requisiti tecnici per attrezzature di manutenzione e produzione Traduzione di esigenze operative in specifiche di progettazione Coordinamento tecnico dei fornitori esterni incaricati della progettazione di dettaglio Identificazione della configurazione elicottero tramite CATIA e predisposizione dei dati tecnici necessari allo sviluppo Verifica della conformità delle soluzioni progettuali rispetto ai requisiti e agli standard aziendali Supporto alle attività di validazione tecnica e industrializzazione. Requisiti Sei la persona giusta se possiedi i seguenti requisiti: Risulti in possesso di Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, o affini Hai buona padronanza di Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint e Access), Detieni una buona Conoscenza di SAP Risulti in possesso di capacità di coordinamento (nella fattispecie disegnatori e fornitori esterni). Sarà considerato un plus aver maturato esperienza (anche breve) in ambito progettazione all’interno di un ufficio tecnico nello sviluppo di attrezzature per la manutenzione e/o la produzione e avere padronanza di Cadam/CATIA. Completano il profilo ideale: Mentalità organizzata e analitica, Capacità di problem solving, Abilità nella gestione delle priorità e dei compiti assegnati. Attitudine al lavoro di squadra e buone capacità comunicative, di ascolto e relazionali Altre informazioni Cosa troverai in STAR7 Un contesto in forte crescita con un ambiente di lavoro giovane improntato allo sviluppo Un contesto altamente qualificato e stimolante Piano di welfare annuale e convenzioni aziendali Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa Meal ticket - Mensa Sarai assunto con contratto commisurato all'esperienza, con una Retribuzione annua lorda compresa tra €27.000 e €33.000, commisurata all’esperienza e alle competenze, CCNL Commercio terziario distribuzione e servizi. Se l’opportunità ti interessa e vuoi approfondirla, inviaci il tuo CV completo di autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati ex art. 13 GDPR.

title: Ingegnere Progettista Meccanico
description: Per potenziare la propria struttura, società di ingegneria di Roma incentrata sulla fornitura di consulenze a organizzazioni governative e militari, coprendo tutte le fasi di progetto, dallo studio di fattibilità al collaudo di accettazione, è alla ricerca di un INGEGNERE ENERGETICO O MECCANICO con esperienza nella progettazione di impianti meccanici e termotecnici, maturata presso studi di progettazione. Requisiti: Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Energetica o Meccanica con ottimo curriculum studiorum; Almeno 1-2 anni di esperienza in attività di progettazione impiantistica, preferibilmente presso studi di ingegneria o società di progettazione; Esperienza nella progettazione e dimensionamento di impianti meccanici, dalla fase preliminare fino alla progettazione esecutiva; Capacità di lavorare autonomamente nella redazione di elaborati grafici, relazioni tecniche e calcoli di dimensionamento; Software CAD e BIM: Utilizzo di AutoCAD (2D/3D) e, sempre più frequentemente, di Revit o altri software (Edilclima, Primus) per la progettazione integrata; Normativa tecnica: Conoscenza delle linee guida nazionali ed europee sull'efficienza e sulla certificazione energetica; Candidato di seria moralità, responsabile, di assoluta fiducia, con spiccate attitudini al lavoro in team e capacità di relazionarsi con i terzi; Massima flessibilità e disponibilità; Capacità di lavorare per obiettivi, sotto stress ed in tempi ridotti, assertività e proattività; Senso pratico, apertura all’innovazione e creatività; Massima disponibilità a trasferte sul territorio nazionale/estero; Inglese buono. Mansioni Principali: Il ruolo unisce attività analitiche sul campo e lavoro tecnico alla scrivania utilizzando software dedicati Progettazione impianti HVAC: Dimensionamento di sistemi di riscaldamento, ventilazione e condizionamento dell'aria. Energie rinnovabili: Sviluppo di schemi tecnici per impianti fotovoltaici, solari termici, pompe di calore e biomasse. Pratiche edilizie ed energetiche: Redazione di Attestati di Prestazione Energetica (APE) e relazioni tecniche ex Legge 10. Modellazione energetica: Calcolo delle prestazioni termiche dell'involucro degli edifici per ridurne i consumi. Verifica conformità: Controllo del rispetto delle normative vigenti in materia di sicurezza ed efficienza energetica. Seguire lo sviluppo tecnico ed implementazione, interfacciandosi secondo necessità e richieste con fornitori, clienti ed interlocutori interni all’Azienda; Gestire la documentazione tecnica; Altre attività definite dal management. Sede di lavoro: Roma, Gregorio VIII Inquadramento e retribuzione indicativi: contratto di lavoro subordinato a tempo indeterminato, full-time, con adeguato periodo di prova; retribuzione da concordare in base alle capacità ed alle esperienze effettivamente maturate. Si tratta di una boutique di ingegneria snella (circa 10-24 dipendenti), il che garantisce un'esposizione diretta a progetti di altissimo livello e una crescita rapida rispetto alle grandi multinazionali. È possibile candidarsi immediatamente alla posizione RIF IEP inviando il proprio curriculum vitae a consulting@clementinasaturno.com La selezione rispetta il principio delle pari opportunità (L. 903/77). Aut. Min. 1314 RS.
