title: Structural Engineer
description: Job Description At Boylan Consulting, we are seeking a Structural Engineer to join our multidisciplinary engineering and environmental consultancy team. This is a varied technical and client-facing role supporting structural engineering projects from concept and detailed design through technical coordination and completion. The successful candidate will work across residential, commercial, industrial and modular projects, providing practical and technically robust solutions. We are looking for a professional with 4-6 years of relevant experience, including experience within the Irish engineering and construction industry. The candidate should be able to work independently, manage projects and deadlines, coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, and communicate confidently with clients and contractors. Experience in modular construction or Modern Methods of Construction (MMC) is desirable. At Boylan Consulting, we offer: 1) Continuing Professional Development 2) Competitive salary 3) A friendly working environment About the available position: • Location: Unit 33, Kells Business Park, Kells, Co. Meath, A82 Y466 • Salary: Negotiable • Education: Structural Engineering degree • Experience: 4-6 years • Work Arrangement: Primarily Office-based position Key Responsibilities & Duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for a range of technical and project activities, including: • Undertaking structural design for residential, commercial, industrial and modular projects. • Preparing structural calculations, drawings, specifications and technical reports. • Designing steel, reinforced concrete, timber and masonry structures. • Coordinating structural information with architects, civil engineers, fire consultants, building-services consultants, manufacturers and contractors. • Supporting modular construction and MMC projects, including structural interfaces, connections, foundations and compliance requirements. • Attending office-based client, design-team and coordination meetings, including online meetings where appropriate. • Responding to construction-stage queries and providing technical support through project completion. • Managing assigned programmes, deliverables and client requirements. • Reviewing drawings and calculations prepared by junior engineers and technicians. Essential Requirements: • 4-6 years of structural engineering experience, including relevant Irish industry experience. • Experience designing steel, reinforced concrete, timber and masonry structures. • Ability to prepare and review structural calculations, drawings, specifications and reports. • Working knowledge of Irish Building Regulations, Eurocodes and relevant engineering standards. • Experience using Tekla Structural Designer, TEDDS or similar structural analysis and design software. • Experience using AutoCAD and familiarity with Revit. • Strong technical judgement, communication and problem-solving skills. • Ability to manage multiple projects and work independently within a multidisciplinary team. Desirable Skills / Attributes: • Experience in modular construction, off-site construction or MMC. • Experience with BIM and Revit coordination. • Knowledge of structural connections, foundation interfaces and transportation or lifting considerations for modular units. • Progress toward Chartered Engineer status with Engineers Ireland or another recognised professional body. • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage office-based design and coordination activities.

description: Rejoignez l’aventure ArianeGroup et participez à la conquête de l’innovation spatiale ! Nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Composants Turbomachines pour rejoindre notre service Mechanical Design Turbomachinery, au sein du département Turbomachines de la Direction Technique Propulsion Liquide. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la conception, l'analyse et la validation des systèmes de sustentation de la ligne d’arbre pour nos turbomachines, en assurant performance et fiabilité. Votre environnement de travail Vous évoluerez dans un environnement technique de haut niveau, au cœur des turbomachines utilisées sur les moteurs du lanceur 6, sur les projets innovants comme Prometheus, ainsi que dans des applications à hydrogène pour la mobilité lourde. Vos missions Concevoir et développer des roulements pour turbomachines, en tenant compte des spécifications de performance, de durée de vie et d'environnement. Réaliser des analyses mécaniques, thermiques et vibratoires des systèmes de roulements à l'aide de logiciels de simulation avancés. Définir et superviser les essais de qualification des roulements. Assurer le support technique aux équipes de production et d'assemblage concernant l'intégration des roulements. Participer à la résolution des problèmes techniques et à l'analyse des défaillances. Collaborer avec les fournisseurs pour la sélection et l'optimisation des technologies de roulements. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus de conception et de validation. Rédiger la documentation technique associée (spécifications, rapports d'analyse, plans de validation). title: Principal Engineer – Large Fabrications
description: Job Description Summary As the Principal Engineer – Large Fabrications, you will provide technical leadership and engineering rigor for the design, analysis, and validation of large fabricated and composite structures used in wind turbine nacelles and related assemblies. This role is focused on sheet-metal based structural components and requires deep expertise in structural integrity, dynamics, fatigue, fracture mechanics, strength assessment, and design for manufacturability. You will be responsible for driving robust engineering decisions through design reviews, drawing reviews, stack-up assessments, analytical calculations, and correlation of test and simulation results. You will also support review of certification activities, engage with external agencies as needed, and help strengthen technical capability across the organization, especially in dynamics. This is a leadership role for an experienced engineer who can challenge assumptions, develop new methods, and partner with CTHs, design teams, suppliers, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver safe, high-quality, and compliant products. Job Description Essential Responsibilities Lead the design, analysis, validation, and technical direction of large fabricated and composite structures for wind turbine nacelles. Drive robust engineering solutions for sheet-metal and composite structures, ensuring safety, quality, manufacturability, and compliance. Chair design reviews, perform detailed drawing and tolerance analyses, and ensure sound technical decisions throughout the product development process. Perform structural calculations and simulations in ANSYS, covering strength, frequency-domain fatigue, fracture mechanics, and structural performance. Apply industry standards (IIW, Eurocode, DNV) to support engineering decisions, compliance, and certification activities. Bridge testing and simulation by correlating results, improving models, and developing validated analysis methods. Partner with engineering leadership to strengthen structural engineering capabilities, identify technical gaps, and drive continuous improvement. Lead technical supplier reviews, root cause investigations, and cross-functional problem solving with design, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and certification teams. Support product lifecycle management (PLM) activities and mentor engineers to grow technical expertise across the team. Qualification / Requirements Master’s degree in Mechanical, Structural, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline. Extensive structural engineering experience, preferably with large fabricated metallic structures and composite components. Strong expertise in structural dynamics, sheet-metal fabrication, and composite structures. Hands-on experience in frequency-domain fatigue analysis, fracture mechanics, strength calculations, structural validation, and first-principles machine design. Proficiency in ANSYS or similar frequency-domain analysis tools. Working knowledge of engineering drawing reviews, GD&T, and tolerance stack-up analysis. Experience supporting certification processes and interacting with certification bodies. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and engineering coaching skills. Strong ownership, accountability, and commitment to engineering excellence. Desired Characteristics Knowledge of wind turbine nacelle structures and related design challenges. Familiarity with industry standards and codes such as IIW, Eurocode, and DNV. Demonstrated ability to lead technical reviews and make sound engineering decisions. Experience in test-to-simulation correlation and method development in frequency domain. Strong problem-solving skills with experience in RCA, supplier issue resolution, and technical investigations. Ability to challenge the status quo and drive technical advancement. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No

title: Manufacturing Engineering Engineer
description: About the Company For over 100 years, Neapco has been a leading global provider of innovative driveline solutions for a wide variety of applications. Constantly evolving with changing markets and driveline technologies, Neapco provides leading-edge propshafts/driveshafts, sideshafts/halfshafts, differentials, aluminum die castings and driveline components to Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), driveline specialists and major heavy-duty parts distributors. Neapco’s capabilities feature a deeply experienced in-house engineering staff, automated lean manufacturing processes, and ongoing quality improvement. A trusted source of engineered solutions for all classes of vehicles and stationary driveline applications, Neapco is known industrywide for flexibility, innovation and on-time delivery. Neapco driveline products are used in commercial vehicles including over-the-road heavy trucks, busses, fire engines and light duty vans, as well as recreational vehicles (RVs) and large motor homes. Neapco provides a full line of fixed-length assemblies and many styles of yokes to interface with other driveline components. Neapco’s flexible engineering and production capabilities can deliver solutions ranging from short-run custom and standard configurations to high-volume OEM assemblies. Widely specified in all commercial vehicle applications, Neapco precision products provide competitively priced OEM quality and performance. About the Role The Manufacturing Engineering Engineer oversees the development and implementation of manufacturing processes which maintain proper product functionality as well as cost efficiency. Responsibilities Provide sustainability of the production performance and quality. Work closely with specialists and operators in the shopfloor to ensure the efficiency of the manufaturing lines. Manage daily Process Audits. Coordinate product and process launches using APQP procedures and principles. Ensure that the manufacturing process is established with equipment, tooling, and process controls that can meet customer, risk, and operation targets. Manage through direct reports, the implementation of the PM system and the maintenance and repair of new equipment and tooling and the related physical plant in those areas through launch up until Production assumes responsibility. Monitor and plan equipment and tooling capacity. Maintain environmental regulatory compliance. Take role in establishing a capital budget and expense budget for management approval. Ensure that the applicable standard practices are understood and applied. Maintain metrics on: equipment and tooling capacity utilization, regulatory conformance, launch conformance, process performance, process control, PM performance, and labour standards conformance. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering Minimum of three (3) years of Manufacturing Engineering experience in an automotive parts manufacturing environment. Required Skills Proficiency in English is a must. Knowledge and understanding of CI tools and approaches (lean manufacturing, Kaizen, Six Sigma, problem solving, Kanban, process mapping, etc.). Experience with IATF 16949. Experience with structured APQP process. Experience with AIAG VDA P-FMEA. Experience on FANUC and/or SIEMENS programming. Understanding and application of SPC/process control. AutoCAD and Minitab (or other statistical package). Please send us your application preferably in English if you believe that you are the right candidate. Equal Opportunity Statement Neapco recognizes that our team members are our most valuable asset, and we are committed to providing them with a safe, drug-free workplace fostering respect and ethical treatment. Unlawful discrimination in employment decisions based on race, color, religion, ethnic/national origin, age, sex, veteran status, disability, or any similar protected status is strictly prohibited. www.neapco.com

title: Sualtı Araçları ve Sualtı Karşı Tedbir Sistemleri Akustik Sensör Geliştirme Mühendisi
description: ASELSAN Savunma Sistem Teknolojileri (SST) Sektör Başkanlığı bünyesinde Gölbaşı yerleşkesindeki faaliyetlerimizde bize güç katacak üniversitelerin Elektrik-Elektronik, Elektronik ve Haberleşme, Makine veya Mekatronik Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun Sualtı Araçları ve Sualtı Karşı Tedbir Sistemleri Akustik Sensör Geliştirme Mühendisi çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. BU POZİSYONDA EN ÖNEM VERDİĞİMİZ YETKİNLİKLER VE DENEYİMLER Tercihen donanım tasarımı, doğrulama ve kalifikasyon süreçleri hakkında bilgi veya tecrübe sahibi, Tercihen akustik, piezoelektrik, sensör ve transdüser teknolojileri konularına ilgi duyan veya temel bilgi sahibi, Tercihen sonlu elemanlar analizi (FEA/FEM) ve yapısal/akustik analiz konusunda COMSOL, ANSYS vb. programları kullanmış, Yeni mezun Elektrik-Elektronik, Elektronik ve Haberleşme Mühendisleri için tercihen; elektromanyetik, mikrodalga teknolojileri, mekanik dalgalar, dalga teorisi ve titreşim konularına ilgi duyan veya temel bilgi sahibi, Yeni mezun Makine ve/veya Mekatronik Mühendisleri için tercihen; titreşim, dinamik sistemler, mekanik dalgalar ve yapısal analiz konularına ilgi duyan veya temel bilgi sahibi, Laboratuvar ve saha testlerinde görev alabilecek, deney sonuçlarını analiz edebilecek, Yurt içi ve yurt dışı projelerde çalışabilecek, seyahat ve sahada çalışmaya engeli olmayan. SENDEN NELER BEKLİYORUZ? Su altı akustik sensör (transdüser), hidrofon ve projektörlerin tasarım ve geliştirme çalışmalarında görev almak, Sensörlerin gereksinimlerini belirlemek; akustik, mekanik ve elektriksel tasarım çalışmalarını gerçekleştirmek, Piezoelektrik malzemelerin sensör tasarımlarında kullanımına yönelik çalışmalar yürütmek, Sensörlerin akustik, titreşimsel, mekanik ve elektriksel performanslarını analiz etmek ve iyileştirmek, Sensör tasarımlarının modelleme, analiz, doğrulama ve kalifikasyon çalışmalarında görev almak, Tasarım sürecinde prototip üretim, entegrasyon ve laboratuvar çalışmalarını yürütmek veya bu çalışmalara destek vermek, Geliştirilen sensörlerin laboratuvar ve su altı saha testlerinin planlanması, gerçekleştirilmesi ve sonuçlarının analiz edilmesine katkı sağlamak, Test sonuçlarını değerlendirerek sensör tasarımının akustik ve yapısal performansını iyileştirmek, Sensörlerin sonar sistemleri içerisindeki kullanımına yönelik sistem ve alt sistem entegrasyon çalışmalarına katkı sağlamak, Tasarım, analiz, test ve doğrulama süreçlerinde farklı disiplinlerden ekiplerle koordineli çalışmak, Yeni nesil akustik sensör ve transdüser teknolojilerinin araştırılması, uygulanabilirliğinin değerlendirilmesi ve ürünlere kazandırılması çalışmalarında görev almak. *İşe alım kriterlerimizi ASELSAN internet sayfamızda Kariyer Sekmesinde bulunan İşe Alım Sürecimiz alanından inceleyerek iş başvuru formumuzu doldur. Aselsan ailesinin bir parçası olarak yerli ve milli projelerdeki başarımızda senin de imzan olsun. Biz Kimiz? Alanında dünyanın en iyi ürünlerini yapma, oyun değiştirici teknolojiler geliştirme ve ihracat odaklı büyüme hedeflerimizle ülkemize ve dünyanın dört bir yanındaki kullanıcılarımıza değer katan küresel bir markayız.

Pozisyon Adı: Saha Mühendisi Departman: Servis Konum: Ankara, Ostim Genel Nitelikler: Üniversitelerin Elektrik, Elektrik-Elektronik veya Makine Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Tercihen saha uygulamaları, şantiye veya endüstriyel tesislerde staj veya kısa süreli deneyim sahibi, Elektrik ve/veya mekanik projeleri okuyabilen veya öğrenmeye istekli, Saha kurulum, montaj ve devreye alma süreçlerinde kendini geliştirmek isteyen, Yoğun şantiye temposuna ve saha koşullarına uyum sağlayabilecek, Yurtiçi ve yurtdışı seyahat engeli bulunmayan, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, öğrenmeye açık ve sorumluluk sahibi, Sahada inisiyatif alabilecek ve süreç takibi yapabilecek, Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış veya tecilli. İş Tanımı: Plent ve endüstriyel tesis kurulum süreçlerinde saha ekibine destek vermek, Mekanik ve elektrik montaj süreçlerinde aktif görev almak, Projelerin sahada uygulanmasına destek olmak ve süreçleri öğrenmek, Devreye alma çalışmalarına katılmak, Saha ekipleri ve üstleri ile koordineli çalışmak, İş programına uygun ilerlemeyi takip etmek ve düzenli raporlama yapmak, Teknik ofis ile saha arasındaki koordinasyonu sağlamak, Sahada karşılaşılan teknik problemlerin çözümünde aktif rol almak, Süreçlere adapte olarak zamanla saha operasyonlarında daha fazla sorumluluk almak. title: Material Purchasing and Process Engineer
description: About Us Itameks is one of the top three manufacturers in Europe of automotive interior floor components. As a supplier to 23 global OEM/OES brands, the company holds the IATF 16949 quality certification. Our headquarters are located in Seyrantepe, İstanbul, with production facilities in the Free Trade Zone in Tuzla, İstanbul, and a new global production site currently being established. The continuous growth of our company is driven by the performance and engagement of our employees. Our success is built on the personal development of each employee, our team spirit, and both individual and collective achievements. Our employees act in line with our company culture, take initiative, assume responsibility, and transform challenges into opportunities. Key Responsibilities Research and analyze the technical characteristics, application areas, and manufacturing process impacts of TPE, rubber, textile, and other main and critical raw materials. Support the definition of material specifications for new products, materials, and process requirements in coordination with relevant technical departments. Participate in the development of new and alternative raw materials in line with internal and external customer requirements and follow the process through to serial production. Research alternative materials and suppliers in domestic and international markets and support their technical and commercial evaluation. Collect quotations from suppliers and prepare comparative analyses based on price, technical suitability, quality, lead time, and cost criteria. Contribute to cost reduction and localization projects for existing and alternative materials. Support new supplier evaluation, sampling, technical approval, and implementation processes in coordination with relevant departments. Monitor market developments related to materials, technologies, suppliers, and pricing and prepare relevant analyses. Analyze TPE, rubber, and textile manufacturing processes, including process parameters, machinery and equipment, and material-process interactions. Participate in process improvement and optimization activities focusing on efficiency, quality, cost, and cycle time. Support root cause analysis and permanent corrective action activities for technical problems encountered in manufacturing processes. Contribute to continuous improvement, cost reduction, process standardization, Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and SMED activities. Support takt time, cycle time, lead time, and other relevant process and time analyses. Participate in efficiency improvement activities related to TPE, rubber, and textile production lines, machinery, and equipment. Support the technical evaluation of new machinery, equipment, molds, fixtures, and apparatus, including the identification of technical requirements and alternative suppliers. Research new technologies, machinery, equipment, materials, and manufacturing methods and contribute to technical and economic feasibility studies. Follow production trials during new product and material introduction processes and support the evaluation and improvement of process results. Prepare technical and commercial comparisons, feasibility studies, and cost analyses related to materials, suppliers, processes, and investments. Monitor assigned activities in accordance with project plans and the Masterplan and report progress and results. Work closely with Purchasing, Production, Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to identify improvement opportunities across the entire process, from raw material sourcing to manufacturing. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Textile Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Recent graduate or preferably 0–2 years of professional experience. Good command of English. Strong interest in manufacturing, material technologies, technical purchasing, and production processes. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to evaluate technical and commercial data together. Strong numerical analysis and problem-solving skills. Cost, efficiency, and continuous improvement-oriented mindset. Willingness to work actively on the production floor and learn manufacturing processes hands-on. Strong research, reporting, and presentation skills. Strong communication, coordination, and negotiation skills. Proficiency in MS Office applications. Ability to work effectively in a team and collaborate across different functions. Willingness to research, learn, and adapt to new materials, technologies, and manufacturing methods.

title: Pump Field Service Engineer
description: Our world depends on rocks, minerals, metals and other raw materials – the building blocks of modern society. As an industry leader, Metso helps transform these essential materials to enable sustainable modern life. Our solutions and services support everything from renewable energy and electrification to the infrastructure and digital economy shaping our future. Together, we help our customers meet growing demand while driving the industry toward a more sustainable use of the earth’s natural resources. Join nearly 18,000 Metsonites worldwide, each bringing unique expertise and experience to positive change. At Metso, you’re supported by a growth culture built on safety, wellbeing, inclusion and collaboration. This is your opportunity to make an impact and rise above the possible. Job posting end date: 10/09/2026 Pump field Service Engineer Introduction We are seeking a Pump field Service Engineer to join our Pump Sales team. You will be responsible for executing the yearly sales plan, covering aftermarket of Pumps, Hydrocyclone, Hoses and Valves. Your role involves generating new business opportunities and managing existing customer relationships and support on troubleshooting. You will play a crucial part in driving sales growth, ensuring exceptional customer service, and strengthening our market presence. This position is mainly located in Ankara. Team you belong to You will join a team of technical sales professionals who are passionate about delivering high-quality solutions to customers in the mining, aggregates, and industriay. We work closely with internal and external stakeholders, such as sales managers, customer service teams, and technical support specialists, ensuring seamless communication and effective sales execution. Our team culture is all about collaboration, customer-centricity, and technical excellence. What You’ll Do Execute the yearly sales plan, identifying new business opportunities and maximizing sales within the assigned territory. Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers at all organizational levels, particularly with maintenance teams, supervisors, and operators. Provide excellent customer service by responding to inquiries regarding pricing, delivery, product details, reliability improvement, spare parts optimization, wear life optimization, life time extension trials, root cause analysis and technical troubleshooting. Provide hands-on field support whenever necessary to assist customers in resolving operational and technical challenges. Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement customer-specific sales strategies. Maintain a strong company image by demonstrating professionalism, in-depth product knowledge, and an understanding of customer needs. Act as a liaison between customers and internal teams, ensuring a smooth flow of communication. Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company policies. Support customers in inventory management and spare parts planning to optimize equipment availability and minimize downtime. Travel extensively for client meetings, industry events, and on-site sales and technical support activities. Who you are! Must possess an engineering degree, technical qualification, vocational training, apprenticeship, or equivalent hands-on industry experience in mechanical, maintenance, industrial, or related fields. Preferably have 5-10 years of experience as Sales / Technical Support in a similar industry. Demonstrated knowledge of mechanical equipment, industrial machinery, maintenance practices, and mining or mineral processing operations. Strong problem-solving skills and a results-oriented mindset with excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Self-motivated, with strong organizational and time management abilities. Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally. Knowledge of business transactions, including costing, pricing, profit calculations, and contract terms. Demonstrated understanding of equipment performance, failure modes, reliability issues, and operational challenges within industrial or mining environments. Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills, with the ability to identify and implement practical solutions in the field. Must have a valid driver's license and exprienced driver. Prepared to work flexible work hours to meet deadlines when required What's In It For You An inspiring purpose - Enabling sustainable modern life. Minerals and metals are the backbone of essential functions in the modern world. However, there's a pressing need for more sustainable solutions to collect and process them. At Metso, you get to be part of transforming the industry and making a positive change. Wellbeing and safety - Benefit from occupational healthcare, generous benefits plan, mental well-being services and engagement surveys. Compensation and rewards - Global incentive program tied to business and performance targets, company car or commuting aid and meal benefits. Hybrid working possibilities - While we are big advocates of meeting and collaborating in person, we believe in fostering a flexible work environment. A thriving culture - We are committed to developing an inclusive culture that enables everyone to do their best and reach their full potential. A culture that is courageous, compelling, and caring, and unites our people to build a sustainable future together. Extensive learning opportunities - Ongoing growth dialogues, internal mobility, mentoring programs, education assistance, ambitious projects, and global opportunities. Worldwide support - Leverage our network of peers across the world, offering valuable assistance. We get things done together, through open and honest communication. Get in touch Want to rise above the possible with us? Click ‘Apply now’ to leave your application Metso is committed to pay equity and transparent reward practices globally. title: Process Design Executive
description: AKSA, a company of Akkök Holding, was founded in 1968 in Yalova. Becoming the world’s largest producer of acrylic fiber over the years, Aksa today serves approximately 300 customers in over 50 countries across 5 continents. Having a capacity of 350.000 tons per year, Aksa supplies raw materials for textiles and technical textiles in many diverse areas. We are seeking a Process Design Executive with experience in chemical engineering and strong leadership skills to join our Process Development Department. Qualities We Are Looking For; • Graduate of Chemical Engineering departments of universities, • At least 7 years of experience in process design, production engineering or process improvement, • Actively involved in production facilities; experienced in process development and improvement studies, • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving and holistic decision-making skills, • Proficient in time management and prioritization, • Strong communication skills, able to collaborate effectively with different disciplines, • Proficient in lean manufacturing, Six Sigma and continuous improvement methodologies, • Knowledgeable about process safety (PSM) and safe design principles, • Experienced in energy efficiency and sustainability projects, • Able to design, develop and ensure the sustainability of process control processes, • Able to contribute to industrial digital transformation projects, • Strong team management and leadership skills. Your main tasks are; • Designing, developing, and optimizing chemical processes, • Analyzing bottlenecks in production processes and developing lasting solutions, • Coordinating Six Sigma and continuous improvement projects, • Conducting design and improvement studies in accordance with process safety requirements, • Developing and managing projects aimed at increasing energy efficiency, • Developing and implementing technical solutions to improve process control and production performance, • Leading and managing the engineering team for which they are responsible, and supporting performance and development processes. • Implementing projects by working in coordination with production, maintenance, and investment teams. What are waiting for you here ! Applications that support your development • Participation in Job Orientation and AKSA Recognition Training specific to the process steps within the scope of job adaptation, • Opportunity to participate in personal development, professional development and leadership training within the scope of our Corporate Training Academy, • Outside fairs, training and company visit opportunities abroad, • Master's/PhD support program, • Foreign language support program, Work-Life Balance • The opportunity to work 4 days a week, which we implemented as a first in Turkey, • Private accommodation for employees, • Benefit package, • Aksa Social Event Team activities (Sailing, book, running, trekking clubs) • Service Opportunity: On the Yalova-Kocaeli (Karamürsel-Gölcük-Başiskele). Recruitment Process • Receiving applications, • Preliminary evaluation to be made in line with the criteria, • Sending personality inventory and interview process to shortlisted candidates • English exam • Senior management meeting • Offer

description: Calpabot is an early-stage humanoid robotics startup building practical robotic systems for real-world work. Mechanical and industrial design is being developed as part of the founding engineering team. We are currently at the early prototype stage , defining the architecture, selecting components and preparing the first physical system. About the role This is a Co-Founder position, not a conventional salaried job . The role can initially be pursued alongside your current work. Equity will be structured through vesting and clearly defined milestones . Prototype hardware, actuators, electronics and development materials required for the project will be provided. The team is based in Istanbul , and because this is a hardware project, regular in-person prototype work will be necessary. Our immediate objective is straightforward: build our first functional prototype. If you want to build real robotic hardware from the ground up and take ownership of a core part of the technology and company, we’d like to hear from you. calpabot.com

Job Description: Design, develop, and train computer vision models for document intelligence, OCR/ICR, signature recognition, object detection, and segmentation use cases, Fine-tune and adapt pretrained models (CNNs, ResNet, ViT, YOLO, VLMs) to banking-specific data, Plan and manage data labeling processes, including defining annotation guidelines, preparing labeled datasets, and ensuring label quality and consistency, Build image preprocessing and data augmentation pipelines using OpenCV and PyTorch, Evaluate and benchmark OCR/ICR engines (PaddleOCR, EasyOCR, etc.) and VLM-based approaches for extracting information from banking documents, Take part in every phase of the project: data analysis, technical design, prototyping, model development, integration into core banking systems, and end-to-end testing, Optimize models for production performance, including latency, throughput, and resource usage, Monitor deployed models and continuously improve them based on performance metrics and business feedback, Follow state-of-the-art research in computer vision and multimodal AI and turn it into applicable solutions. Would be Advantageous: Prior experience in banking, financial services, fraud detection, or document processing projects, Experience with model optimization and deployment tools (ONNX, TensorRT, OpenVINO, or similar), Experience with data annotation tools (CVAT, Label Studio, or similar), Experience with container orchestration tools (Kubernetes). title: Founding Engineer
description: Help us expand what AI agents can build. Limrun runs development tools and applications as cloud services that agents can use from wherever they run. We're hiring an engineer to build and scale that platform. The role You'll help decide what to build and own projects from design through ongoing maintenance. You'll also join the on-call rotation, investigate production incidents, and fix their causes. What you'll do • Build and launch new tools, features, and cloud services, including the Go services, APIs, and Kubernetes controllers behind them. • Reduce startup times, improve scheduling, and make better use of compute as demand grows. • Build and maintain the tenant isolation, access controls, and networking that protect customer workloads and data. • Automate host provisioning, upgrades, and recovery from failures. • Work with customers to understand their workflows and turn problems they encounter into better APIs, tooling, and product features. What we're looking for • You've built, operated, and scaled production cloud infrastructure, with responsibility for deployment, observability, and reliability. • You've written and maintained Go services in production and can reason about concurrent code. • You understand Kubernetes architecture and controller patterns well enough to build on them and debug their behavior. • You can investigate failures across application code, networking, and operating systems. • You've shipped production software or infrastructure using AI-assisted development. We care about your work and the responsibility you've taken for it more than titles or years of experience. Nice to have, not required • Experience with sandboxing, virtual machines, or managing Linux and macOS hosts. • Hands-on work with DNS, routing, proxies, tunnels, or private networking. • Experience building APIs, SDKs, CLIs, CI systems, or remote build tools. • Experience using or building AI agents for platform maintenance and production operations. • Familiarity with mobile development workflows using simulators and emulators. Why Limrun As an early engineer, you'll work directly with the founder to decide what Limrun builds next. Each new service can open up more development workflows to agents. You'll help establish how the engineering team works, with room to take on broader responsibilities as the company grows. We're a small team using AI to tackle big infrastructure problems. Limrun gives you room to explore how far AI can take your engineering work, test ideas, and see the results in systems that developers and agents depend on. What we offer • A hybrid role based in Istanbul. • Regular team offsites. • Company-covered work travel across Europe and the US. Apply Send us your resume or profile and a short note about an engineering project you're proud of. This could be: • A system or service you took from design to production. • A scaling, performance, or reliability problem you solved. • An operational improvement that reduced failures, manual work, or recovery time. Tell us what you personally owned, the decisions you made, and what improved. If AI contributed, tell us how you used it and checked the results. Links to code, projects, or technical writing are welcome where you can share them.

Hands-on experience with verification methodologies and tools, including simulation, waveform analysis, execution automation, coverage collection, and gate-level simulations. Experience in Event Driven Modelling/Verification is a plus. Knowledge of scripting languages (Perl, Python, Tcl) is a plus. title: Ingénieur Structure Subsea (F/H)

MYTTRA recherche un Ingénieur Structure Subsea maîtrisant Abaqus et SACS pour intervenir sur des problématiques de calcul et de dimensionnement de structures sous-marines. 🔎 VOS MISSIONS : ✔️ Réaliser les calculs de structures Subsea Prendre en charge les études de dimensionnement et de justification mécanique de structures destinées à des environnements Offshore / Subsea. ✔️ Réaliser les analyses Modéliser et analyser les structures par éléments finis en réalisant notamment des calculs plaques et volumiques . ✔️ Dimensionner les structures Réaliser les études portant sur les structures tubulaires et structures en treillis . ✔️ Analyser les résultats de calcul Interpréter les résultats des simulations, identifier les zones critiques et contribuer à l’optimisation des solutions de conception. ✔️ Participer aux revues techniques Apporter votre expertise calcul aux différentes phases du projet et échanger avec les équipes d’ingénierie sur les choix de conception. ✔️ Produire la documentation technique Rédiger les notes de calcul, rapports d’analyse et documents de justification associés. 🧩 VOTRE PROFIL : ✅ Expérience indispensable : Vous disposez impérativement d’une expérience professionnelle dans les environnements Subsea / Offshore de minimum 3 ans . ✅ Compétences techniques indispensables : Calcul de structures Subsea / Offshore Calcul par éléments finis Calcul plaque Calcul volumique Structures tubulaires Structures treillis ✅ Qualités recherchées : Excellentes capacités d’analyse Rigueur dans les calculs Autonomie Esprit de synthèse Capacité à travailler avec des équipes d’ingénierie multidisciplinaires ✨ POURQUOI MYTTRA ? 🌴 28 CP/An 🌍 2 CP Associatifs/An 🎭 100€ de pass culturel/an 💰 Prime de fin d'année automatique allant jusqu'à 1500€ Brut 📈 Intéressement 🍽️ Ticket Restaurant (8€) sans condition d'ancienneté 🚗 Frais de déplacement incitatifs

title: Ingénieur Calcul Structures Métalliques H/F
description: Description du poste Développer vos compétences au sein d’une équipe humaine et dynamique, contribuer à des missions passionnantes permettant de prévenir et de maîtriser les risques, ça vous tente ? Apave recherche une-e Ingénieur(e) Calcul Structures Métalliques . Au sein de l’agence de Limonest (69), l’équipe technique assure un rôle majeur : permettre à nos clients d’exercer leur métier en toute sécurité et contribuer ainsi au développement du Groupe Apave au cœur des territoires. Concrètement, en quoi va consister votre quotidien ? Vous réaliserez des missions d’assistance technique avec rédaction de notes de calcul pour la plupart du temps. Vous serez aussi amené(e) à effectuer des vérifications tierce partie de notes de calculs. Vous Interviendrez Sur Divers Types De Structures Bâtiments en charpente métallique Structures supports (mâts, pylônes, stockage industriel) Equipements d’accès et de sécurité (Passerelles, plateformes de travail, garde-corps) Equipements de levage et de manutention (Potences, monorails, ponts roulants) De quoi vous permettre de travailler sur plusieurs règlementations et normes et ainsi de monter en compétences sur plusieurs sujets techniques. Vos Principales Missions Seront Echange avec le client afin de définir son besoin et la faisabilité du projet Définir le prix et le contenu de la prestation avec rédaction d’une proposition commerciale Effectuer la prestation avec un accompagnement du client dans le cadre de son projet Vous l’aurez compris, vous serez acteur de votre affaire depuis le contact avec le client jusqu’à la réalisation de la prestation, et serez identifié par le client pour de futurs projets. Il est prévu un accompagnement complet lors de vos premières missions, avec en support des ingénieurs expérimentés dans le domaine de la structure, du levage et du nucléaire. Des déplacements ponctuels sont à prévoir sur certains projets, afin d’effectuer des expertises et / ou relevés dimensionnels de structures. Vous serez emmené à travailler sur des affaires de grande envergure (Nucléaire, International). Choisissez-nous ! En rejoignant Apave, vous intégrez plus qu'un groupe : vous prenez part à une histoire où la force du collectif est une réalité, où la notion d'accompagnement s'exprime au quotidien, pour que chacun trouve naturellement sa place. Parce que chez Apave, nous considérons nos différences comme une richesse que nous mettons chaque jour au service de missions à forte utilité sociale. Profil recherché Parlons de vous ! D’abord, Votre Cursus Vous êtes de formation Ingénieur(e) ou Master 2 Génie Civil ou Mécanique à dominante études de structures Vous avez de bonnes connaissances en Résistance de Matériaux Vous maîtrisez l’outil informatique et connaissez les logiciels de dimensionnement à barres et éléments finis de type ROBOT ou Advance Design, ainsi qu’Excel, Vous savez utiliser le logiciel ANSYS pour modéliser et analyser des structures métalliques plus complexes (ponts roulants, équipements de manutention ou de levage) Idéalement, vous maitrisez au moins un ou plusieurs codes de construction de structure métallique (CM66, normes EUROCODE 3 et règles de calculs FEM / NF EN 13001). Ensuite, Vos Compétences, Vos Qualités Personnelles Vous souhaitez monter en compétences sur la structure métallique au sein d’une équipe composés d’ingénieurs expérimentés et pouvant vous accompagner Vous aspirez à développer votre potentiel dans le domaine de la Structure Métallique, Rigoureux, autonome, doté d’un bon esprit d’analyse et d’un bon relationnel, Vous souhaitez travailler et vous investir sur des projets complexes et de grande technicité. Nous vous contactons pour un 1er échange. Nous souhaitons poursuivre ensemble ? Des entretiens opérationnels techniques et RH vous attendent. Bienvenue ! Notre collaboration va commencer, hâte de vous retrouver ! Nous Rejoindre, C'est Prendre du plaisir dans le travail et développer votre carrière. Nous vous proposons une diversité de missions loin de la routine, un programme de formation complet tout au long de votre parcours, et des possibilités de mobilité interne au sein du Groupe Une entreprise engagée dans votre équilibre vie professionnelle / vie personnelle : Droit à la déconnexion, Interventions majoritairement sur un secteur géographique défini. Bénéficier des avantages : 13ème mois, forfait repas ou ticket restaurant selon conditions de déplacement, RTT, participation / intéressement, plan d'épargne, prime vacances. Des outils connectés et de mobilité pour réaliser votre activité : smartphone, tablette.

title: Ingenjör inom Additiv tillverkning
description: BAE Systems Hägglunds AB Vill du arbeta inom försvarsindustrin och dessutom för en världsledande fordonstillverkare? Just nu befinner sig BAE Systems Hägglunds AB i en expansiv fas inom samtliga produktområden, då efterfrågan på Hägglunds fordon (Bandvagn / BVS10 och Stridsfordon 90 / CV90) nått höjder som aldrig tidigare har skådats. Är du redo att ta klivet in i framtidens teknik? Vi söker nu en Ingenjör inom Additive Manufacturing, AM. Var med och forma framtidens industri! Din framtida utmaning Additive Manufacturing – Framtidens Teknik och Innovation! Är du en passionerad och driven ingenjör som vill vara med och forma framtidens teknik? Som Ingenjör inom AM kommer du att spela en central roll i utvecklingen och effektiviseringen av vår additiva tillverkning. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med den senaste teknologin inom 3D-printing och ingå i hela designprocessen för att skapa innovativa lösningar. Som Ingenjör inom AM har du en tongivande roll i att utveckla och optimera våra teknologiska lösningar inom additiv tillverkning. Du kommer att arbeta nära vårt designteam, där du kommer att driva hela designprocessen från idé till färdig produkt. Din erfarenhet inom konstruktion, hållfasthet och programmering kommer vara avgörande för att säkerställa att alla projekt uppfyller våra höga krav på kvalitet och effektivitet. En spännande och framtidsinriktad arbetsmiljö där innovation och teknik står i fokus. Möjligheten att arbeta med den senaste teknologin inom additiv tillverkning. En roll där du verkligen kan påverka och forma utvecklingen av nya lösningar. Stöd från ett kompetent team och en stark kultur av samarbete och lärande. En dynamisk arbetsplats där effektivisering och utveckling är nyckelkomponenter i vår strategi. Den du är Konstruktionskompetens Förståelse för materialens hållfasthet Är van vid att arbeta med programmering och koder för att optimera designen för 3D-printing. Kunskap inom CNC och maskinbearbetning värderas högt Du kan arbeta inom etablerade riktlinjer och processer, samtidigt som du driver innovation och effektivisering i hela designflödet. Vill vara med och utveckla nästa generations 3D-printers och applicera teknologin för att lösa framtidens utmaningar. Flytande i svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift Vad du blir en del av Hos oss kommer du att ha kul på jobbet och ingen dag kommer att vara den andra lik! Du kommer att få vara med när produkten blir till från idé till dess att den rullar ut till kund. Du kommer att få jobba med framtidens teknik i ett globalt företag där du har stora möjligheter till kompetens & karriärutveckling. Om du inte kan se filmen, klicka på länken: https://youtu.be/sbvv-Jm2PhI BAE Systems levererar några av världens mest avancerade, teknikledande lösningar inom försvar, flyg och säkerhet. Vi har över 100 000 kvalificerade medarbetare i mer än 40 länder. Genom att vi arbetar tillsammans med kunder och lokala partners, levererar vi produkter och tjänster med militär kapacitet, som skyddar människor och den nationella säkerheten samt säkrar viktig information och infrastruktur. BAE Systems Hägglunds fokuserar på utveckling, tillverkning, integration och support av ett brett spektrum av militära fordon till kunder över hela världen. Våra främsta produkter är medeltunga stridsfordon (CV90), bepansrade terrängfordon (BvS10), stöd och support samt elhybrida drivsystem för den civila marknaden. Pålitlig, Innovativ och Djärv är ledorden för vår verksamhet. Läs gärna mer om Örnsköldsvik och Höga Kusten på www.jobbaochlev.se/ - www.inspiration.ornskoldsvik.se - www.hogakusten.com/sv Kontaktperson Har du frågor, är du varmt välkommen att höra av dig till Head of Standard Vehicle Variants Jimmy Blixt , 072 – 704 87 52 eller rekryteringskonsult Maria Josefsson 070 – 842 23 35. Sista ansökningsdag är den 6 december. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placeringsort Örnsköldsvik. Självklart erbjuder vi flyttbidrag om du flyttar för jobb hos oss. Vi arbetar med försvarssekretess, vilket innebär både legala krav samt speciella krav från våra kunder på oss som företag. Alla som anställs ska därför genomgå säkerhetskontroll och drogtest. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: New Product Introduction Engineer
description: About the job Company Description Millux BV is a leading expert in advanced metals processing, laser micromachining, and high‑precision laser welding for demanding semiconductor and high‑tech applications. With over 35 years of experience in short and ultrashort‑pulse laser technologies, Millux delivers precise, repeatable, and scalable results from feasibility studies through full production. The company specializes in machining complex micro‑features, creating high‑quality laser‑drilled structures, and producing reliable, contamination‑free welds on advanced metals such as titanium, stainless steels, Hastelloy, and aluminium. As part of the IDEX Materials Science Solutions platform, Millux is supported by a broader group with expertise in optical technologies, advanced metals, technical glass, and ceramics, enhancing its ability to solve complex engineering challenges. Role Description The New Product Introduction (NPI) Engineer is part of the Engineering team at Millux, which also consists of Factory Engineers, R&D engineers and Project leads. The team is lead by the Engineering manager. The NPI Engineer is responsible for driving new products from concept to stable series production in a on-site role based in Wijchen. This role includes liaising with clients regarding manufacturability, conducting parameter testing on machines, programming machines, creating prototypes and hand over projects to production. A versatile role with many responsibilities. The engineer collaborates closely with R&D, production, quality, and customer engineering teams to translate design requirements into robust, scalable processes and work instructions. Day-to-day tasks involve planning and tracking NPI projects, organizing and executing tests and trials, analyzing process data, and implementing improvements to ensure quality, yield, and on-time delivery. The role also includes preparing technical documentation, supporting customer technical reviews, and ensuring smooth handover of new products to operations. Working at Millux Millux has an open culture. Employees are ambitious, loyal, enthusiastic and supportive of one another. You will be welcomed as part of our team and will feel at home from the start. We work hard every day to achieve the best results and we celebrate successes together. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related technical discipline. 5-10 years experience in a similar role, preferably in an international environment. Strong analytical skills, including data interpretation, problem-solving, and root cause analysis. Research and Development (R&D) capabilities, such as experimental design, process optimization, and collaboration with product and process engineers. Project Management skills, including planning, organizing milestones, coordinating stakeholders, and managing timelines and resources. Product Development experience, including translating customer specifications into manufacturable solutions and supporting design-for-manufacturing activities. Testing skills, including defining test plans, executing trials, documenting results, and validating process robustness. Relevant experience in laser processing, precision manufacturing, or semiconductor/high‑tech environments. Strong communication skills, ability to work in cross-functional teams. Fluent or Native speaker in Dutch language and fluent in English are both manditory. What do we offer you? First and foremost, a highly collaborative and motivated work environment where your input can make a difference, with plenty of opportunities for training, personal development, and growth. We offer a competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience. The Metalektro Collective Bargaining Agreement applies, and we also offer excellent employment benefits. These include: • Salary between € 4350 and € 6650 • 8% vacation pay • 27 vacation days + 13 scheduled days off • pension plan (PME) • profit-sharing bonus • option to lease a bicycle through Lease-a-bike.nl • contribution toward a gym membership through Bedrijfsfitness.nl We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or other external parties. Any resumes submitted without a valid service agreement and prior authorization will be considered the property of the company, and no placement fee will be paid.

title: Materials Engineer – Metallographer
description: We are looking for a Materials Engineer / Metallographer to join a laboratory team supporting advanced manufacturing, production, research, and development activities. The laboratory works across materials analysis, chemical laboratory testing, metallography, microscopy, and thermal spray technologies . The role involves investigating materials and processes, supporting production-related challenges, conducting damage and failure investigations, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. You will work closely with laboratory colleagues, engineers, production teams, and internal customers to deliver reliable material analysis and laboratory results. Key Responsibilities Perform sample preparation and material testing using cutting, mounting/casting, grinding, and polishing equipment. Prepare samples for metallographic and microscopic examination. Conduct and support microscopy investigations of metallographic, thermally sprayed, and additively manufactured/printed samples. Analyze and document examination results and prepare technical reports and laboratory documentation. Support material characterization, damage investigations, and problem-solving activities related to production and process development. Contribute to research and development of new materials and manufacturing processes. Work with colleagues across materials engineering, laboratory operations, and process development on continuous improvement initiatives. Support laboratory instrument development, IT systems, calibration, quality assurance, and process improvements. Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into practical laboratory solutions. Ensure laboratory activities are performed according to applicable quality, safety, and documentation requirements. Required Qualifications Technical education or professional background, preferably in Materials Technology, Materials Engineering, Metallurgy, or a related field. Practical interest in laboratory work, materials analysis, inspection, and testing environments. Basic understanding of metallography, microscopy, and material characterization techniques. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and standard IT tools. Ability to learn and work with laboratory information management systems and technical software. Good spoken and written English. Good spoken and written Swedish. Preferred / Meritorious Qualifications Hands-on experience with metallographic sample preparation. Experience working with microscopy and material examination equipment. Experience with thermal spray, additive manufacturing, coatings, or related manufacturing processes. Experience with laboratory systems, quality management, or laboratory documentation. Practical experience operating and maintaining laboratory instruments and equipment. Good mechanical aptitude and confidence working with cutting, grinding, polishing, and other workshop/laboratory equipment. Personal Attributes We are looking for someone who: Takes individual responsibility and can work independently while contributing effectively to a team. Has a structured and analytical approach to problem solving and investigations. Is comfortable communicating with colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders. Can understand customer requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions. Is organized and able to deliver tasks according to agreed plans, priorities, and deadlines. Has a genuine interest in materials science, laboratory technology, and continuous improvement. Contributes to a positive, collaborative, and professional working environment.

title: Prototype Engineering Engineer
description: In a nutshell We are looking for a highly motivated and adaptable team member who demonstrates flexibility, a strong passion for engineering, problem-solving mindset, and who naturally embodies the Toyota DNA principles such as respect for people, continuous improvement (Kaizen & Reflection), Genchi Genbutsu, teamwork, and customer focus. Join Prototype at Toyota Technical Center in Zaventem. Company Information Toyota is one of the world’s largest automobile manufacturers and a leading global company, founded in 1937. Today, Toyota sells vehicles in 170 countries and employs over 350,000 people worldwide. At Toyota Motor Europe (TME), with our headquarters based in Brussels, Belgium, around 2,700 colleagues from more than 60 nationalities work together across Europe. We are responsible for the wholesale marketing of Toyota and Lexus vehicles, parts and accessories, and we support Toyota’s European R&D, manufacturing, and engineering operations. We are on an exciting journey as we continue to evolve into a mobility company. Our goal is to create even more value and happiness for our customers through a wide range of mobility solutions. Our services extend R&D with Production Engineering (Onsite & Manufacturing plants), and Homologation & Regulation departments. Throughout the project lifecycle, we support early concept development, strategic planning and we provide expertise in vehicle prototype production, quality assurance and rapid prototyping. We are committed to delivering customer satisfaction through clear roles & responsibilities and expectations. By fostering transparency and safe communication, we strive to achieve excellence in every request and every aspect of a project. Rapid Prototyping: Manage prototype projects from concept through realisation, delivery and assembly. Develop and deliver prototype parts (3d printing, proto tooling) within demanding timelines to support product development activities. Collaborate closely in R&D by applying engineering principles and hands-on problem-solving to design, build and test, ensuring rapid and efficient prototype iterations. Benchmark EU prototype feasibility and manufacturability on QDC principle (quality, delivery, cost), optimizing processes, tools, and workflows, improving efficiency and reducing lead time. title: INGENIEUR INDUSTRIALISATION H/F
description: À propos de nous C'est en intervenant depuis plus de 20 ans sur des projets majeurs et toujours plus complexes que nous encourageons le dépassement de soi afin de relever les défis techniques de grands donneurs d'ordres dans les secteurs de l'aérospatial, des énergies, de la défense, du naval, du ferroviaire ou encore du sport automobile. AVANTIS résulte d'une envie profonde de ses créateurs d'être une véritable référence dans le domaine de l'ingénierie mécanique. Nos équipes, composées d'experts passionnés et dévoués sont le moteur de notre entreprise et s'engagent à offrir à nos clients une expérience unique, basée sur la qualité et la fiabilité de notre savoir-faire. En tant qu'acteur important du développement de solutions innovantes, nous accompagnons aujourd'hui les leaders des industries de pointe. Bâtir une relation durable et garantir la satisfaction de nos clients avec une technologie innovante et une exigence qualité, tels sont les objectifs des 300 collaborateurs du groupe. Ensemble, nous nous efforçons de développer des relations authentiques et durables, fondées sur la confiance, le respect et la transparence. Dans un monde où les défis sont nombreux et complexes, nous croyons fermement que la capacité à penser de manière créative et à innover est essentielle pour réussir. Rejoindre AVANTIS, c'est la possibilité d'imaginer la conception de solutions innovantes à partir d'une feuille blanche et aboutir à des résultats performants. Aujourd'hui, nos 11 sites en France et à l'étranger dont notre usine de fabrication et notre centre R&D nous permettent d'optimiser la conception et la fabrication de structures/pièces mécaniques et de réduire notre impact environnemental en intégrant tous les moyens de production permettant de réaliser les produits de A à Z. Nos bureaux d’études de Melun et Torcy en Seine-et-Marne, interviennent en tant que maitre d’œuvre sur des projets d’outillages, de bancs d’essais, de machines spéciales et d’équipements industriels dans les secteurs de l’aéronautique, du spatial, de la défense, du naval, du ferroviaire et des énergies. Nous assurons la conception, le dimensionnement, la définition, la réalisation et l’installation de tous ces moyens. Mission Dans la continuité du développement de notre activité nous recherchons : UN INGENIEUR INDUSTRIALISATION/MANUFACTURING H/F Vous interviendrez sur des projets liés à la fabrication de pièces et de composants pour des moteurs aéronautiques de type turbofan. Ce poste, à fort potentiel d’évolution, vous permettra de prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités sur des projets industriels stratégiques et complexes, tout en bénéficiant de réelles perspectives de développement et d’évolution de carrière. Intégré au sein d’un environnement technique exigeant et international, vous assurerez le suivi de l’industrialisation et de la fabrication de pièces à forte valeur ajoutée, depuis l’analyse des procédés jusqu’au suivi de leur réalisation et de leur conformité. A Ce Titre, Vous Aurez Pour Missions Principales Le pilotage et le suivi de l’industrialisation de pièces mécaniques complexes destinées aux moteurs aéronautiques ; Le suivi des différentes étapes et procédés de fabrication : forge (forging), fonderie (casting), usinage (machining), traitements thermiques, traitements de surface et revêtements ; Le suivi des procédés spéciaux associés à la fabrication : soudage, brasage, traitements spécifiques, CND/NDT ; La compréhension globale des autres procédés pouvant intervenir dans la fabrication de pièces moteurs : électroérosion (EDM), fabrication additive métallique, métrologie et contrôle dimensionnel ; L'analyse des dossiers de fabrication, gammes, plans, spécifications techniques et exigences qualité ; La participation aux différentes étapes de qualification et validation des procédés industriels ; L'identification des risques industriels et techniques et et le pilotage des plans d’actions associés ; L'analyse des non-conformités, la participation à la recherche des causes racines et la mise en œuvre les actions correctives ; Le suivi de l’avancement des activités avec les différents interlocuteurs : engineering, manufacturing, qualité, supply chain, fournisseurs et partenaires ; La participation aux revues techniques et industrielles afin d'assurer un reporting clair sur l’avancement, les risques et les points bloquants ; La contribution à l’amélioration continue des processus de fabrication et à la sécurisation de la performance industrielle. Profil Issu d'une formation supérieure de niveau BAC+5 (école d'ingénieurs ou université) à dominante mécanique, matériaux, procédés de fabrication, production ou industrialisation, vous justifiez idéalement d'environ 5 ans d'expérience dans un environnement industriel exigeant tels que l'aéronautique, les moteurs aéronautiques, la défense, les énergies ou la mécanique de haute précision. Vous Disposez D'une Bonne Compréhension Des Procédés De Fabrication De Pièces Mécaniques à Forte Valeur Ajoutée, Notamment Forge – Fonderie – Usinage – Traitements thermiques – Traitements de surface & revêtements – Procédés spéciaux – Soudage/brasage – CND/NDT – Métrologie – Fabrication additive. Une expertise approfondie de l'ensemble de ces procédés n'est pas indispensable. Nous recherchons avant tout un profil capable de comprendre une gamme de fabrication complexe, d'identifier les procédés et étapes critiques, d'analyser les risques industriels et de coordonner les actions nécessaires. Des connaissances en APQP, PPAP, FAI, AMDEC/FMEA, 8D, Root Cause Analysis ou démarches similaires constituent un atout. Un anglais de niveau B1 ou B2 est demandé. Poste en CDI à pourvoir à Moissy-Cramayel (77), rémunération entre 48 et 55 K€ b/an suivant profil et expérience + avantages. Référence de l'offre : j1mkqakja1

title: (Junior) Researcher for Computational design of mechanical metamaterials for 3D printed footwear
description: Computational design of mechanical metamaterials for 3d printed footwear Job Description The Faculty of Industrial Design Engineering at TU Delft is seeking three highly motivated researchers to join an exciting collaborative research project on 3D-printed footwear innovation, carried out in close collaboration with industrial partners. The project aims to develop an integrated computational design and digital fabrication workflow for next-generation footwear. The research combines biomechanics, computational design, mechanical metamaterials, additive manufacturing, and digital workflows to create novel footwear concepts with improved performance and manufacturability. One of the three positions will focus on mechanical metamaterials design. This researcher will develop computational methods and experimentally evaluate mechanical metamaterials for footwear applications. Responsibilities Design mechanical metamaterials for functional performance Perform computational modelling and simulation Prototype and experimentally characterise designs Optimise structures for manufacturability and performance Collaborate closely with the computational design and biomechanics researchers Job Requirements MSc (or equivalent) in Mechanical Engineering, Computational Science and Engineering, or a closely related discipline Strong background in mechanics and finite element analysis Experience with topology optimisation and/or inverse design Experience with additive manufacturing or mechanical testing is an advantage Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ is desirable. TU Delft (Delft University of Technology) Working at TU Delft means contributing to solutions that really make a difference. For over 180 years, we have been training engineers who make an impact worldwide in companies, government bodies, or as entrepreneurs. Our alumni turn knowledge into concrete solutions for the challenges of today and tomorrow. These challenges are changing rapidly. That is why we focus on themes such as energy, climate, digitalisation, artificial intelligence (AI), and smart mobility every day. Our education and research are directly aligned with what society needs now and in the future. At TU Delft, our people make the difference. With their knowledge and curiosity, our staff provide a high-quality education and conduct pioneering research that extends beyond the campus. You will have the opportunity to take the initiative, work with others, and grow as a professional. Working at TU Delft means join an international community of professionals and students. Together, we create knowledge, innovations, and solutions that help move the world forward. Faculty Industrial Design Engineering Matching the evolution of people with the speed of the revolution of technology. This is the focus of the Faculty of Industrial Design Engineering (IDE). Delft designers act as a bridge between advances in technology and the needs of people, organisations and society to create products, services and systems with purpose. IDE is a leader in design research across the application areas of mobility, sustainability and health, as well as its development of design tools and methods. A 350-strong research team and over 2,000 students work together in our inspiring hall, labs and studios. In close cooperation with industry, the public sector and NGOs we rehearse possible futures in research and education to design for a complex future. Click here to go to the website of the Faculty of Industrial Design Engineering. Conditions of employment Duration of contract is 12 months. Temporary. A job of 32-36 hours per week. A salary based on scale 8 or 10 will be applicable and is depending on graduation date and years of relevant work experience after graduation. With a salary between €3537 - €5760 gross per month based on a fulltime contract (38 hours), plus 8% holiday allowance and an end-of-year bonus of 8.3%. An excellent pension scheme via the ABP. The possibility to compile an individual employment package every year. Discount with health insurers on supplemental packages. Flexible working week. Every year, 232 leave hours (at 38 hours). You can also sell or buy additional leave hours via the individual choice budget. Plenty of opportunities for education, training and courses. Partially paid parental leave Attention for working healthy and energetically with the vitality program. Additional Information The project relies on close collaboration within the research team and with industrial partners. Successful candidates are therefore expected to relocate to Delft at the start of the project or shortly thereafter. These are fixed-term research appointments and do not lead to a PhD degree. For more information about this vacancy, please contact Jun Wu J.Wu-1@tudelft.nl Application procedure Are You Interested In This Vacancy? Please Apply No Later Than 15 October 2026 Via The Application Button And Upload The Following Documents Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Please Submit a CV; a motivation letter describing your background and interest in the position; and a portfolio (where relevant), showcasing previous projects or research. You can address your application to Jun Wu. Please Note You can apply online. We will not process applications sent by email and/or post. As part of knowledge security, TU Delft conducts a risk assessment during the recruitment of personnel. We do this, among other things, to prevent the unwanted transfer of sensitive knowledge and technology. The assessment is based on information provided by the candidates themselves, such as their motivation letter and CV, and takes place at the final stages of the selection process. When the outcome of the assessment is negative, the candidate will be informed. The processing of personal data in the context of the risk assessment is carried out on the legal basis of the GDPR: performing a public task in the public interest. title: Global Production Engineer
description: At Ottobock, we help people maintain or regain their freedom of movement. We develop and manufacture innovative medical devices, including prosthetics, orthotics, wheelchairs, and advanced material-based solutions. As a global leader in prosthetics, we operate in over 60 countries worldwide, with our headquarters located in Germany. We are looking for Global Production Engineer to join our team. The Global Production Engineer (Operation Lead) leads and coordinates production-related activities within PIP and Operations projects across the Bulgarian sites, ensuring delivery of quality, time, cost, and scope targets. The role drives industrialization, production readiness, design transfer, and ramp-up while leading cross-functional global teams and supporting manufacturing excellence, standardization, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Act as Operation Lead in the Product Innovation Process (PIP), responsible for the industrialization of new products and ensuring alignment with project goals, production requirements, and Ottobock’s global standards. Ensure manufacturability and scalability of product designs in close collaboration with R&D and Production. Lead and coordinate Make-or-Buy decisions in alignment with the global production strategy and in collaboration with Purchasing. Lead global Operations projects at the Bulgarian sites focused on improving efficiency, cost, quality, and production performance. Drive the implementation of robust, efficient, and scalable manufacturing processes in line with Lean Manufacturing principles and Ottobock’s global quality standards. Support the implementation and standardization of global manufacturing processes, technologies, and best practices. Lead global technology transfer and production setup projects at the Bulgarian sites. Coordinate process validation activities in alignment with global requirements and applicable quality standards. Act as the technical connection between local production sites and global process and engineering teams. Lead cross-functional project planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting. Share knowledge and facilitate training to ensure alignment, capability, and standardization across sites. Monitor and analyze process data to ensure process capability, stability, and continuous improvement. Define, monitor, and report process KPIs and provide recommendations for corrective and preventive actions. Compliance & Standards: • Ensure adherence to Ottobock’s quality and safety standards. • Support audits, CAPAs, and continuous improvement initiatives. • Maintain documentation in line with ISO 13485 and internal process frameworks. • Contribute to sustainability objectives through efficient resource use and waste reduction. Required Qualifications: Master’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of experience in process engineering, manufacturing engineering, or a similar role. Experience in global, multi-site, and cross-functional engineering projects is preferred. Experience in leading Design Transfer, Production Readiness, and New Product Introduction (NPI) activities from development through production ramp-up is preferred. Experience in leading cross-functional teams and managing production projects is preferred. Strong knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and process analysis tools is preferred. Experience with SAP and process documentation tools is preferred. Experience with project management methods and tools is preferred. Established network across Ottobock production sites is preferred. Fluent in English; German is an advantage. Key Competencies: Strategic thinking and problem-solving. Strong communication and stakeholder management. Analytical mindset and data-driven decision making. Global project management and cross-functional coordination. Continuous improvement mindset. Results-driven and quality-focused. Familiarity with international engineering and manufacturing standards. Adaptability and openness to travel. What we are offering: The unique opportunity to apply your professional expertise in a challenging environment and build up processes from the scratch. The chance to acquire valuable competencies in the presence of high quality standards. Perspectives for career development and growth within the global company. An attractive remuneration package based on your experience.
