title: PhD Position Unravelling Hydrogen-Induced Degradation and Fracture in Circular Steels
description: Join a cutting-edge research programme at TU Delft and investigate the mechanisms of hydrogen-induced degradation in circular steels. Job Description Within this project, you will investigate one of the key challenges facing the hydrogen economy: understanding how hydrogen interacts with the complex microstructures of circular steels and causes degradation and failure. This position is part of the project "Circularity as Opportunity: Engineering Hydrogen-Resistant Circular Steels (CIRHY)", a 6-year research and innovation programme developing next-generation circular steels that can safely operate in hydrogen environments. By combining advanced experiments with multiscale modelling, CIRHY aims to enable reliable and sustainable steels for future hydrogen infrastructure and industry. Hydrogen embrittlement is one of the major barriers to the safe deployment of hydrogen technologies. At the same time, increasing steel circularity introduces microstructural complexity through tramp elements, precipitates, inclusions and segregation phenomena. While considerable progress has been made in understanding hydrogen embrittlement in conventional steels, the mechanisms governing hydrogen-induced degradation and fracture in compositionally complex circular steels remain poorly understood. The Extreme Materials and Mechanics Group at TU Delft, led by Prof. Vera Popovich, is internationally recognized for its expertise in hydrogen embrittlement, fracture mechanics and advanced characterization of metallic materials. By combining state-of-the-art microscopy, hydrogen testing and fracture mechanics, the group develops fundamental understanding of material degradation in extreme environments and translates this knowledge into solutions for the energy transition. Within this position, you will combine advanced microstructural characterization, in-situ hydrogen mechanical testing and fracture toughness experiments to uncover how hydrogen interacts with circular steel microstructures and affects deformation, ductility, crack initiation and crack propagation. You will investigate hydrogen trapping and transport, identify the microstructural features controlling embrittlement and establish quantitative links between microstructure and structural performance. The outcome of this research, conducted in close collaboration with Tata Steel and other partners, will provide crucial experimental insights for designing safer and more reliable hydrogen-resistant circular steels. Role In this role, you will develop fundamental insights into the mechanisms governing hydrogen-induced degradation and failure of circular steels. As a PhD researcher, you will: Perform advanced 3D microstructural characterization of circular steels, focusing on segregation of tramp elements to precipitates, inclusions, interfaces, voids and dislocations. Investigate the influence of hydrogen on deformation behaviour and ductility through in-situ hydrogen mechanical testing. Quantify hydrogen transport, trapping and interaction with microstructural defects using advanced characterization techniques. Conduct in-situ hydrogen fracture toughness testing to identify crack initiation and propagation mechanisms. Collaborate closely with researchers from the Department of Materials Science and Engineering at TU Delft, University of Groningen, Eindhoven University of Technology, University of Twente, KU Leuven, MPI for Sustainable Materials and multiple industrial partners. Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations and dissemination activities within the M2i framework. Job Requirements We are looking for a highly motivated and curious researcher with a strong interest in materials degradation, hydrogen embrittlement and advanced experimental characterization. You enjoy working at the intersection of materials science, mechanics and microscopy, and are excited to contribute to the development of sustainable materials for the hydrogen economy. You are an independent thinker, eager to learn new experimental techniques, and enjoy collaborating with researchers from different disciplines as well as industrial partners. Furthermore, You Meet The Following Requirements You hold a Master's degree in Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Applied Physics, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline. You have a strong background in physical metallurgy, materials characterization, fracture mechanics, mechanical behaviour of materials, or a related field. Experience with one or more advanced characterization techniques such as SEM, EBSD, TEM, XRD, SIMS or related methods is highly desirable. Experience with mechanical testing, fracture mechanics, hydrogen embrittlement research or materials degradation is an advantage but not mandatory. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and enjoy combining experimental observations with scientific interpretation. You have a strong academic track record, demonstrated by excellent study results and/or research experience. You are enthusiastic about working in a multidisciplinary academic and industrial consortium. You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. title: Mekanik Tasarım Mühendisi
description: MEKANİK TASARIM MÜHENDİSİ İlan Hakkında HARPAX Sistem Teknolojileri, hava, kara ve deniz platformlarına yönelik kritik alt sistemlerin geliştirilmesi alanında faaliyet gösteren bir mühendislik şirketidir. ODTÜ Teknokent ofisimize, havacılık yakıt ve yağlama ekipmanları başta olmak üzere, elektro-mekanik alt sistemlerin, gereksinimden doğrulamaya kadar uzanan ürün geliştirme süreçlerine liderlik edecek, çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. İş Tanımı • Üst seviye sistem gereksinimlerini alt seviye mekanik tasarım gereksinimlerine dönüştürmek, tasarıma eksiksiz aktarmak ve doğrulama aşamasına kadar izlenebilirliğini sağlamak. • Literatür, standart ve pazar araştırmalarını yürüterek kavramsal tasarım, teknoloji geliştirme, prototipleme ve tasarım olgunlaştırma faaliyetlerini gerçekleştirmek. • İleri seviye 3B modelleme, 2B teknik resim hazırlama, Geometrik Ölçümlendirme ve Toleranslandırma (GD&T) ile tolerans yığılım (stack-up) analizlerini yürütmek. • Üretim ekipleriyle koordineli çalışarak Üretilebilirlik) ve Montajlanabilirlik değerlendirmelerini yapmak; tasarımları performans, güvenilirlik, ağırlık, maliyet ve çevrim süresi ekseninde optimize etmek. • Yapısal, akış ve termal analizlerin gerçekleştirilmesi amacı ile analiz ekipleriyle gerekli girdi ve çıktıların belirlenmesinde rol almak, analiz çıktıları mekanik tasarıma yansıtmak. • Çevresel ve fonksiyonel tasarım doğrulama testlerini test ekipleriyle birlikte yürütmek; testlerde gözlenen uyumsuzlukların kök neden analizlerini (RCA) yaparak tasarım düzeltici faaliyetlerini sonuçlandırmak. • Ürün Ağacı (BOM), Arayüz Kontrol Dokümanı (ICD), malzeme tanımları, montaj talimatları ve tasarım doğrulama raporlarını hazırlamak ve güncelliğini sağlamak. • Tasarım ve değişiklik yönetim süreçlerini kurumsal konfigürasyon, kalite standartları ve havacılık prosedürlerine uygun yürütmek. • Sistem, analiz, test, üretim, kalite, tedarik zinciri ve alt yükleniciler arasındaki teknik koordinasyonu sağlamak; iç ve dış paydaşlara teknik sunumlar gerçekleştirmek. Aranan Nitelikler • Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, Havacılık ve Uzay Mühendisliği, Uçak Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun (Tercihen yüksek lisans derecesine sahip). • Mekanik tasarım ve ürün geliştirme süreçlerinde en az 5 yıl sektör tecrübesi olan. • Tercihen pompa, döner ekipman, yakıt/yağlama sistemleri, hidrolik-pnömatik komponentler veya hassas mekanik mekanizmaların tasarımında doğrudan rol almış. • İleri düzeyde 3B parametrik modelleme ve teknik resim bilgisi (Tercihen CATIA V5/V6 tecrübesi; 3DEXPERIENCE veya benzeri PLM platformlarına hakimiyet). • Havacılık malzemeleri, makine elemanları, standart imalat yöntemleri, yüzey ve ısıl işlem süreçleri ile GD&T (ASME Y14.5 / ISO-GPS) standartlarına hakim. • Yapısal (FEA), termal veya hesaplamalı akışkanlar dinamiği (CFD) temel prensiplerini bilen ve analiz çıktılarını yorumlayabilen (Tercihen ANSYS deneyimi). • Havacılık kalifikasyon ve çevresel test standartlarına (MIL-STD-810, RTCA DO-160 vb.) aşina olmak, • Uluslararası literatürü, teknik standartları takip edebilecek ve raporlama/sunum yapabilecek düzeyde ileri teknik İngilizce bilgisi. • Güçlü analitik düşünme, sistematik problem çözme (kök neden analizi) ve çok disiplinli ekiplerle etkin çalışma/iletişim kabiliyeti. • Seyahat engeli bulunmayan, Ankara'da ikamet eden/edebilecek ve erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış ya da muaf.

title: Senior R&D Mechanical Engineer - International Aftermarket Services Team
description: Unlock Your Potential at Eaton: Where Diversity Drives Innovation. No matter where you come from, your aspirations matter to us. We believe in the power of different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds to ignite innovation and drive success. We're in the business of empowering people, and that includes you. Your journey here is not just about a job; it's about a shared vision for a brighter, more sustainable future. Our site in Ankara offers a fantastic learning environment and a vibrant array of career opportunities spanning medium-voltage product design, manufacturing, and sales. Combining agile R&D with internationally recognized test facilities, our team has the resources, speed, and flexibility to adapt to any customer demand. We support utility providers and renewable energy projects, as well as commercial and residential buildings, with innovative and cost-effective solutions. We aspire to be an all-encompassing medium-voltage center of excellence. Our team is currently growing fast as we ramp up our ability to support crucial trends like Industry 4.0, electrification, and the energy transition. Our work is enabling more agile and energy-efficient manufacturing, as well as driving forward electrification and the transition to smarter power grids dominated by renewables — helping to create a more sustainable future. Our employees are passionate about continuously improving and reaching their full potential, as well as enabling our facility to do the same. We’re always seeking dedicated and adaptable people with skills spanning engineering, sales, marketing, R&D, and manufacturing. If you’re curious and love innovating to solve new challenges, join us! This position reports to the Engineering Manager, R&D Aftermarket Services, and is part of the R&D Aftermarket Services team. The role works closely with the EMEA Services organization on several defined R&D projects, with sales impact ranging from €100K to €2M. The Services & Aftermarket EMEA business has a strong growth strategy supported by Eaton’s extensive installed base of Low Voltage and Medium Voltage systems, built over more than 60 years across the region. In line with Eaton’s sustainability objectives—and the broader global market shift toward sustainable solutions—many legacy products are currently transitioning to more environmentally friendly technologies. For example, oil‑insulated switchgear is progressively being replaced by vacuum‑insulated alternatives. This position is an on‑site role based in Sincan, Ankara. What You’ll Do Develop standardized mechanical retrofit design solutions for Aftermarket Low Voltage and Medium Voltage systems. Support business growth across the installed customer base. Defining new maintenance, upgrade, and digital service packages. Working closely with Marketing and service operations teams Support field service teams with engineering expertise Resolve complex technical issues and escalations. Provide root cause analysis for failures and reliability problems. Define technical specifications and create concept design options. Validate design concepts through engineering calculations and simulations. Perform detailed mechanical design and prepare final design documentation. Participate in laboratory testing and certification activities. Release finalized and certified designs for production. Collaborate within an international R&D team across multiple countries. Coordinate with laboratories, grid companies, EMEA Country Services Unites CSUs, production facilities, and suppliers. Contribute to building and maintaining a knowledge management and learning platform. Work on site in Ankara while collaborating remotely with teams in the Netherlands and India. Qualifications Master’s or Bachelor’s + degree in Mechanical Engineering. Minimum 5 years of experience in electrical industry/ mechanical engineering Skills Strong knowledge and experience with 3D CAD and PDM tools, as well as mechanical design within product development. Expert in innovation and continuous improvement Knowledge of Project management Strong in Change management Independent decision making skills Knowledge of installed base and lifecycle management Understanding of DFSS (Design for Six Sigma) principles. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. Accountable, creative, and aligned with Eaton’s Leadership Model behaviors. Demonstrates strong drive, ownership of tasks, and a sense of urgency to meet deadlines. Effective team player with the ability to collaborate across disciplines. Eagerness to learn and apply Eaton processes, project methodologies, and engineering tools. Ability to work effectively in a diverse, matrix organization with international teams in EMEA, India, and China. Willingness to travel to the Netherlands for up to one month when needed. Self‑starter with a high degree of independence and ownership. Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal. description: Context & Purpose of Role: izURET has excelled at providing high quality, timely, and cost-effective architectural services over the past 7 years for numerous projects in the United States and around the world. An engineering division was created at the beginning of 2025 to expand our services to our clients on each and every project. We are seeking to further expand our team of engineers and BIM modelers to tackle mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, and civil aspects of a wide range of projects spanning from retail, restaurant, grocery and refrigeration, and commercial buildings to heavy industrial, data centers and even hospitality. This position will initially focus on supporting a dedicated engineering team for a major US grocery and retail client, providing modeling, drafting, calculation, and coordination support for that client's refrigeration engineering group. As demand grows and skills develop, team members will have the opportunity to flex into other engineering assignments across Trelity's broader project base. This position sets the stage for career advancement as we are finding a high demand for these services. This person will be working with and learning directly from the Engineering Manager as well as several peers with an extensive range of backgrounds and experiences. This position will require flexibility and adaptability as we seek to address our clients’ wide-ranging requests and grow our capabilities project by project. This role includes structured, hands on mentorship in refrigeration engineering from experienced US based client engineers, in addition to Trelity's internal training and support. Job Description: Lead mechanical HVAC and plumbing modeling and construction drawing development efforts in both AutoCAD and/or Revit based on direction provided by client and Engineering Manager. Perform basic mechanical HVAC and plumbing calculations in accordance with US code requirements and guidance from supervisors. Support refrigeration system design efforts, including modeling, drafting, and coordination of refrigeration equipment layouts, piping, and line sizing, under the direction of client refrigeration engineers and Trelity leadership. Coordinate mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and structural information between the refrigeration team and other disciplines to support accurate and well coordinated project delivery. Learn refrigeration codes, terminology, and industry standard practices through structured mentorship from US based client engineers and Trelity's senior technical staff. Understand and apply company-wide QAQC controls and standards. Prepare basic reports, specifications, and simple system designs. Research code compliance requirements specific to the project locations and advise on project adherence to these codes. Manage time spent completing project deliverables within prescribed budget and schedule. Effectively manage all assigned projects according to their Project Brief scope. Meet all “Expectations” listed below. Essential Expectations: Fulfill our brand promises: High Quality, On Time In Full, No Surprises, Good Design Judgement Essential Qualifications: University degree in Engineering. 1+ years AEC industry experience; refrigeration specific experience is not required. Strong Autodesk Revit/AutoCAD experience. Strong experience with MS Office programs. Experience in performance of analysis and design calculations of HVAC and plumbing systems is preferable. Eagerness to learn refrigeration engineering fundamentals through direct mentorship from experienced US based client engineers, valued more than prior project leadership experience. Interest in managing people, projects, and client communication. Fluent in English at C1 level, able to communicate comfortably with clients based in the USA, both in understanding and verbally expressing ideas. Key Attributes: Patient with repetitive work. High quality focus & detail orientation. Desire to grow as a person and professional. Questioning attitude, seeks understanding. Open to supporting questions/needs that come from team members. Ambitious, Collaborative, Persistent. Values align with our Core Values. Comfortable receiving close, ongoing mentorship from client side engineers, and adaptable enough to move between refrigeration focused work and other project types as assignments shift. Growth Paths: This is an internal position at izURET and we expect that the next steps from this role will be becoming: Mechanical Associate Coordinator – if you love mechanical engineering/design and wish to lead, develop, and train other mechanical associates, this could be your next step. Engineering Program Coordinator – if you like management and coordinating the flow of information to a diverse team, structuring their time and resources to achieve a shared goal, this could be your next step. Refrigeration Design Lead: if you want to deepen your specialization in refrigeration engineering and help grow this practice area, this could be your next step.

title: Sr. R&D Engineer
description: Our Story Pointr is the market leader in Indoor Mapping, Location and Analytics, and the inventor of AI-based map production. Its innovative (20+ patents) Pointr Maps™ platform is used by millions of users across offices, retail locations, airports, hospitals, and more every month. As the top choice of Fortune 100 customers and billions of sqft. deployed globally (30+ countries), Pointr is always on the lookout for great team members to support its fast growth. Our core values are Ownership , Harmony , and Scale , and we look for Passionate, Kind, and No-Ego team members to join the team. Role Overview We're looking for a Sr. R&D Engineer to join the Location team and improve the positioning engine behind Pointr's blue dot offering, used in airports, hospitals, and corporate campuses. The engine turns noisy real-world sensor data into a reliable location estimate, indoors and outdoors. It runs primarily on iOS and Android, with the shared C++ core also supporting WebAssembly and backend services. You will take algorithm improvements from research through implementation, validation on real venue data, and release. The work spans probabilistic estimation, sensor fusion, and applied geometry, including the native mobile scanning code that supplies the engine's measurements. You'll join a small, senior team with ownership over technical decisions and a short path from experiments to customer deployments. What You'll Do Improve the accuracy, responsiveness, and robustness of Pointr's indoor-outdoor positioning algorithms across a wide range of venue types, devices, and real-world conditions. Research, develop, and evaluate positioning algorithms, spanning classical estimation and machine learning approaches, and measure whether they improve results on real venue data. Research and investigate emerging positioning technologies. Some work involves development kits, reference hardware, and measurement setups for capabilities not yet available on shipping phones. Build and use offline replay, accuracy regression suites, and simulation tools to measure improvements. Validate on real iOS and Android devices, where sensor behavior and runtime constraints can differ from desktop results. Develop production code in the shared C++ engine and the native iOS and Android sensor and radio scanning layers, with attention to performance, memory use, thread safety, and test coverage. Turn field issues, such as suboptimal hardware deployments or unexpected sensor behavior, into reproducible test cases and engine improvements. Use AI coding agents daily for research and development, and take responsibility for reviewing and validating their output. Shape technical decisions through experiments and code review. Document the reasoning behind your work and contribute invention disclosures where warranted. What Success Looks Like First 90 days: independently run and interpret the accuracy measurement tools, and ship your first engine improvement with tests and on-device validation. 6 months: own a significant area of the engine, deliver measurable positioning improvements, and diagnose field issues from customer venues. 12 months: set technical direction and measurement standards for your area, with improvements deployed at customer scale. Help the team develop and validate algorithms more effectively through reviews and better tooling. What We Seek 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including performance-sensitive production code. Depth in algorithms and estimation matters more than your current programming language; prior C++ experience is preferred, not required. Strong grounding in probabilistic state estimation and sensor fusion, including recursive Bayesian filtering and particle-based methods, with the judgment to choose an approach suited to the problem. Solid applied mathematics, including linear algebra, probability, numerical methods, and geometry. You can distinguish model limitations from data quality problems. Experience working with noisy, real-world sensor time series: reproducing issues from recorded traces, isolating causes, and validating changes with measurable results and automated tests. Daily use of AI coding agents and a basic understanding of how they work, including context windows, tool use, prompting, instruction files, and common failure modes. You can direct agents effectively and critically review their output. Working knowledge of iOS or Android development, enough to build and debug on real devices and modify native platform code. Comfort with native development tools, including build systems, Git, compilers, sanitizers, and profilers, and with cross-platform constraints. Clear technical communication with engineers and non-engineers, and a collaborative approach to technical disagreements and code review. Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken. Preferred Qualifications Experience in indoor positioning, GNSS, robotics, SLAM, pedestrian dead reckoning, or RF signal processing. Hands-on experience with Claude Code or OpenAI Codex; other AI coding agents also qualify. Experience building agent tools or integrations is a plus. Experience with modern C++, Swift, or Kotlin, or shipping a shared native core in iOS and Android apps. Familiarity with mobile constraints that affect positioning, including background execution, sensor and radio scanning APIs, power budgets, and device differences. Knowledge of ranging and positioning methods used with radio technologies such as BLE, UWB, or Wi-Fi. Experience with computational geometry, geospatial data, or map processing. Wayfinding and graph algorithms are useful secondary skills. Experience applying machine learning to motion or signal models, with evidence that it improves on classical estimation methods. Experience building simulation or visualization tools for algorithm development. An MS or PhD in a relevant field, research publications, or equivalent demonstrated depth in positioning, estimation,

description: Position Purpose At GAMA Enerji, we are looking for a motivated professional to join our Asset Performance & Modelling team and enhance the operational performance of our assets. Preparing regular analyses and reports on market prices, power plant performance, and model outputs; developing automated reporting solutions integrated with company systems using Power BI or similar business intelligence tools, Contributing to the development of data infrastructure and digitalization initiatives in coordination with the IT team; supporting data collection, processing and the integration of models and reports into company systems and business processes, to ensure their the effective and sustainable use. Qualifications & Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related discipline, preferably from a reputable university, 1–3 years of relevant experience in electricity markets, energy trading, power generation operations, or data analytics, Fluency in Turkish and English, written and spoken. title: Grid Connection & Modelling Engineer
description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Grid Connection & Modelling Engineer, you will develop and validate electrical simulation models for wind turbines and renewable energy power plants, ensuring compliance with grid code requirements and project commitments. You will perform power system studies, prepare technical documentation, and collaborate with engineering, sales, and customer teams to provide expert support on grid connection and modelling topics while contributing to the continuous improvement of Siemens Energy's modelling solutions. How You’ll Make an Impact Ensure timely delivery of models, avoiding project delays and potential penalties. Develop and configure electrical models for customer delivery according to project contractual obligations and deadlines. Prepare technical reports demonstrating compliance with project-specific grid code requirements. Transfer technical knowledge into wind turbine product models delivered to customers. Support internal and external customers regarding simulation & model-related issues. Support Sales during customer meetings and contract negotiations concerning wind turbine electrical systems. Participate in defining and maintaining the company's electrical modelling roadmap. Prepare and maitain documentation, including: design reports, validation reports, user manuals. Generate and/or integrate automatically generated code into the modelling & simulation efforts. Prepare grid code analysis reports for customer projects. Provide generic electrical support regarding wind turbine generator (WTG) capabilities. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical&Electronics Engineering, Control Engineering, or a relevant field.MSc and/or PhD is a strong advantage. Specialization in grid connection of wind power and power system studies. Ideally 5+ years of experience in power systems analysis or similar experience in the educational sector. High level of written and spoken English. Software & Programming Skills: Experience with at least one of the power system simulation tools such as: DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSS®E, PSCAD, EMTP-RV, MATLAB & Simulink. More is a big plus. Expertise on Grid Connection & Power System Studies: Wind farm grid connection, load flow, harmonics, short circuit, dynamic and transient stability studies, and grid code compliance analysis. Expertise on Electrical Engineering & Renewable Energy: Transmission and distribution networks, power electronics, electrical machines, grid interaction (SSR, SSCI, weak grids), wind energy principles, DFIG/full converter technologies, and renewable energy systems (wind, PV, storage). Expertise on Modelling, Simulation & Control: Development and simulation of wind farms, power systems, control algorithms, wind turbine models, renewable power plant controls, and integration of compiled code into simulation tools. title: Research, Simulations
description: Employment type: Full time - Hybrid Compensation: 250.000 – 500.000 TL net per month · equity · private health insurance About Talp Talp is simulation infrastructure for enterprise decisions. We build a company’s customer base from its own behavioral data so decisions can be tested before they are made, and we already work with large enterprises across three regions. We are the wind tunnel for decisions. What we install stays and sharpens every time it runs, which is why we call it infrastructure rather than a tool. Testing decisions this way will soon be as ordinary as version control. We have raised $2.2 million to date, most recently at a $25 million valuation, from Formus Capital, Sunshine Lake Ventures, Aito Capital, the a16z Scout Fund, and a group of GPs and founders. The Role Everyone in this field renders the simulation. Nobody renders the proof. Confidence scores, calibration methods, benchmarks measured against human evidence. None of it has been published by anyone in this category, and the company that publishes it first will define how everybody else gets measured. That is the center of this job. You will participate in shaping our scientific direction and turn research into working systems. Your scope spans modeling, evaluation, and the infrastructure that supports experimentation and deployment. This is a hands-on role. You will design experiments, write code, inspect data, and work closely with engineering. You should be comfortable asking difficult scientific questions and taking full responsibility for how they are answered. Responsibilities Shape the research direction: Identify the most valuable questions, prioritize experiments, and connect scientific progress directly to product improvements. Develop and improve models: Work across data preparation, model adaptation, training, and fine-tuning. Reproduce relevant research, challenge its assumptions, and test approaches against strong alternatives. Define how quality is measured: Design benchmarks and experiments that assess behavioral accuracy, consistency, and usefulness. Compare simulations against human evidence while accounting for uncertainty, population variance, and data limitations. Build reliable evaluation systems: Develop repeatable workflows for comparing models, investigating failures, and detecting regressions. Keep datasets, experiments, and results strictly traceable, protecting evaluation data from leaking into development. Combine human and automated judgment: Create clear scoring criteria, review processes, and automated evaluators, then verify that those evaluators consistently agree with qualified human reviewers. Make research practical to run: Partner with engineering on data pipelines, experiment tracking, training workflows, and model serving to maximize iteration speed, reliability, and compute efficiency. Carry improvements into production: Follow promising results through implementation and deployment, verifying that their advantages hold outside the original experiment. Set the scientific standard: Establish clear standards for rigor, and communicate findings through technical writing, publications, and external collaborations. Who You Are Applied Research Record: A strong track record in applied AI or machine learning research, with evidence of taking ideas from experiments into working production systems. Deep Model Experience: Hands-on experience with language models, modern training/fine-tuning techniques, and rigorous model evaluation. Core Engineering Skills: Strong Python skills and deep familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX. Sound Statistical Judgment: You reason intuitively about sampling, uncertainty, and bias, and can tell immediately whether an apparent improvement is statistically meaningful. Systems & Tooling Ownership: Experience building or owning research tooling, evaluation pipelines, or ML infrastructure that other engineers rely on. High Agency: The ability to drive technical work autonomously and make clear decisions even when the empirical evidence is incomplete. Intellectual Honesty: Clear communication and the willingness to discard an approach the moment the data challenges it. Typically five or more years of relevant AI or ML research experience. Relevant academic research counts toward this; we also welcome candidates with exceptional demonstrated impact on a shorter timeline. Valuable Additional Experience Behavioral science, computational social science, causal inference, or experimental design Synthetic data generation, human feedback loops, annotation systems, or complex behavioral datasets Multi-agent systems and simulations involving interacting populations Distributed training, GPU optimization, or efficient model serving You do not need equal depth in every area. We look for deep research instincts combined with strong engineering ability. A PhD is welcome but not required. Our Process We prioritize thoughtful conversations and clear examples of past work. Our hiring process is designed to help both sides align on mutual fit, working style, and expectations. Reapplication Policy: To ensure a fair and thorough evaluation for all applicants, Talp observes a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. Equal Opportunity Talp is an equal opportunity workplace. We welcome applicants of every background and identity. If you need support or an accommodation at any point in the process, let us know and we will arrange it.

Görev Ve Sorumluluklar Ürün ve alt sistemlere yönelik test, doğrulama ve kalifikasyon faaliyetlerinin planlanması ve yürütülmesi, Sistem/ürün gereksinimlerinin incelenerek uygun test yöntemlerinin, test prosedürlerinin ve test senaryolarının oluşturulması, Çevresel ve fonksiyonel testlerin gerçekleştirilmesi ve/veya ilgili test faaliyetlerinin koordinasyonunun sağlanması, Test düzeneklerinin kurulması, ölçüm ve veri toplama sistemlerinin kullanılması, Test sırasında elde edilen verilerin analiz edilmesi ve teknik sonuçların raporlanması, Testlerde karşılaşılan hata ve uygunsuzlukların incelenmesi, kök neden çalışmalarına katkı sağlanması ve tekrar testlerinin gerçekleştirilmesi, Tasarım ve üretim ekipleriyle koordineli çalışarak ürün geliştirme süreçlerine teknik geri bildirim sağlanması, Proje gereksinimleri doğrultusunda test kayıtlarının ve teknik dokümantasyonun hazırlanması ve takibinin yapılması. Aradığımız Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği, Mekatronik Mühendisliği, Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun, Test ve doğrulama süreçlerinde çalışmaya istekli, analitik düşünme ve problem çözme yeteneği güçlü, Teknik resim, şartname ve mühendislik dokümanlarını okuyup yorumlayabilen, Ölçüm cihazları, sensörler ve test ekipmanları konusunda bilgi sahibi, Test sonuçlarını analiz edebilecek ve teknik rapor haline getirebilecek, Disiplinler arası ekip çalışmasına yatkın, sorumluluk sahibi ve sonuç odaklı, Teknik dokümantasyonu takip edebilecek seviyede İngilizce bilgisine sahip. Tercih Sebebidir Savunma, havacılık veya benzeri yüksek güvenilirlik gerektiren sektörlerde test tecrübesi, MIL-STD-810 ve ilgili çevresel test standartları hakkında bilgi/tecrübe, Titreşim, şok, sıcaklık, nem ve benzeri çevresel testler konusunda deneyim, Sensörler, veri toplama (DAQ) sistemleri ve test/ölçüm cihazları konusunda uygulamalı deneyim, Test prosedürü, test raporu ve doğrulama dokümantasyonu hazırlama tecrübesi. Savunma sanayiinin yüksek mühendislik standartlarına sahip projelerinde; tasarımdan üretime, testten doğrulamaya kadar ürünün gerçek mühendislik sürecinin içerisinde yer alacak bir ekip arkadaşı arıyoruz. Teknik problemlerin üzerine gitmeyi, sahada ve laboratuvarda çalışmayı ve ortaya çıkan ürünün performansını bizzat doğrulamayı seviyorsanız başvurunuzu bekliyoruz.

title: QA Engineer
description: About AppNation We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide. Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 90M+ users globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries. We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions. About the Role We're looking for a QA Engineer to join Genie Studio and ensure the quality and reliability of Genie, our AI-powered assistant used by millions worldwide. You’ll own testing end-to-end across iOS, Android, and Web, covering AI-powered experiences, revenue-critical flows, releases, and A/B tests. Working closely with Product and Engineering, you’ll combine hands-on testing, automation, and strong user perspective to catch issues early and help us ship reliable experiences at scale. What You’ll Do Own Testing Across Platforms: Plan and execute functional, exploratory and regression testing for Genie on iOS, Android and Web. Test AI-Powered Experiences: Validate chat flows, streamed responses and model updates, and catch quality issues in non-deterministic outputs that traditional test cases miss. Guard Every Release: Run smoke and regression cycles, validate release candidates, and give a clear go/no-go signal for every build. Test Revenue-Critical Flows: Ensure subscriptions, paywalls, trials, renewals and web checkout work correctly across platforms and pricing configurations. Validate A/B Tests: Verify that experiments are set up correctly, users land in the right variants, and each variant behaves and tracks as expected. Detect, Report and Track Bugs: Write clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira, prioritize them with Product and Engineering, and follow them through to verification. Be Part of the Sprint: Join planning and grooming, review requirements early, surface edge cases and risks, and help define acceptance criteria. Automate & Improve: Build and maintain automated tests for web and mobile, keep test plans and regression suites up to date, and drive practical improvements to our QA process and tooling. What We Look For Experience: 3+ years of hands-on QA in consumer mobile and/or web products, ideally in a fast-paced environment. Mobile & Web Testing: Strong experience testing iOS and Android apps and web applications across devices, OS versions and browsers. Release Ownership: Proven experience running regression cycles and validating releases, including App Store and Google Play release processes (TestFlight, internal testing tracks). Subscription & Payment Testing: Hands-on experience with StoreKit and Google Play Billing sandbox environments and/or web payment flows. Technical Skills: Comfortable with API testing (e.g., Postman), reading device logs, network debugging tools (e.g., Charles, Proxyman), Jira and test management tools. Test Automation: Hands-on experience with Playwright, and with Appium or Selenium. Ownership & Communication: Able to work as the sole QA in a team, set your own priorities, make sound quality judgments without close supervision, and communicate risks clearly to Product and Engineering. User Perspective: You think like an end user and care about delivering reliable experiences to millions of people. Nice to Have Experience testing AI/LLM-based products Familiarity with A/B testing tools and analytics event validation Why AppNation? Build and scale products reaching millions of users globally. Work with talented people in a fast-moving AI-first environment. Take ownership and see your impact directly in the products you build. Grow quickly with opportunities to lead projects and shape technical decisions. Enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance, meal and commute support, relocation support, and flexible working options. Our Hiring Process Application Review → Interview → Technical Assessment → Final Interviews At AppNation, we set ambitious goals and challenge ourselves to build products that reach millions of people. We value curiosity, ownership, and continuous growth. If this role excites you and you're ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now—we're excited to meet you.

title: Senior AQA Engineer
description: We are seeking a skilled Senior QA Automation Engineer With 5+ years of experience to join our Gaming Hub team. This role focuses on backend and API testing for player-facing platform services in an iGaming environment. You will design, develop and own automated test solutions that ensure reliable, secure and performant backend systems. Experience in iGaming (or similar real-time/transactional domains) is strongly preferred. Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain automated testing frameworks and scripts focused on backend services and APIs Identify and prioritise test cases for automation (smoke, regression, integration, contract and non-functional) Build and maintain automated API tests, contract tests and integration test suites for microservices and platform components Develop and run performance, load, stress and stability tests; analyse results and drive remediation with engineering teams Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and gating flows; own flakiness reduction and test reliability; and be responsible for test outcome reporting and stakeholder communication Work closely with developers, SREs and product to reproduce, triage and resolve issues; drive observability improvements to aid root-cause analysis Define and maintain test data and environment strategies (sandbox tenants, testing flags, user configuration profiles) Participate in design refinements, feature planning, team ceremonies and product releases Mentor and collaborate with QA peers to raise automation maturity and testing practices Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience Strong experience with automation frameworks and tools for backend/API testing (examples: pytest, Postman/Newman, Cypress, Playwright) Proficient in one or more programming languages used for automation: Python or JavaScript/TypeScript Experience testing RESTful APIs, including contract/schema validation and end-to-end integration testing Familiarity with service virtualisation / mocking tools and containerised test environments; basic knowledge of orchestration (Kubernetes) is a plus Hands-on with CI/CD (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar) and automation integration into pipelines Strong understanding of software testing best practices and methodologies (including test design, flaky test mitigation, CI gating) Knowledge of observability and monitoring tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, New Relic) to validate behaviour in staging/production Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams Excellent problem-solving, analytical and communication skills; fluency in English (written & verbal) Experience designing and executing performance/load tests (k6, JMeter, Locust, or similar) Benefits Private health insurance Company wide social and team building activities Hybrid & Remote work arrangements Flexible working hours Wellbeing day; Training and Development opportunities Logifuture operates across seven countries, with headquarters in Malta and additional offices in the UK (London), Italy (Parma & Lecce), Austria (Innsbruck), Serbia (Kragujevac), Romania (Bucharest) and UAE (Dubai). The majority of our roles listed on our careers page are not restricted by location, giving prospective employees the flexibility to choose any of our offices. Furthermore, we also collaborate with consultants based outside these locations, broadening our talent pool and allowing us to remain agile and competitive in the global market. In addition at Logifuture we embrace equality and diversity. We do not discriminate and our values of delivering results together support this statement. We are determined to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to contribute their unique skills and experiences.

title: Lider Test Mühendisi
description: STM Savunma Teknolojileri Mühendislik ve Ticaret A.Ş. olarak, savunma teknolojilerinin geleceğini şekillendiren projelerde görev alacak; uzmanlığını geliştirmek, sorumluluk alanını büyütmek ve gerçek etki üretmek isteyen profesyonellerle tanışmak istiyoruz. İleri teknoloji projelerinde sorumluluk alabileceğiniz, teknik uzmanlığınızı yönetsel ve kişisel gelişim olanaklarıyla destekleyebileceğiniz bu yolculukta; çalışan gelişimini ve deneyimini merkeze alan yapımız ile sürdürülebilir başarıyı ve sürekli gelişimi esas alan bir kariyer fırsatı sunuyoruz. Bu anlayışla; bilgi ve deneyimini geliştirmek isteyen, katkı sunmaktan heyecan duyan adaylarımızı Kalite, Test ve Süreç Yönetimi Müdürlüğü projelerinde görev almak üzere Lider Test Mühendisi pozisyonunda ekibimizin bir parçası olmaya davet ediyoruz. Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Sistem, alt sistem ve entegrasyon seviyesinde doğrulama ve geçerli kılma faaliyetlerinin planlanması ve yürütülmesi Sistem gereksinimlerinden test senaryoları, test prosedürleri ve kabul kriterlerinin oluşturulması Yazılım, donanım ve sistem seviyesinde fonksiyonel testlerin gerçekleştirilmesi HIL (Hardware In the Loop), SIL (Software In the Loop) ve simülasyon tabanlı test altyapılarının kullanılması ve geliştirilmesine katkı sağlanması Uçuş kontrol sistemleri, görev bilgisayarları, sensörler ve haberleşme alt sistemlerinin doğrulanması Laboratuvar ve saha testlerinde aktif görev alınması Test sonuçlarının analiz edilmesi, hata yönetimi ve doğrulama raporlarının hazırlanması Geliştirme ekipleriyle koordineli çalışarak ürün kalitesinin ve güvenilirliğinin artırılmasına katkı sağlanması MIL-STD-810H standardına uygun çevresel şartlar (titreşim, şok, sıcaklık, nem, yağmurlama vb.) testlerinin planlanması, yürütülmesi, analiz edilmesi ve raporlanması. Kimi Arıyoruz? Elektrik-Elektronik, Bilgisayar, Yazılım, Mekatronik, Havacılık ve Uzay veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun İlgili pozisyonlarda minimum 8 yıl tecrübeli, Sistematik düşünme ve analitik problem çözme yetkinliğine sahip Gereksinim bazlı test yaklaşımı konusunda bilgi sahibi Yazılım ve donanım test süreçlerine ilgi duyan Takım çalışmasına yatkın, sorumluluk sahibi ve öğrenmeye açık Gereksinim yönetimi, gereksinim izlenebilirliği ve konfigürasyon yönetimi süreçleri ile bu süreçlerde kullanılan Jira, Xray, Git, SVN veya benzeri araçlar hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak Test otomasyonu, Python, C++ veya benzeri programlama dillerinden en az birini kullanabiliyor olmak Seyahat engeli bulunmayan. Tercih Sebebi Olabilecek Yetkinlikler Savunma sanayii projelerinde görev almış olmak Tercihen İHA-1 Sertifikasına sahip Haberleşme sistemleri, RF veri linkleri, sensör teknolojileri ve gömülü sistemler konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak İnsansız Hava Araçlarının (İHA) temel çalışma prensipleri, alt sistemleri ve görev konseptleri hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak MIL-STD-810H standardı kapsamında çevresel testler konusunda bilgi veya uygulama deneyimine sahip olmak. #MilliMühendislikteSenVarsın #BuKariyerdeSenVarsın

title: Kalibrasyon Mühendisi
description: Merhaba! Biz; anlam dolu ve çalışmaktan gurur duyduğumuz bir iş yapıyoruz. GÖKBEY’i, HÜRJET’i, KAAN’ı, ANKA-III'ü, GÖKTÜRK-Y'yi ve daha nicelerini üretiyoruz! Birbirimize saygı duyduğumuz, gelişim fırsatlarıyla dolu iş ortamımızda hem kendimizi hem de havacılık ve uzay geleceğini şekillendiriyoruz. Aramıza katılarak, keşif tutkunu ve merak duygunu, gurur ve cesur hamlelerle tamamlayacak; son teknolojiyle alanında öncü ürünler geliştirirken anlam ve gelişim dolu bir geleceğe adım atacaksın. Bitmek tükenmek bilmeyen keşif tutkusu, merak, azim ve cesaretle yüksekleri hedefliyorsan, seninle # GÖZÜMÜZYÜKSEKLERDE! Sen? Elektrik, Elektronik, Makine, Mekatronik veya Fizik Mühendisliklerinden Lisans derecesine sahipsen, İyi derecede İngilizce biliyorsan, (TOEFL IBT 84+, IELTS 6.5+, TOMER 79+, ITEP 4+) ISO/IEC 17025 akreditasyon süreci konusunda bilgi sahibiysen, Ölçüm teknikleri ve bunlara ilişkin ölçüm belirsizliği hesapları konusunda bilgi sahibiysen, MS Office programlarına hakimsen, Ekip çalışmasına uyumluysan, Aşağıdaki konulardan en az bir tanesinde tecrübe sahibiysen, Kuvvet ölçüm cihazları/tezgahları kalibrasyonu, Tork kalibrasyonu, ISO 7500-1, ISO 376 standartlarına göre kalibrasyon, Yük hücresi (load cell) kalibrasyonu, Sıcaklık kalibrasyonu, Sıvı akış ölçer kalibrasyonu, SAE AMS2750 standardına göre kalibrasyon, aradığımız yetenek SENSİN Bize Ne Katacaksın? Metroloji ve Kalibrasyon yönetimi alanında, Kalibrasyon talimatları ve prosedürlerini hazırlayacak, Kalibrasyonun icrası, sertifikasının hazırlanması ve gözden geçirilmesi, kalibrasyon sonuçlarının yorumlanması, cihazın etiketlenmesi ve sisteme işlenmesi sürecinde aktif katılımı olacak, Kalibrasyon sertifikalarının güncelliğini sağlayacak ve ölçüm belirsizliği hesabını gerçekleştirecek, Yerli ve yabancı pek çok müşteri tarafından yapılan denetimlere hazırlanacak / katılacak, Gereken noktalarda eğitim verecek, yatırımlar için teknik komisyonlara dahil olup metrolojik destek verecek, Kalibrasyon taleplerini gözden geçirip değerlendirme yapacak, İlgili bölümlere metrolojik destek verecek, Kalibrasyon sürecinin herhangi bir aşamasında karşılaştığı sorunları çözecek ve gereken iyileştirmeleri yapacak, Revizyon ihtiyacı olan kalibrasyon yönergelerini belirleyip revizyon işlemini yapacak, Kalibrasyonların belirlenen takvim içerisinde ilerlemesini koordine ve kontrol edecek Sorumluluk alanındaki personel ve cihaz kapasite planlamalarını yapacak, Laboratuvar referanslarının dış kalibrasyon ihtiyacını belirleyecek, gereken hizmet alımı sürecini gerçekleştirecek, Kabiliyetimiz dışındaki cihazların kalibrasyonu için dış kalibrasyon hizmet alım sürecini işleterek takip edecek, Ekip içinde çalışıp ekibi yönlendirecek, bu katkılarınla havacılık ve uzay geleceğini şekillendireceksin. Seni Ne Güçlendirir? Kalibrasyon süreçlerinde deneyime sahip olman, İyi ve akıcı bir İngilizce’ye sahip olman, Denetim deneyimine sahip olman, ISO 7500-1, ISO 376 standartlarına ve AMS 2750 standardına göre kalibrasyon deneyimine sahip olman, ISO/IEC 17025 akreditasyon süreci konusunda bilgi sahibi olman, MS Office programlarına hakim olman, Kariyerine Ne Katacağız? title: Senior Design Engineer
description: Shape the Future of Tissue Technology as a Senior Design Engineer Are you ready for the next step in your engineering career? Join a highly skilled team in Karlstad where you will help design market-leading tissue machines used by customers around the world. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues throughout the delivery chain, turning customer needs into tailored technical solutions. You will have the opportunity to develop both your design expertise and your involvement in customer projects while contributing to innovative, sustainable industrial solutions. Your Responsibilities You will create detailed drawings and technical documentation that support purchasing, manufacturing, and assembly of tissue machines. You will collaborate with engineers, project managers, production teams, and pre-assembly functions to deliver high-quality customer solutions. You will contribute to the ongoing development, maintenance, and improvement of products, machine sections, and components. You will translate customer requirements into practical and effective mechanical design solutions. You will support customer projects from design through delivery and occasionally travel when required. Expectations for you You hold a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering and have experience in mechanical design. You have experience and a strong interest in mechanical product development and design engineering. You communicate confidently in written and spoken English. Experience from the paper, tissue, or process industry is considered a strong advantage. Some travel may be required as part of the role. To succeed in this role You enjoy combining technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and take ownership of your work from concept to delivery. Strong communication skills, problem-solving ability, and a structured approach will help you succeed in a role that involves close interaction with colleagues across engineering, production, and project teams. You are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve products and processes. We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles, Practical Behaviours That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value We offer You will join one of four engineering teams consisting of approximately 60 engineers working on world-leading tissue machine technology. The team combines expertise in mechanical design and technical project management, creating excellent opportunities for professional growth and knowledge sharing. As your experience grows, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of specific machine sections and components, becoming a key technical expert within your area. The role provides close collaboration with production and pre-assembly teams, giving you a valuable end-to-end understanding of the products you help create. At Valmet, you'll work in an international and people-focused environment where innovation, sustainability, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do. We value continuous learning and offer opportunities for professional development, modern work tools, and a supportive culture where your ideas and contributions matter. Want to know more? Please send your application as soon as possible via the link provided, but no later than October 2nd, 2026. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Lars Gustavsson, Manager Dry End Section, at lars.o.gustavsson@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email. We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace. When everything works together Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. Join the team and lead the way with us! www.valmet.com/careers

description: Syngenia est à la recherche d’un Ingénieur Calcul Structure - ABAQUS H/F sur Bouguenais (44). Missions Vous réalisez des simulations numériques par éléments finis sur des structures métalliques dans le cadre du projet EPR2. Vous développez et exploitez des modèles complexes sous ABAQUS en calcul implicite. Vous modélisez des éléments coques, poutres et connecteurs, en intégrant des comportements non linéaires. Vous gérez les non-linéarités de contact ainsi que les problématiques de grands déplacements et de grandes déformations. Vous pilotez la convergence de calculs fortement non linéaires, notamment en présence de phénomènes de flambement. Vous définissez, réglez et contrôlez les paramètres nécessaires à la robustesse des simulations. Vous gérez et structurez les jeux de données ABAQUS à partir de fichiers texte et de modèles paramétriques. Vous utilisez HYPERMESH pour la définition des géométries et la création des maillages. Vous développez ou exploitez des scripts Python pour la préparation des calculs et l’analyse des résultats. Vous rédigez la documentation technique et les livrables associés en français Profil Vous êtes ingénieur en mécanique des structures avec une spécialisation en simulation numérique par éléments finis. Vous maîtrisez le logiciel ABAQUS, notamment en calcul implicite et en modélisation non linéaire complexe. Vous possédez une première expérience significative, ou plus de 7 ans d’expérience, sur des calculs industriels complexes. Vous avez une bonne connaissance de l’architecture des jeux de données ABAQUS, des mots-clés associés et de la modélisation paramétrique. Vous faites preuve d’une grande rigueur dans la gestion de multiples configurations de calcul et disposez de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles en français. Offre Travailler chez Syngenia ou pour ses partenaires, c’est travailler votre talent et votre expertise.Nous vous offrons la possibilité de travailler sur des projets stimulants dans le monde entier et de conseiller vos clients en fonction de vos connaissances. En collaboration avec vos collègues, vous aurez la chance d’investir dans votre carrière. En outre, vous pouvez compter sur un package salarial attractif en fonction de vos connaissances et de votre expérience. Prenez en main votre carrière et développez votre réseau d’ingénierie, devenez un consultant Syngenia

title: Ingeniero de Simulación de Cálculo Estructural (m/f/d)
description: PARA QUÉ LE BUSCAMOS Desde Rheinmetall Expal Munitions, nos encontramos en búsqueda de nuevos perfiles para nuestro departamento de Simulación. En este puesto, realizarás el análisis de la respuesta mecánica de estructuras bajo cargas extremas, aceleraciones transitorias y fenómenos no lineales. El trabajo consiste en estudiar el comportamiento estructural de los productos de la empresa y el utillaje utilizado en pruebas de ensayo teniendo en cuenta las cargas, la elevada rotación y los problemas asociados a momentos clave de la operativa del producto. Competencias Clave en ANSYS: ANSYS Mechanical / LS-DYNA / Autodyn: Dominio de trabajo de solucionadores explícitos (explicit dynamics) para problemas de choque, impacto, penetración o altas aceleraciones. Modelado de Materiales No Lineales: Manejo de modelos de plasticidad dependiente de la tasa de deformación (ej. Johnson-Cook), criterios de fallo/daño, hiperelasticidad y gran deformación. Contactos Complejos: Configuración de contactos no lineales (fricción, erosión de elementos, autodetección de contacto en malla deformada). Transitorios Térmicos y Termomecánicos: Análisis de acoplamiento térmico-estructural transitorio (gradientes térmicos severos, tensiones térmicas) Para abordar con éxito los casos multifísicos acoplados (FSI o Fluid-Structure Interaction), deseable: Manejo de ANSYS System Coupling / Workbench: Definir interfaces de transferencia de datos (cargas aerodinámicas/presiones > estructura, desplazamientos > malla CFD, campos de temperatura > tensiones térmicas). Estrategias de Acoplamiento: Criterios para determinar cuándo emplear acoplamiento unidireccional (one-way, ej. CFD estacionario/transitorio exportado como carga térmica o de presión a Mechanical) o bidireccional (two-way, transitorio acoplado paso a paso para aeroelasticidad o flutter). Infraestructura HPC: Conocimientos prácticos en configuración de licencias, particionado de malla y paralelización en entornos de supercomputación/clusters para simulación intensiva. Ubicación: Presencialidad en Via de Dublin, Madrid. QUÉ DEBE APORTAR Máster o Grado en Ingeniería Aeronáutica, Mecánica o Industrial Al menos 3 años de experiencia en análisis dinámico no lineal. Inglés B2 Necesario. Deseable C1 ANSYS Mechanical / Autodyn Matlab / Simulink Python Deseable: Simulación estructural avanxada, no lineal y dinámica SpaceClaim/Discovery (preparación y simplificación de geometría) Manejo de código APDL o scripting en Python para automatización de postproceso.

Jobbeskrivning Vi ser potential att växa inom strukturmekanik och söker nu en ny medarbetare till vår beräkningsenhet i Linköping. Som Beräkningsingenjör hos oss får du chansen att arbeta med beräkning mot några av världens ledande industriföretag. Du kommer att bli inblandad i många spännande produktutvecklingsprojekt och ställas inför utmaningar från flera olika branscher. Projekt och uppdrag kan variera i storlek och innehåll samt utföras antingen in-house i våra egna lokaler eller ute på plats hos våra kunder. Fokus är mot tekniska beräkningar inom strukturanalys, både med hjälp av FEM och analytiska metoder. Du kommer få ett personligt ansvar för dina leveranser och möjlighet att driva dina egna projekt framåt. En av anledningarna att våra konsulter trivs så bra är att vi alltid försöker individanpassa rollen som konsult för att stämma med dina förutsättningar. Det betyder att dina möjligheter att vara med och påverka din egen utveckling är stora. Genom täta avstämningar och utvecklingssamtal kommer du och din chef tillsammans sätta såväl långsiktiga som kortsiktiga karriärsmål, som stimulerar just dig, och du sitter själv i förarsätet för din kompetensutveckling. Utöver grymma kollegor, teknisk framkant, kontinuerlig utveckling och stimulerande uppdrag kan vi erbjuda dig mycket mer som Arbetsgivare. Club AFRY är vår personalklubb som arrangerar sociala aktiviteter på och utanför kontoret. Urval sker kontinuerligt så du är välkommen med din ansökan redan idag! Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som vill utvecklas till en hängiven beräkningsingenjör, med stort intresse för teknik i olika former och har ett stort engagemang för hållfasthetsanalyser. Som medarbetare hos oss behöver du snabbt kunna sätta dig in i nya sammanhang och läsa in dig på nya tekniker om så behövs. Som person är du engagerad, ödmjuk och en genuin lagspelare som trivs med att arbeta i team där ni tillsammans uppnår goda resultat. Det är en stor tillgång om du har lätt att skapa goda relationer både med kunder och kollegor. Du är en skicklig kommunikatör och kan enkelt förmedla både dig och dina analysresultat på engelska och svenska, i både tal och skrift. Du har en akademisk utbildningsbakgrund inom hållfasthetslära och vi ser gärna att du har en hög känsla för kvalitet i leveransen och kundvärdet. Det är meriterande om du har en erfarenhet från någon av de vanligaste FE-programvarorna. Ytterligare information Vi söker dig som vill vara en del av AFRYs framgångssaga. Brinner du för teknisk utveckling? Gillar du att samarbeta för att hitta den bästa lösningen? Då kan vi erbjuda dig karriärmöjligheter på en modern arbetsplats med utmanande arbetsuppgifter och spännande projekt världen över. AFRY är rankat som en av Sveriges mest populära arbetsgivare bland ingenjörer. Hos oss är du med och utvecklar innovativa och hållbara lösningar inom infrastruktur, energi och industri. Just nu söker vi marknadens vassaste kompetens som tillsammans med oss vill skapa framtidens samhälle. Vi hoppas också att du kommer lära dig lika mycket av oss som vi kommer göra av dig. Kontaktuppgifter för frågor: Teamledare Kristina Nilsson, kristina.nilsson@afry.com Sektionschef Thommy Nilsson, thommy.nilsson@afry.com På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen

title: Ingénieur(e) calcul en mécanique des structures H/F/D F/H
description: Travaillant au sein de l’équipe « Technology » de l’ingénierie Produit, l’ingénieur(e) calcul pour l’intégrité mécanique devra réaliser des études statiques et dynamiques des composants et assemblages des produits nucléaires, et contribuera au développement des outils et méthodes associés. Les produits nucléaires incluent la turbine à vapeur, les échangeurs thermiques, l’alternateur, les pompes et leurs systèmes auxiliaires. Ce rôle consiste principalement à évaluer l’intégrité mécanique de produits nucléaires (turbine, alternateur, pompes, échangeurs de chaleur, etc.) et à développer des méthodes et outils pour les analyses d’intégrité mécanique statique, dynamique et thermomécanique. Les principales activités sont les suivantes : Réaliser des analyses d’intégrité mécanique par la méthode des éléments finis sur des composants, conformément aux critères de dimensionnement et aux règles et instructions internes. Modéliser des structures complexes à l’aide du logiciel de maillage HyperMesh et effectuer des simulations par éléments finis sous ANSYS. Personnaliser les modèles, automatiser les cas de charge et effectuer des post-traitements avancés à l’aide du langage APDL (Ansys Parametric Design Language). Réaliser des analyses statiques et dynamiques (modales, sismiques, harmoniques, transitoires), ainsi que des études de durée de vie (fatigue, nocivité, propagation de fissures). Effectuer des calculs mécaniques linéaires et non linéaires (non-linéarités de contact, de comportement matériau et de géométrie). Intégrer les exigences des codes (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M) dans les études de dimensionnement des appareils à pression. Prendre en charge les analyses mécaniques dans le cadre de l’exécution des projets et/ou du développement produit. Rédiger les rapports d’analyse d’intégrité mécanique conformément aux exigences qualité et aux plannings définis. Vérifier les calculs et analyses réalisés par d’autres membres de l’équipe. Assurer le suivi technique des activités sous-traitées. Contribuer au développement et à l’harmonisation des outils, processus de calcul et à la capitalisation du savoir-faire. Respecter les règles et instructions EHS propres à l’entreprise. Diplôme d’ingénieur ou doctorat dans le domaine du calcul d’intégrité mécanique. Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine du calcul mécanique de structures par éléments finis. Excellente maîtrise des outils ANSYS (APDL) et HyperMesh ; la connaissance de CATIA est un atout. Bonne connaissance des codes et standards applicables aux appareils à pression (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M). Connaissance des machines tournantes Capacité à lire, analyser et interpréter des plans de fabrication et des documents d’ingénierie. Aptitude à travailler dans un environnement motivant et exigeant. Leadership et capacité à piloter des activités techniques complexes. Bon relationnel, esprit d’équipe et capacité à représenter le service dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et international. Disponibilité pour des déplacements occasionnels en France ou à l’étranger (principalement en Europe). Bon niveau d’anglais.

VOTRE PROFIL Diplômé·e d'une formation Bac+5 en mécanique, génie civil, structures, calcul scientifique ou équivalent, vous disposez d'une première expérience en calcul de structures dans un environnement industriel, nucléaire, aéronautique, ferroviaire, énergétique ou de construction. title: Structures Analysis Engineer, Launch Vehicle Structure (m/f/d)
description: Mission Brief You will be responsible for the structural analysis of entire assemblies belonging to our rocket’s primary and secondary structures. From trading design concepts to sizing and validating design iterations and examining the impact of manufacturing deviations, you will play an important role in guiding design decisions and pushing performance and reliability of our structures forward. As a Mid-Level Structures Analysis Engineer, you will support the analysis, verification and development of launch vehicle structures throughout the entire lifecycle, from concept to qualification. Your Role in Our Space Mission: Perform detailed stress analysis of aerospace structures and components using both classical hand calculations and advanced finite element methods (FEM), mostly of CFRP structures. Identify failure scenarios and collaborate with design engineers to review and optimize structural designs. Define applicable load cases, addressing the impact of thermal, quasi-static loads (arising from random vibrations) etc. Analise and provide possible solutions to manufacturing non-conformities. Develop test plans and support physical testing of components to verify sizing assumptions and qualify hardware. Prepare comprehensive stress analysis reports and documentation for internal/external use. Improve our standards and toolchain for structural verification. Be familiar with classical design standards and have experience in the use of CAD software Operate independently with moderate guidance. Qualification Checklist Degree in the field of Engineering, Aerospace, Mechanical or (Computational) Mechanics, or any other related field. At least 3 years of experience in analysing aerospace structures. Good knowledge in classical hand-calculations and advanced FE Modelling of aerospace structures (Hypermesh, Optistruct, Nastran etc). Self-motivated, collaborative, and capable of working independently with moderate guidance. Good engineering intuition with regards to load paths and failure mechanisms. Strong teamwork skills to contribute to team goals and support large projects, including interaction with other departments. Fluent English Bonus Skills Practical experience in the space sector (preferably in launch vehicle development program). Previous experience using CAD, preferably with Siemens NX. Good understanding of composite structures’ behaviour over a wide range of temperatures. Practical experience with Material Qualification and composite manufacturing techniques. title: Process Engineer
description: At Materialise Medical, we believe that better healthcare starts with solutions designed around the individual patient. If you’re passionate about bringing personalized care to every patient, you’ll love being a part of this team. Through the technology we develop, researchers, engineers, and clinicians are revolutionizing personalized treatment — helping improve and save lives daily. To further drive & support our Medical Production activities Materialise Medical is looking for a Process Engineer to join the HQ Process Engineering team (Leuven). What You Will Be Doing You will be stepping into a cross-functional agile team which focuses on CMF product development as well as manufacturing process development and implementation. With your strong engineering mindset, you develop thorough expertise in additive manufacturing, post-processing, cleaning and quality inspection technologies, allowing you to become the technical expert and GoTo for both development & operational questions. Next to that, you also gain a solid understanding of CMF product specifics, enabling you to effectively connect product requirements to the corresponding process needs. You take the lead in managing and driving larger process development, implementation and validation projects, ensuring alignment across different teams and timely delivery of results. You are involved early in the development of new or updated devices, assessing manufacturability and process validation needs. In close collaboration with the device development team, you assist in the definition of a clear and comprehensive set of product specifications which will serve as input for the process validation and implementation after design transfer. You own the validation programs for the manufacturing processes and corresponding equipment. You create these validation programs from scratch for new products and processes or update them for each product and process change, after which you execute (or coordinate the execution of) the corresponding equipment validations (IQOQPQ). Where required for process or product changes, you set up, execute and analyze process characterization studies to understand the impact of process parameters on process and product output. You continuously evaluate process performance and identify opportunities to standardize, streamline and automate process steps, contributing to operational excellence and scalability. You drive process development and operational roll-out of various process changes and translate this into operational success by providing the right process documentation, including work instructions, operator training and support. You guarantee compliance with Quality Management System requirements by meticulously documenting all phases of the process characterization, validation and operational implementation per internal quality procedures. As a member of the Process Engineering team, you will enjoy close cooperation with stakeholders from operational, device development, biosafety, research, quality and regulatory teams. Through involvement in a variety of activities and projects, we set up a growth trajectory in which you can shape your own future within Materialise. Your profile You have a master’s degree in engineering You have at least 2 years of experience working in a process (validation) engineering role within highly regulated industries such as the medical devices, pharmaceuticals or aerospace industries. Experience with Design Transfer activities and/or Additive Manufacturing is considered a strong plus You are quality oriented and have an eye for detail, but you also don’t get stuck on this. You are able to think out of the box when needed You are good at troubleshooting and problem solving You have a strong and versatile work ethic and you’re eager to learn You are proactive and self-organized. You take initiative and demonstrate full ownership of your tasks. You value and uphold impeccable coordination Strong English verbal & written skills required Note: A motivation letter is requested when applying for this position. What’s Waiting For You Work that matters The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day. At Materialise, we expect you to think about the customer, not just the task. You push for better solutions and care about the difference your work makes. A people-centered space When you join Materialise, you join a group of colleagues invested in you, not just your work. From your own team to a department across the world, you’ll find a sense of belonging with people who help without being asked, challenge you, and have your back. At the same time, we expect you to invest in the people around you — not just your own work — to make the group stronger than the sum of its parts. An environment of trust As a company of innovators, we know how crucial autonomy is in your work. When we hire you, we trust in your expertise, giving you space to organize your tasks, work flexibly, and make your own calls. At Materialise, we expect you to deliver on that trust and keep your commitments. A career ready to build When you see opportunities for your career to grow at Materialise, we encourage you to go for them. People shape a fulfilling career at their own pace here. At Materialise, we expect you to take initiative in your own development. Don’t wait for someone else to plan your career. Step into the space and make it count. Make a difference together with the Medical team.

Execute qualification and certification activities for AM hardware in accordance with aerospace requirements and internal quality processes. title: Metal Additive Manufacturing Research Lead
location: San Cristobal de La Laguna, Kanarya Adaları, İspanya
description: ARQUIMEA is a global technology company that develops innovative solutions and products for highly demanding sectors. Our areas of activity include Aerospace, Defense & Security, Big Science, Biotechnology, and Fintech. ARQUIMEA Research Center (ARC) , part of ARQUIMEA , was established in 2019 with the ambition of inventing the technologies of tomorrow. It is a European-level environment of innovation and excellence where senior and junior researchers from around the world work together to develop disruptive technologies and business models that will drive socio-economic growth in the medium and long term. This is a strategic position for both ARQUIMEA Research Center and ARQUIMEA New Tech. The objective is to build internal capabilities in metallic additive manufacturing, reduce dependence on external suppliers, accelerate the development of advanced components, and create a technological advantage in high-performance materials and manufacturing processes. We are looking for a Metal Additive Manufacturing Research Lead to join the Materials Research Line within ARC. The position is linked to a strategic R&D area with high relevance for ARQUIMEA New Tech. Main Function and Scope We are seeking a Metal Additive Manufacturing Research Lead to drive a strategic R&D line focused on metallic additive manufacturing for high-performance industrial and aerospace applications. This role is intended for a postdoctoral researcher with strong hands-on experience in metal 3D printing, additive manufacturing process development, materials characterization, and experimental research. The successful candidate will lead the technical development of metal additive manufacturing capabilities applied to advanced metallic components, complex geometries, porous structures, lightweight parts, and functional hardware designed for demanding environments. The position combines applied research, experimental development, technology maturation, and industrialization-oriented thinking. The objective is not only to explore new manufacturing routes but also to build a real technological capability that can be transferred into products, processes, and sustainable competitive advantages for ARQUIMEA . Required Skills, Experience And Candidate Profile Responsibilities Lead the R&D line focused on metallic additive manufacturing for high-performance applications. Define and execute experimental plans for metal additive manufacturing processes. Develop and optimize process parameters for metallic 3D printing technologies. Investigate manufacturing routes for complex metallic components, porous structures, lightweight parts, and functional hardware. Work on materials selection, process-property relationships, and manufacturability. Coordinate design, manufacturing, post-processing, inspection, and testing activities. Define characterization plans, including microstructure, porosity, mechanical performance, thermal performance, cleanliness, and repeatability. Key Responsibilities: Materials Expertise and Advancement: Drive the transition of new powder materials from concept to industry, navigating challenges from lab to application. Fluency in Swedish and English, spoken and written. Location This position is for our office in Stockholm. We do not offer any relocation support for this role. So, what do you think? title: Junior mechanical engineer
description: Ontwerp wat beweegt, tilt en draait Als junior mechanical engineer werk je aan techniek die letterlijk in beweging is.
