Jij ontwerpt en rekent aan onderdelen die onder zware omstandigheden moeten blijven functioneren. Binnen infra en water werk je aan beweegbare bruggen, sluizen, gemalen en waterzuiveringen. Je ontwerpt aandrijvingen en bewegingswerken die elke dag betrouwbaar moeten functioneren. In offshoreprojecten werk je aan hijsvoorzieningen en mechanische onderdelen van windplatforms. Binnen de industrie ontwerp je constructies voor fabrieken en procesinstallaties. En in de maritieme sector werk je mee aan de mechanica van onderzeeboten en marineschepen. Je werkt ontwerpen uit van concept tot detail. Je maakt berekeningen op sterkte, stijfheid en vermoeiing, toetst aan normen en denkt mee over maakbaarheid en onderhoud. Je stemt af met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines zoals civiele techniek, elektrotechniek en procestechnologie. Je ziet hoe jouw ontwerp onderdeel wordt van een groter geheel. Bij Iv werken we aan projecten die anderen soms voor onmogelijk houden. We houden van ingewikkelde vraagstukken, maar niet van moeilijk doen. De lijnen zijn kort, de lat ligt hoog en je krijgt snel verantwoordelijkheid. Je start met begeleiding, maar groeit snel door naar zelfstandige taken. This is an excellent opportunity for recent Mechanical Engineering graduates who want to build a career with a leading international mechanical and electrical contractor. You will gain hands-on experience across live projects, working alongside experienced engineers, project teams, commercial teams and site leadership. As a Graduate Mechanical Engineer, you will support the delivery of mechanical building services across a range of projects, which may include commercial, industrial, pharmaceutical, data centre, residential, energy and infrastructure environments. You will be exposed to both office-based and site-based work, giving you a strong practical understanding of how mechanical systems are designed, coordinated, installed, tested and commissioned. Designer Group’s graduate programme is designed to support early-career professionals through practical project experience, mentoring, structured development and exposure to major engineering projects across Ireland, the UK and Europe. The existing graduate programme is positioned as a two-year programme providing hands-on experience across core teams and project environments. Key Responsibilities Will Include Supporting project teams with the delivery of mechanical services from early-stage planning through to installation, testing and commissioning. Assisting with technical reviews, drawings, specifications, submittals and project documentation. Working with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors and site teams to support safe and efficient project delivery. Supporting quality, safety and compliance requirements across mechanical works. Assisting with progress tracking, reporting, materials coordination and issue resolution. Developing practical knowledge of M&E contracting, construction sequencing, programme requirements and client expectations. Building your technical understanding of mechanical systems, site coordination, project delivery and engineering best practice. Participating in training, mentoring and continuous professional development as part of your graduate journey. Requirements Requirements Minimum Requirements Level 7 or Level 8 qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline. Strong interest in mechanical building services, M&E contracting and construction project delivery. Good communication, organisation and problem-solving skills. Ability to work well as part of a team and take direction from experienced engineers and project leaders. Proactive attitude, strong work ethic and willingness to learn. Comfortable working in both office and site-based environments. Available to start immediately or at short notice. Preferred But Not Essential Previous placement, internship or site experience within construction, M&E, building services, utilities, energy, pharma, commercial or data centre environments. Basic understanding of mechanical drawings, schematics, technical specifications or construction documentation. Exposure to AutoCAD, Revit, BIM, Microsoft Project, Excel or other engineering/project tools. Interest in progressing toward professional development, CPD and chartership. Benefits Benefits At Designer Group, our people are central to our continued growth. We invest in graduates through structured development, mentoring and exposure to real project delivery from the beginning of their careers. Benefits Include Full-time permanent employment. Structured graduate development. Mentoring from experienced engineering professionals. Exposure to major M&E projects. Pathway to chartership. CPD training, including Engineers Ireland-accredited development. International project opportunities. Competitive salary. Pension plan. Health plan. Life cover. Travel and subsistence allowances where applicable. Bike to Work scheme. Social committee and employee events. Third-level education grant support. Designer Group is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: About Osbit: We’re Osbit. We design and build cutting-edge engineering systems to make offshore wind happen at scale. We supply engineering equipment across many technology areas, to enable key offshore operations such as wind turbine foundation installation, burial and installation of subsea cables, and the lifting & handling of wind turbine components. We’re here to redefine what’s possible offshore, to drive the clean energy sector, and our planet, forward. We combine decades of collective experience in developing offshore equipment with fresh and innovative approaches, and we are passionate about enabling a more sustainable world for us all. We're proud to be a formative member company in game-changing offshore wind services business Venterra Group. Role Description: This role is the sturdy foundation underpinning Osbit’s success. An Osbit Mechanical Engineer is technically capable, and driven, in equal measure. You're an energetic all-rounder, owning your project from start to finish, and collaborating closely with your colleagues to overcome any obstacles thrown your way. The offshore wind industry is growing fast, and our projects are too. There’s lots to work on, with opportunities to take ownership and make a genuine difference to our business outcomes. You must be willing to get stuck in, combining your technical nous with strong communication, and lateral thinking, to ensure that we deliver On Spec, to Budget and In Time - OSBIT, every time. Your Responsibilities: You'll be part of a live project team, working closely with your teammates to design and build each engineering system. You may be assigned different roles project-to-project, and your core responsibilities include: Helping design innovative systems from first principles, from concept through to detailed design, while maintaining technical excellence. Supporting on schedule delivery by effective management of your project deliverables. Managing supplier progress, holding regular meetings and in-person support. Preparing technical documentation & design calculations for peer review, and checking third party documentation. Preparing for and carrying out testing, commissioning and mobilisation activities. Liaising with other business functions, including finance and HSSEQ, for support and guidance. Supporting your teammates by sharing your knowledge and insights in working groups and presentations, where applicable. About You: Open minded with a keen to learn attitude. First rate communicator. Self-motivated and persistent in getting from A to B. Diligent in attention to detail. Adaptable when unexpected challenges crop up. Your Experience: We welcome a range of qualification levels, from graduates onwards. In this role, as a basis you'll need: A degree-level qualification, or equivalent, in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Engineering, or Naval Architecture. The ability to work with Autodesk Inventor software. Proficiency in hand calculations, through to Staad and FEA. Further Information: Successful applicants be based at our Netherlands headquarters, in Rotterdam, working on site as required. Working abroad may be required at times to visit customers, suppliers, and support assembly programmes. We can offer hybrid working in this role. What we offer: It's really important to us that Osbit is a fun and supportive place to be. This is why we offer a range of benefits. In the Netherlands, these include: Company pension scheme. Opportunities to take part in UK inhouse training. Lunch and refreshments provided daily. Access to a UK Myers Briggs practitioner & counsellor, and tailored coaching. Annual summer party celebration and Christmas walk, lunch, and festivities. About Venterra Group: Venterra Group is a dedicated wind energy services group at the forefront of driving the clean energy transition. Together, we engineer, build and support the operations of major wind developments around the world by providing specialist, technical and comprehensive services at every stage of the project lifecycle. Our vision is to become the global services champion and strategic partner supporting the wind industry’s rapid expansion. At Venterra, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected and valued. We believe that diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives make us stronger and help us achieve better outcomes. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to succeed and thrive.

title: 2027 Ireland Graduate Mechanical Engineering Career Path: Water
description: Before making an application, please browse all graduate opportunities available as we will only accept one application per candidate. Once you have made an application you will not be able to make changes to your selection or make a new application. The exception is if we open new vacancies in the new year. To avoid missing out on your preferred role, we recommend applying as early as possible, as positions will close once filled. Application process Upload CV and cover letter, detailing motivations and suitability for the opportunity. Online strengths-based assessment This opportunity uses a single-stage strengths-based interview as part of the selection process. Start your career with a global, employee-owned consultancy where your work can make a real difference. At Mott MacDonald, you'll work alongside experts, contribute to meaningful projects, and have the support, learning opportunities, and experience needed to grow your career from day one. Job Description Engineer the Future of Water. Empower Communities. Protect the Planet. At Mott MacDonald, we’re not just building infrastructure we’re shaping the systems that deliver clean water, protect public health, and support sustainable living. As a Graduate Mechanical Engineer in our Water Division, you’ll be part of a team that’s transforming the entire water cycle from abstraction and treatment to distribution and disposal. You’ll work on high-profile, innovative projects, including advanced resilience schemes at some of the largest wastewater treatment works in the UK, helping protect the River Thames and surrounding communities from pollution and flooding. This is your opportunity to contribute to meaningful change, supported by a culture that values your growth, wellbeing, and ideas. What You’ll Be Doing Design with purpose: Contribute to mechanical designs across the full water cycle potable water systems, wastewater treatment, and more. Innovate and collaborate: Work alongside multidisciplinary teams to deliver sustainable, forward-thinking solutions for complex challenges. Learn and grow: Gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies and engineering practices, supported by mentoring and training. Make an impact: Help deliver projects that improve lives, protect ecosystems, and respond to the climate emergency. Candidate Specification At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in. To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience (excluding placements ) and have a masters degree (obtained no earlier than 2025) or expected to achieve one of the following degree disciplines: Mechanical Engineering In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests - such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects. We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led – we do not use AI tools at this stage and kindly ask you not to either. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story. We are looking for graduates with the following strengths: Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently. Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues. Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity. Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving. AI Usage At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application. Accessibility We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help. About Your Development A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. You will join our three-year early careers soft skills development programme – Accelerating your Future, which is designed to give you the skills and tools necessary for a long-lasting successful career here at Mott MacDonald. Our social side Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in. From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community. title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Van net afgestudeerd tot ervaren engineer: bouw met ons mee aan techniek die je niet iedere dag tegenkomt. Royal SMIT groeit. Daarom breiden we ons Engineering-team in Nijmegen flink uit en zoeken we meerdere Mechanical Engineers. Of je nu aan het begin van je carrière staat, al een paar jaar ervaring hebt of toe bent aan een volgende stap als ervaren engineer: bij ons krijg je de ruimte om op jouw niveau in te stappen én verder te groeien. Je werkt aan indrukwekkende vermogenstransformatoren voor klanten over de hele wereld. En omdat Engineering en Productie bij ons op dezelfde locatie zitten, blijft het niet bij een ontwerp op je beeldscherm. Wat jij ontwerpt, zie je hier daadwerkelijk gebouwd worden. Wat ga je doen? Als Mechanical Engineer werk je aan het mechanische buitenwerk van onze vermogenstransformatoren. Denk aan de tank, koeling, expansievaten, ventilatoren, pompen en het complete oliecircuit. Geen project is hetzelfde. Van aardbevingsbestendigheid en transport tot koeling, geluid en extreme weersomstandigheden: jij vertaalt technische eisen naar slimme, veilige én maakbare oplossingen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Ontwerpen en construeren in 3D CAD; Uitvoeren en beoordelen van technische berekeningen; Ontwerpen toetsen op kwaliteit, veiligheid, maakbaarheid en kosten; Samenwerken met collega’s binnen Engineering en Operations; Oplossen van technische vraagstukken binnen projecten; Bijdragen aan innovatie en verbetering van onze ontwerpen. Hoe snel je verantwoordelijkheid krijgt, hangt af van jouw ervaring en ontwikkeling. Iedere engineer start bij ons met een inwerktraject waarin je ons unieke product, onze processen en onze manier van werken leert kennen. Als starter krijg je daarbij intensieve begeleiding van ervaren collega’s. Breng je al relevante ervaring mee, dan zul je het inwerktraject op onderdelen sneller doorlopen en eerder zelfstandig technische vraagstukken en projecten oppakken. Naarmate je groeit in je rol, krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om complexere uitdagingen aan te pakken. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken vooral engineers die enthousiast worden van techniek en graag willen blijven leren. Je hebt: Je hebt een afgeronde technische opleiding op mbo-, hbo- of wo-niveau, waarbij relevante werkervaring binnen engineering voor ons minstens zo belangrijk is als je opleidingsniveau Kennis van of ervaring met 3D CAD en mechanisch construeren; Affiniteit met constructieleer en technische berekeningen; Oog voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en maakbaarheid; Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Ervaring met transformatoren is niet nodig. Ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld machinebouw, staalconstructies, energie, offshore of zware industrie is mooi meegenomen. Wat bieden wij jou? Of dit nu je eerste baan als engineer wordt of je al jaren ervaring hebt: we kijken naar jouw kennis, ervaring en het niveau waarop je bij ons instapt. Voor de functie van Mechanical Engineer hanteren we, afhankelijk van jouw niveau, de volgende salarisranges: Junior Mechanical Engineer: €3.400 – €4.300 bruto per maand; Medior Mechanical Engineer: €4.200 – €5.500 bruto per maand; Senior Mechanical Engineer: €5.400 – €6.797 bruto per maand. De uiteindelijke inschaling bepalen we op basis van jouw kennis, relevante werkervaring en de verantwoordelijkheden die je binnen de functie kunt oppakken. Daarnaast krijg je: 27 verlofdagen en 13 ADV-dagen, waarbij je ADV kunt omruilen voor extra salaris; Een PME-pensioenregeling; Reiskostenvergoeding; Een bonusregeling gebaseerd op bedrijfsdoelstellingen; Fiscale voordelen via FiscFree; Een fietsstimuleringsprogramma via Trappers; Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf technisch en persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen. Dit is werken bij Royal SMIT Transformers B.V. Bij Royal SMIT Transformers B.V. stap je in de wereld van de toekomst, waar we ons richten op vermogenstransformatoren en secundaire installaties. Onze moderne productiefaciliteit in Nijmegen is een toonbeeld van innovatie en kwaliteit. We dragen wereldwijd bij aan de opwekking en distributie van elektrische energie, en dat maakt impact! In onze professionele en collegiale werkomgeving voel je je meteen thuis. We zijn trots op ons ambacht van morgen en kijken ernaar uit om samen met jou verder te bouwen aan een duurzame toekomst. Je werkt samen met verschillende technische disciplines aan transformatoren die wereldwijd worden ingezet. Het bijzondere? Onze Engineering en Productie zitten op dezelfde locatie. Je kunt de productie inlopen, overleggen met de collega’s die jouw ontwerp bouwen en met eigen ogen zien hoe jouw technische keuzes werkelijkheid worden. Zo bouwen we niet alleen aan transformatoren, maar ook aan ons Engineering-team voor de toekomst. Op de afdeling engineering werken we met ongeveer 80 engineers verdeeld over zes disciplines vol passie aan transformator ontwerpen. Om de transformator ontwerpen zo te maken dat de transformatoren succesvol geproduceerd, geassembleerd, getest, getransporteerd en uiteindelijk bij de klant in bedrijf genomen kunnen worden, wordt multidisciplinair samengewerkt tussen de disciplines. Dit is een team van elektrische en mechanische specialisten op verschillende vakgebieden. Zin in een uitdaging? Net afgestudeerd, al een paar jaar aan het werk of inmiddels een ervaren engineer? We komen graag met je in contact. Heb je vragen over deze functie of wil je solliciteren? Neem contact op met Niek Sterenborg via +31 6 12 35 72 40 of niek.sterenborg@sgb-smit.group. Klaar om te solliciteren? Klik op de sollicitatiebutton! X

title: Junior Mechanical Engineer

Zo ontdek je niet alleen waar jouw kracht ligt, maar bouw je ook snel ervaring op bij verschillende opdrachtgevers. De ideale start voor engineers die willen leren, groeien en zichzelf blijven ontwikkelen. Dit ga je doen Als Junior Mechanical Engineer Werk Je Aan De Ontwikkeling Van Mechanische Systemen Voor Uiteenlopende Projecten Binnen De Machinebouw, Industrie, Productie En Hightech. Via Wepro Zet Je Jouw Kennis Direct In Bij Verschillende Opdrachtgevers. Samen Met Ervaren Engineers Bouw Je Aan Slimme Technische Oplossingen En Krijg Je Stap Voor Stap Meer Verantwoordelijkheid. Jouw Werkzaamheden Bestaan Onder Andere Uit Ontwerpen en modelleren van machines, apparaten en industriële systemen in 3D CAD-software. Opstellen van 2D-werktekeningen, stuklijsten en technische documentatie. Vertalen van technische vraagstukken naar praktische, veilige en betrouwbare oplossingen. Meewerken aan productontwikkeling en het verbeteren van bestaande machines en installaties. Afstemmen met opdrachtgevers, leveranciers en collega-engineers om projecten succesvol te realiseren. Ondersteunen van de werkplaats bij de realisatie en doorontwikkeling van ontwerpen. Je bent fit for the job als je... Daarnaast Breng Je Het Volgende Mee Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechanical Engineering of een vergelijkbare technische richting, zoals Automotive, Mechatronica of Aviation Engineering. Ervaring met engineeringprojecten vanuit stages, afstudeeropdrachten of werkervaring. Kennis van CAD-software en FEM-analyses, bijvoorbeeld SolidWorks, Inventor of vergelijkbare systemen. Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. De ambitie om projectmatig te werken en ervaring op te doen binnen verschillende organisaties en industrieën. title: Mechanical Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Job Description ATMOS Works is seeking a Mechanical Engineer (m/f/d) with strong expertise in CAD-based development, mechanical design, and hands-on experience in building aerospace-grade hardware. Key responsabilities You will develop and refine mechanical designs from concept through production, ensuring space-qualification requirements are met. You will create detailed 3D CAD models and technical drawings, preferably in SolidWorks, for manufacturing and assembly processes. You will lead the mechanical design, analysis, and optimization of launcher structures, mechanisms, and interfaces for performance, durability, and mass efficiency. You will define materials, components, and manufacturing methods compliant with aerospace standards and environmental constraints. You will manage and support the end-to-end manufacturing process, including prototype builds, assembly, integration, and test campaigns. You will conduct and document mechanical, structural, and environmental testing, including vibration, thermal cycling, and fit checks. You will collaborate closely with internal teams, including systems, avionics, and propulsion, to ensure seamless integration of mechanical subsystems. You will interface with suppliers and partners to clarify technical specifications and ensure component quality and compliance. You will continuously improve existing designs to enhance performance, reliability, manufacturability, and cost efficiency. You will ensure full traceability, documentation, and compliance with safety, aerospace, and certification requirements. Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field. Professional experience in mechanical design through internships, working student roles, university projects, or an entry-level engineering position. Good knowledge of 3D CAD modelling and technical drawing; experience with SolidWorks is a strong plus. Initial hands-on experience with mechanical assembly, prototype development, or testing is an advantage. Solid understanding of mechanical structures, materials, and manufacturing processes. Interest in designing hardware for demanding environments, including vibration, thermal loads, and other challenging operating conditions. Ability to understand technical requirements and translate them into practical and robust mechanical designs. Strong written and spoken German; English is a strong plus. Structured and proactive way of working, with strong problem-solving skills and a hands-on mindset. **Please note that we can only consider applicants who are nationals of an EU member state .** Company description ATMOS Works is a dedicated business unit of ATMOS Space Cargo, based in Kraków, Poland, and established to serve European government and defence customers. It develops and operates dual-use orbital capabilities, including the secure, sovereign return of sensitive hardware and data, in-orbit demonstration and validation (IOD/IOV), and advanced space systems. ATMOS was founded as a European company built on the values of freedom, democracy, equality, the rule of law, and human rights. We are committed to protect these values by making our technology available to others who share the same values, strengthening infrastructure and innovation for prosperity on Earth.Our team is multinational and diverse, with offices in Lichtenau and Strasbourg. We work in a collegial, hands-on culture where people support each other, take ownership, and keep learning every day. Motivation for the mission comes first — building spacecraft is not a nine-to-five pursuit. We align the mission, the team, and the individual in mutual dependence. This principle shapes our work environment where exceptional people, as committed as they are competent, can grow and contribute to a mission that matters.

description: Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 100 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 27,3 milliards d'euros en 2024, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés. Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2024 » du magazine TIME. Safran Aerosystems est l'un des leaders mondiaux des systèmes aéronautiques dédiés à la sécurité des avions et hélicoptères ainsi qu'à la gestion des fluides et du carburant. La société est un acteur clé dans le domaine de la sécurité des vols (oxygène, évacuation, flottabilités) et participe à la décarbonation de l'aviation grâce aux carburants alternatifs durables et aux nouvelles architectures moteurs. Elle compte 5200 collaborateurs répartis dans 7 pays. Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi Vous souhaitez intégrer un grand Groupe aéronautique leader sur ses marchés avec de grands défis à relever ? La Division Aerosafety (DASY) développe une large gamme de systèmes gonflables (toboggans d'évacuation, flottabilités de secours d'hélicoptères, radeaux et gilets de sauvetage) pour aéronefs commerciaux et militaires ainsi que des systèmes oxygène pour les pilotes et passagers. Vous intégrerez la Business Unit Oxygen Systems, qui conçoit des systèmes et équipements oxygène destinés à assurer la sécurité des équipages et des passagers à bord des avions civils et militaires et des hélicoptères. En tant qu'Ingénieur-e Produit, vous serez en charge de concevoir, de justifier et de maintenir la définition des équipements Oxygène développés pour l'aviation civile et militaire (masques à oxygène pour pilotes, systèmes de distribution et de régulation...). Vous serez en charge des étapes clés du développement de nouveaux produits et d'évolutions de systèmes existants. Pour se faire, vous mènerez les activités suivantes : - Développer des produits et sous-ensembles respectant les exigences Client, en établissant les spécifications en collaboration avec les Ingénieur-es Systèmes. - Construire la définition de l'équipement et sa justification en : - élaborant la définition de l'équipement avec l'aide des concepteurs ou conceptrices de l'équipe, tout en veillant à la pertinence technico-économique des solutions, - spécifiant des calculs et des simulations numériques auprès des Ingénieur-es Simulations, - spécifiant les programmes d'essais de mise au point, de développement et de qualification auprès du Laboratoire d'essais, et en validant les résultats. - Piloter l'ensemble des travaux de développement et de qualification de l'équipement. Ce poste pourrait être évolutif vers un rôle de manager hiérarchique. Vous savez gérer des projets de développement Produit et déployer une approche basée sur la gestion du risque, des coûts et du respect des délais ? Vous serez amené-e, lors de faits techniques, à appliquer les méthodes d'expertise et de résolution de problèmes. Vous avez un diplôme Bac+5 et possédez une forte expérience (supérieure à 8 ans) dans le développement d'équipements mécaniques ou pneumatiques pour l'éronautique ? Les compétences techniques recherchées : - Expériences réalisées dans le développement d'équipements aéronautiques civils (DO-160) - Bonnes compétences en mécanique et matériaux (résistance, lois de comportement, tenue en statique et en fatigue, lecture de plan, chaîne de cote...), ainsi qu'en pneumatique. - Maîtrise des méthodes d'analyses fonctionnelles et de Fiabilité et Sécurité de Fonctionnement (AMDEC, évènements redoutés, arbres de défaillance...). - Des connaissances en CAO (Catia v5), en simulations numériques structure, vous seront nécessaires pour échanger avec les membres de l'équipe. Le savoir-être recherché : - Rigueur, sérieux et orientation satisfaction Client, - Esprit d'équipe et excellentes qualités relationnelles, - Autonomie, polyvalence, proactivité et transparence. - Appétence pour le management d'équipe Vous recherchez un nouveau challenge pour « booster » votre carrière ? KU Leuven website: https://www.kuleuven.be/english/kuleuven/ Project KU Leuven seeks a highly motivated PhD candidate for a fully funded, four-year international doctoral position within the Marie Sklodowska-Curie Doctoral Network (MSCA-DN) project TURBO-IMPACT (TURBOmachinery Innovative Manufacturing, Processing, Analysis, Characterization, and Topology ; Website: https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101311350). The TurboImpact project, funded by Horizon Europe – MSCA-DN, tackles challenges in designing, optimizing, selecting materials, and manufacturing small-scale turbomachinery for applications in heat pumps, fuel cells, organic Rankine cycles, or gas turbines. This project develops robust system and component design methods, an integrated manufacturing platform, and multi-material joining techniques to efficiently produce small-scale turbomachinery. In this EU project, this PhD researcher (DC8) will focus on the complete indirect DLP/SLA additive manufacturing route for silicon nitride turbomachinery components. This involves the development of a UV-curable Si3N4 slurry, optimization of DLP/SLA printing strategies for reference parts and complex components such as impellers, and the post-printing debinding and sintering process to obtain fully dense complex near-net-shaped ceramic components. The AM parts will be microstructurally, mechanically and geometrically characterized. Simple geometries will be used for the evaluation of joining and machining performances, whereas the complex near-net-shaped components will be applied in turbomachinery. The research group has a long track record (>35 years) on the powder metallurgical development, processing and characterisaton of ceramics, cermets, metcers and metals. title: PhD positions in Structural Health Monitoring of Welded Thermoplastic Composite Assemblies
description: Job Description Thermoplastic composites are widely regarded as promising materials for the next generation of commercial aircraft, combining excellent mechanical performance with low weight. In addition, their melt-processable matrix enables automated, high-rate manufacturing of components that can subsequently be assembled into complex aerostructures using welding. This provides significant opportunities for more efficient and cost-effective aircraft manufacturing. However, welded composite assemblies are challenging to inspect using conventional non-destructive inspection techniques. As a result, larger safety margins are often required in structural design, leading to heavier structures, while maintenance intervals may be more conservative than necessary. Developing reliable methods to continuously assess the structural condition therefore enable both lighter designs and more efficient maintenance strategies. To address this challenge, the project aims to develop structural health monitoring technologies based on a digital twin . The digital twin will combine information from the physical structure with models and monitoring data to assess its current structural state and predict its remaining lifetime. This will enable the condition of welded structures to be monitored throughout their service life, allowing maintenance to be planned when it is actually needed rather than according to predetermined intervals. Ultimately, this approach aims to contribute to lighter, safer, and more sustainable aircraft structures . The PhD positions Experimental characterization and digital twin development A key challenge in developing a reliable digital twin is accurately characterizing the static and fatigue behaviour of welded thermoplastic composite joints. Since there are currently no well-established standards for fatigue testing of these joints, the project will involve developing experimental methods to reliably characterize their mechanical performance and damage evolution. The experimental results will be used to develop constitutive models for the welded interface. In particular, these models should describe progressive interfacial damage development as a function of fatigue loading. The models will be implemented and validated in commercial finite element (FE) software. The resulting FE model will define the digital twin of the welded structure and provide the basis for the second PhD project, which will use the digital twin together with monitoring data to develop prognostic structural health monitoring strategies. In this project you will: Perform experimental characterization of the static and fatigue performance of welded thermoplastic composite structures. Develop constitutive models that accurately describe the performance of the welded interface. Implement the developed models in commercial FE simulation software for the development of a digital twin and validate their accuracy against experiments. We are looking for a colleague who has experience in mechanical experimentation of the fatigue behavior of composite materials and/or polymers, and is able to develop and implement constitutive models in FE software. Development of a Structural Health Monitoring system The ability to estimate the current state of the welded thermoplastic composite joint and the development of this state over time, is of decisive importance for lifetime performance modelling. The key challenges are the robust integration of a sensor system in the structure and the analysis of measured signals, which are typically strongly affected by environmental and operational conditions. This project aims to tackle these challenges by using piezo-electric and/or optical fiber based sensor system, combined with physics informed data analysis method, exploiting the digital twin model developed by the first PhD project. In this project you will: Implement an effective sensor integration method for welded thermoplastic composite structures, using piezo-electric sensors, fiber optical sensor, or a combination of both. Perform dynamic experiments of pristine and (gradually) damaged structures to collect data for the state estimation methods. Develop signal processing methods to estimate, enriched by physics-based information, the current state of the welded structure and its development under fatigue loading. We are looking for a colleague who has experience in sensor integration and dynamic experimentation, knowledge of piezo-electric or optical fiber based measurements, and proficiency in signal processing methods enriched with physics-based information. Your profile You are a highly motivated researcher who is driven by curiosity and has: A Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or equivalent. Good team-working abilities and a positive can-do mentality. Strong reporting and communication skills Proficiency in English, both spoken and written (we require a TOEFL > 90 or IELTS > 6.5 score). Further, the position on fatigue characterization and mechanical modelling requires: Experimental skills in the mechanical characterization of fiber reinforced composites or polymers; experience with fatigue testing is desired. Theoretical knowledge and skills in the modelling of (failure) of fiber reinforced composites. Experience with the finite element method and programming experience in scripting languages like Python or Matlab. The position on structural health monitoring requires: Experimental and theoretical skills in dynamics and experiences with piezo-electric and/or fiber optic sensors. Experience with signal processing methods of data, enriched with physics-based information. title: Ingénieur(e) calcul en mécanique des structures expérimenté(e) F/H
description: Travaillant au sein de l’équipe « Technology » de l’ingénierie Produit, l’ingénieur(e) calcul en intégrité mécanique réalise des analyses statiques, dynamiques et thermomécaniques sur les composants et assemblages des produits nucléaires. Ces produits incluent notamment la turbine à vapeur, l’alternateur, les pompes, les échangeurs de chaleur et leurs systèmes auxiliaires. Le rôle comprend également la contribution au développement et à l’amélioration des méthodes et outils dédiés aux analyses d’intégrité mécanique, afin de garantir la fiabilité et la performance des équipements. Les missions clés : Réaliser des analyses d’intégrité mécanique par la méthode des éléments finis sur des composants, conformément aux critères de dimensionnement et aux règles et instructions internes. Modéliser des structures complexes à l’aide du logiciel de maillage HyperMesh et effectuer des simulations par éléments finis sous ANSYS. Personnaliser les modèles, automatiser les cas de charge et effectuer des post-traitements avancés à l’aide du langage APDL (Ansys Parametric Design Language). Réaliser des analyses statiques et dynamiques (modales, sismiques, harmoniques, transitoires), ainsi que des études de durée de vie (fatigue, nocivité, propagation de fissures). Effectuer des calculs mécaniques linéaires et non linéaires (non-linéarités de contact, de comportement matériau et de géométrie). Intégrer les exigences des codes (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M) dans les études de dimensionnement des appareils à pression. Prendre en charge les analyses mécaniques dans le cadre de l’exécution des projets et/ou du développement produit. Coordination technique entre les équipes calculs MI et les équipes design et de management de projet. Représente l’activité calcul MI au sein de revues d’avancement projet Proposer, planifier et exécuter les activités de projet en lien avec le responsable de l’équipe Intégrité Mécanique, incluant la mise en œuvre de méthodes et d’outils de calcul adaptés. Rédiger les rapports d’analyse d’intégrité mécanique conformément aux exigences qualité et aux plannings définis. Vérifier les calculs et analyses réalisés par d’autres membres de l’équipe. Assurer le suivi technique des activités sous-traitées. Contribuer au développement et à l’harmonisation des outils, processus de calcul et à la capitalisation du savoir-faire. Promouvoir le savoir-faire et l’image du département. Agir conformément aux valeurs et au code d’éthique de l’entreprise. Respecter les règles et instructions EHS propres à l’entreprise. Diplôme d’ingénieur ou doctorat dans le domaine du calcul d’intégrité mécanique. Minimum 10 ans d’expérience dans le domaine du calcul mécanique de structures par éléments finis. Excellente maîtrise des outils ANSYS (APDL) et HyperMesh ; la connaissance de CATIA est un atout. Bonne connaissance des codes et standards applicables aux appareils à pression (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M). Connaissance des machines tournantes. Capacité à lire, analyser et interpréter des plans de fabrication et des documents d’ingénierie. Aptitude à travailler dans un environnement motivant et exigeant. Leadership et capacité à piloter des activités techniques complexes, et assurer le suivi de projets (engagement et adhérence au planning, pilotage des études, reporting…). Bon relationnel, esprit d’équipe et capacité à représenter le service dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et international. Disponibilité pour des déplacements occasionnels en France ou à l’étranger (principalement en Europe). Langues : Français indispensable, bon niveau d’anglais.
